title: 米約高架橋
summary: 米約高架橋以七座混凝土高墩、七座鋼塔與 2,460 公尺連續鋼箱梁跨越法國塔恩河谷，最高墩約 245 公尺、塔頂高 343 公尺。本課從河谷高空風與多跨斜張體系的勁度問題出發，分析雙肢橋墩、正交異性鋼箱梁與 154 根單股斜索，再拆解由兩岸頂推、經臨時鋼墩把跨徑減半的施工法與合龍，最後談斜索監測、載重試驗、鋼橋面疲勞與特許經營期的維護。
summaryEn: The Millau Viaduct crosses the Tarn valley in France on seven concrete piers, seven steel pylons and a 2,460 m continuous steel box deck, with the tallest pier about 245 m and the pylon tops at 343 m. The course starts with high-level valley wind and the stiffness problem of multi-span cable-stayed bridges, examines split-shaft piers, the orthotropic steel box and 154 monostrand stays, then unpacks launching from both abutments over temporary towers that halve the spans and the closure, ending with stay monitoring, load testing, deck fatigue and maintenance through the concession.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 頂推設計練習：鋼梁自重 w = 36,000 t / 2,460 m ≈ 14.6 t/m，即約 143.6 kN/m。頂推到臨時墩前，若無鼻樑，171 m 懸臂根部彎矩 M₀ = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m。改用 40 m、30 kN/m 的鋼鼻樑時，鋼梁懸臂只剩 131 m：M = 143.6×131²/2 + 30×40×(131 + 20) ≈ 1.232×10⁶ + 0.181×10⁶ ≈ 1.41×10⁶ kN·m，減少約 33%。南段 1,743 m 鋼梁重約 1,743×143.6 ≈ 250,000 kN；若滑動摩擦 μ = 0.03、縱坡 i = 3.025%，向上坡推需 F ≈ W·(μ + i) ≈ 15,100 kN，向下坡則 W·(μ − i) ≈ 0，表示梁會自行下滑，必須設置制動與反推。由此可見輕量鼻樑與頂推斜索比推力大小更關鍵，控制量是懸臂根部彎矩與下坡時的制動。鼻樑長度、重量與摩擦係數為教學假設，不代表米約的實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Launching exercise: the steel deck weighs w = 36,000 t / 2,460 m ≈ 14.6 t/m, about 143.6 kN/m. Before reaching a temporary tower, a 171 m cantilever without a nose has a root moment M₀ = w·L²/2 = 143.6×171²/2 ≈ 2.10×10⁶ kN·m. With a 40 m nose weighing 30 kN/m, only 131 m of deck cantilevers: M = 143.6×131²/2 + 30×40×(131 + 20) ≈ 1.232×10⁶ + 0.181×10⁶ ≈ 1.41×10⁶ kN·m, about 33% less. The 1,743 m south section weighs about 1,743×143.6 ≈ 250,000 kN; with sliding friction μ = 0.03 and gradient i = 3.025%, pushing uphill needs F ≈ W·(μ + i) ≈ 15,100 kN, while downhill W·(μ − i) ≈ 0, meaning the deck would run away by itself and needs braking and restraint. The comparison shows why a light nose and launching stays matter more than raw pushing capacity: the critical quantities are the root moment and the restraint of a deck that wants to slide downhill. Nose length, weight and friction are teaching assumptions, not Millau's actual design.

title: 厄勒海峽大橋
summary: 厄勒海峽大橋是連接丹麥與瑞典固定通道的橋梁段，全長約 7,845 公尺，主跨 490 公尺的斜張高橋與兩側 140 公尺跨的引橋都採用上層公路、下層鐵路的鋼—混凝土複合桁架。本課從海峽零阻水要求、雙層桁架與豎琴式斜索的荷載路徑出發，拆解石灰岩上的預鑄沉箱、204 公尺混凝土橋塔、Svanen 浮吊整跨吊裝與主跨合龍，再談鐵路制動力、船撞風險、疲勞防蝕與鋼軌伸縮調節器的交接。
summaryEn: The Øresund Bridge is the bridge section of the fixed link between Denmark and Sweden: about 7,845 m long, with a cable-stayed high bridge of 490 m main span and approach viaducts of 140 m spans, all built as steel–concrete composite trusses carrying a motorway above and a railway below. The course starts from the strait's zero-blocking requirement and the load path through double-deck trusses and harp stays, then covers precast caissons on limestone, the 204 m concrete pylons, full-span lifts by the floating crane Svanen and main-span closure, ending with rail braking, ship-impact risk, fatigue and corrosion, and the handover of rail expansion devices.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 豎琴式斜索設計練習：塔上錨距 12 m、梁上錨距 20 m，索角 θ = arctan(12/20) ≈ 31.0°，sinθ ≈ 0.514。若每個索面在每公尺承受 w = 200 kN/m，每根索支撐 20 m，索力 T = 200×20/0.514 ≈ 7,775 kN。單股 7 根 5 mm 鋼線面積約 137.4 mm²、f_pu = 1,860 MPa，以 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa 設計，需要 7,775,000/(837×137.4) ≈ 67.6，取 68 股，實際應力約 832 MPa。若 w 增加到 215 kN/m，T ≈ 8,358 kN，需約 72.7，取 73 股。活載使索力增加 15%（約 1,166 kN）時，200 m 長、68 股的索彈性伸長 ΔL = ΔT·L/(E·A) = 1,166,000×200/(195,000×9,346) ≈ 0.128 m，這是橋面撓度的一部分。數值為教學假設，不代表厄勒海峽大橋的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Harp-stay exercise: with anchor spacings of 12 m on the pylon and 20 m on the girder, θ = arctan(12/20) ≈ 31.0° and sinθ ≈ 0.514. If each cable plane carries w = 200 kN/m and each stay supports 20 m, T = 200×20/0.514 ≈ 7,775 kN. One strand of seven 5 mm wires has about 137.4 mm²; with f_pu = 1,860 MPa and design at 0.45 f_pu = 837 MPa, 7,775,000/(837×137.4) ≈ 67.6, so 68 strands at an actual stress of about 832 MPa. If w rises to 215 kN/m, T ≈ 8,358 kN and about 72.7, so 73 strands, are needed. When live load raises the force by 15% (about 1,166 kN), a 200 m, 68-strand stay stretches ΔL = ΔT·L/(E·A) = 1,166,000×200/(195,000×9,346) ≈ 0.128 m elastically, part of the deck deflection. Values are teaching assumptions, not the Øresund design.

title: 大貝爾特東橋
summary: 大貝爾特東橋以 1,624 m 主跨與 254 m 混凝土橋塔跨越丹麥大貝爾特海峽東航道，1998 年通車。本課從航道船舶撞擊模擬如何決定跨徑出發，說明封閉鋼箱梁的渦流鎖定與導流板、18,648 根鋼絲的空中紡線主纜、壓重錨碇、預製沉箱拖航與橋面吊裝，再到 2015 年完成的主纜除濕改造、營運中的船舶風險管理與 200 年壽命評估。
summaryEn: The Great Belt East Bridge crosses the East Channel of Denmark's Great Belt with a 1,624 m main span and 254 m concrete pylons, opening in 1998. The course starts from how ship-collision simulations set the span, then explains vortex lock-in and guide vanes on the closed steel box girder, air-spun cables of 18,648 wires, ballasted anchor blocks, towed caissons and deck lifting, and finally the cable dehumidification retrofit completed in 2015, ship-risk management in operation and the assessment of a 200-year service life.

workedExample.text: 設計練習：比較兩種主纜防蝕策略對 3 km 主纜的影響。主纜鋼絲 18,648 根、直徑 5.38 mm，鋼絲總面積 A ≈ 423,900 mm²。假設恆載與活載下每纜最大張力 T = 260 MN，鋼絲強度 1,570 MPa，破斷力 = 0.4239×1,570 ≈ 666 MN，安全係數 = 666/260 ≈ 2.56。若腐蝕使有效鋼絲面積損失 5%，係數降為 2.56×0.95 ≈ 2.43；損失 10% 時約 2.30。若規定最低安全係數 2.2，可容許的面積損失約 1 − 2.2/2.56 ≈ 14%。除濕把纜內相對濕度維持在腐蝕門檻以下，目的是讓面積損失長期接近零，而不是等損失接近 14% 才介入。數值為教學假設，不代表大貝爾特東橋的設計或檢測結果。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare two corrosion-protection strategies for a 3 km cable. The cable has 18,648 wires of 5.38 mm, a total steel area A ≈ 423,900 mm². Assume a maximum tension per cable under dead and live load of T = 260 MN and wire strength 1,570 MPa: breaking force = 0.4239×1,570 ≈ 666 MN and the safety factor = 666/260 ≈ 2.56. If corrosion removes 5% of the effective wire area the factor falls to 2.56×0.95 ≈ 2.43; at 10% it is about 2.30. With a minimum required factor of 2.2 the tolerable area loss is about 1 − 2.2/2.56 ≈ 14%. Dehumidification keeps internal humidity below the corrosion threshold so that area loss stays near zero for the long term, rather than waiting until loss approaches 14% before acting. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design or inspection results of the Great Belt East Bridge.

title: 青馬大橋
summary: 青馬大橋主跨 1,377 m，1997 年通車，上層六線公路、下層兩條鐵路軌道與兩條有遮蔽的車道，是承載鐵路的最長跨徑懸索橋。本課從鐵路對橋面坡度與變位的要求、颱風下的行車安全出發，計算空中紡線主纜的主跨與邊跨鋼絲數差異，說明滑模混凝土塔、96 個橋面模組吊裝、伸縮縫與軌道銜接，再以香港路政署的風與結構健康監測系統（WASHMS）、交通量與水上淨空管制，說明營運維護。
summaryEn: Tsing Ma Bridge has a 1,377 m main span and opened in 1997, carrying six road lanes above and two rail tracks plus two sheltered carriageways below, the longest-span suspension bridge carrying rail. The course starts from rail demands on deck gradient and deflection and from vehicle safety in typhoons, derives the difference in wire count between main and side spans of the air-spun cables, explains slipformed concrete towers, lifting 96 deck modules, expansion joints and track continuity, then uses the Highways Department's Wind and Structural Health Monitoring System (WASHMS), traffic data and marine air-draft control to explain operation and maintenance.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算青馬大橋型懸索橋在公路與鐵路同時加載時的主纜張力增量。假設主跨 l = 1,377 m、垂跨比 1/11（f ≈ 125.2 m），每條主纜主跨鋼絲面積 A ≈ 0.759 m²。公路六車道各 20 kN/m 的 30% 同時作用（36 kN/m），加上兩軌列車各 60 kN/m 的 50%（60 kN/m），總活載 96 kN/m，每纜 48 kN/m。張力增量 ΔH = Δw·l²/(8f) = 48×1,377²/(8×125.2) ≈ 90,900 kN ≈ 91 MN，鋼絲應力增量 ≈ 91/0.759 ≈ 120 N/mm²。若列車改為兩軌全滿（120 kN/m），每纜活載 78 kN/m，ΔH ≈ 148 MN、應力增量約 195 N/mm²，顯示鐵路荷載假設對主纜應力幅與疲勞評估的影響。數值為教學假設，不代表青馬大橋的設計計算。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the main-cable tension increase on a Tsing Ma type suspension bridge under combined road and rail loading. Assume main span l = 1,377 m, sag ratio 1/11 (f ≈ 125.2 m) and main-span wire area per cable A ≈ 0.759 m². Take 30% of 20 kN/m on each of six road lanes acting together (36 kN/m) plus 50% of 60 kN/m on each of two tracks (60 kN/m), a total live load of 96 kN/m, or 48 kN/m per cable. The tension increase ΔH = Δw·l²/(8f) = 48×1,377²/(8×125.2) ≈ 90,900 kN ≈ 91 MN, a wire stress increase of about 91/0.759 ≈ 120 N/mm². With both tracks fully loaded (120 kN/m) the live load per cable becomes 78 kN/m, ΔH ≈ 148 MN and the stress increase about 195 N/mm², showing how rail-load assumptions drive cable stress range and fatigue assessment. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design calculations of Tsing Ma Bridge.

title: 昂船洲大橋
summary: 昂船洲大橋以 1,018 m 主跨橫越香港藍巴勒海峽，主跨為中央開槽的流線形雙鋼箱梁，背跨為預力混凝土雙箱梁，兩座單柱塔下段為混凝土、上段為雙相不鏽鋼外皮的鋼—混凝土複合結構。本課從颱風風荷載、塔梁液壓緩衝器、224 根斜拉索、鋼箱梁吊裝與鋼混接頭，一路到雷諾數效應的風洞試驗、跨中撓度監測與長索維護。
summaryEn: Stonecutters Bridge crosses Hong Kong’s Rambler Channel with a 1,018 m main span of streamlined twin steel boxes separated by a central gap, prestressed concrete twin-box back spans and two monopole towers whose lower parts are concrete and upper parts steel–concrete composite with a duplex stainless skin. The course runs from typhoon wind load, tower–deck hydraulic buffers, the 224 stays, deck-segment lifting and the steel–concrete junction to Reynolds-number effects in wind testing, mid-span deflection monitoring and long-stay maintenance.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算颱風時主跨跨中的側向變形量級。取橋面側風荷載 w = 4.9 kN/m（U = 50 m/s、C_D = 0.8、D = 4 m），主跨 L = 1,018 m。若把主跨視為兩端由塔約束、中間由斜索提供有限側向勁度的梁，以簡支梁上限估計 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI)：取兩箱合計側向 EI = 2.0×10¹⁰ kN·m²，L⁴ = 1,018⁴ ≈ 1.074×10¹²，δ = 5×4.9×1.074×10¹²/(384×2.0×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.63×10¹³/7.68×10¹² ≈ 3.4 m。公開資料中風荷載跨中撓度約 2.2 m，比簡支上限小，表示斜索的擺錘效應與塔的約束分擔了約 35% 的側向變形（1 − 2.2/3.4 ≈ 0.35）。若風速降為 40 m/s，w 與 δ 都乘以 (40/50)² = 0.64。EI 與係數為教學假設，非本橋設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the order of mid-span lateral movement in a typhoon. Take a side wind load w = 4.9 kN/m (U = 50 m/s, C_D = 0.8, D = 4 m) on the L = 1,018 m main span. Treating the main span as a beam restrained by the towers with limited lateral stiffness from the stays, an upper bound from a simply supported beam is δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI); with a combined lateral EI of 2.0×10¹⁰ kN·m² for the two boxes and L⁴ = 1,018⁴ ≈ 1.074×10¹², δ = 5×4.9×1.074×10¹²/(384×2.0×10¹⁰) ≈ 2.63×10¹³/7.68×10¹² ≈ 3.4 m. The published wind deflection of about 2.2 m is smaller, implying that the pendulum action of the stays and tower restraint remove about 35% of the lateral movement (1 − 2.2/3.4 ≈ 0.35). At 40 m/s both w and δ scale by (40/50)² = 0.64. EI and coefficients are teaching assumptions, not design values for this bridge.

title: 蘇通長江公路大橋
summary: 蘇通長江公路大橋以 1,088 m 主跨跨越寬約 6 km 的長江口，主橋孔跨為 (100+100+300)+1,088+(300+100+100) m，倒 Y 形混凝土塔高 300.4 m，鋼箱梁含風嘴寬約 41 m，最長斜索約 577 m。本課從縱向阻尼限位體系、高空風剖面、每塔 131 根鑽孔摩擦樁、鋼錨箱錨固區出發，經施工平台與節段同步提升，到氣彈模型、沖刷監測、塔柱徐變與長索多模態振動。
summaryEn: Sutong Yangtze River Bridge spans the roughly 6 km wide Yangtze estuary with a 1,088 m main span in a (100+100+300)+1,088+(300+100+100) m arrangement, 300.4 m inverted-Y concrete towers, a steel box deck about 41 m wide including fairings and stays up to about 577 m long. The course runs from the longitudinal damper–limiter system, wind profiles at height, the 131 bored friction piles per tower and steel anchor boxes, through work platforms and synchronised segment lifting, to aeroelastic testing, scour monitoring, tower creep and multi-mode vibration of long stays.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算塔頂在風荷載下的附加彎矩。取塔上段迎風寬 b = 10 m，以單元 2 的指數律求 z = 300 m 時 U ≈ 57.2 m/s，q = ½ρU² = 0.5×1.225×57.2² ≈ 2,004 Pa；取阻力係數 C_D = 1.3，每公尺風力 w = 2,004×1.3×10 ≈ 26.1 kN/m。若塔上 100 m 平均承受此風力、合力作用於塔頂以下 50 m，對 200 m 高程處的彎矩 M = 26.1×100×50 ≈ 130,300 kN·m。若改用橋面高度 70 m 的風速 48.0 m/s，q ≈ 1,411 Pa，w ≈ 18.3 kN/m，M ≈ 91,700 kN·m，低估約 30%（1 − 91,700/130,300 ≈ 0.30）。若塔寬改為 8 m，兩者都乘以 0.8。數值為教學假設，不代表蘇通大橋的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the extra moment from wind on the upper tower. Take an upper-tower width b = 10 m; from the unit 2 power law U ≈ 57.2 m/s at z = 300 m, so q = ½ρU² = 0.5×1.225×57.2² ≈ 2,004 Pa; with C_D = 1.3 the force per metre is w = 2,004×1.3×10 ≈ 26.1 kN/m. If the top 100 m of tower carries this on average with the resultant 50 m below the top, the moment at the 200 m level is M = 26.1×100×50 ≈ 130,300 kN·m. Using the deck-level speed of 48.0 m/s at 70 m instead gives q ≈ 1,411 Pa, w ≈ 18.3 kN/m and M ≈ 91,700 kN·m, an underestimate of about 30% (1 − 91,700/130,300 ≈ 0.30). If the tower width becomes 8 m, both scale by 0.8. Values are teaching assumptions, not the Sutong design.

title: 港珠澳大橋橋梁段
summary: 港珠澳大橋主體工程以約 22.9 公里橋梁、6.7 公里沉管隧道與兩座人工島跨越伶仃洋，設計壽命 120 年。本課聚焦橋梁段：青州、江海直達船與九洲三座通航孔斜張橋，以及以鋼箱梁和鋼—混凝土組合梁構成的非通航孔連續梁；從颱風與地震設計基準、大節段鋼箱梁與組合梁、整體吊裝與颱風季的工法變更，到風洞試驗、製造檢驗、防腐與三地共管的監測交接。
summaryEn: The main works of the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge cross the Lingdingyang with about 22.9 km of bridge, a 6.7 km immersed tunnel and two artificial islands, designed for 120 years. This course focuses on the bridge works: the Qingzhou, Jianghai and Jiuzhou navigation-channel cable-stayed bridges and the non-navigable continuous spans of steel box and steel–concrete composite girders, moving from the typhoon and earthquake design basis, large steel box segments and composite girders, single-piece lifts and a typhoon-season method change, to wind-tunnel testing, fabrication inspection, corrosion protection and monitoring handover under joint tri-party management.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 非通航孔鋼箱梁設計練習：某 110 m 跨連續鋼箱梁以大節段吊裝，節段重 3,000 t、長 130 m，自重 w = 3,000/130×9.81 ≈ 226 kN/m。連續梁中間支點負彎矩近似 M = w·L²/10 = 226×110²/10 ≈ 2.74×10⁵ kN·m。若梁高 h = 4.5 m，上翼板拉力 F = M/h ≈ 60,900 kN；頂板寬 33 m、頂板加 U 肋的等效厚度 28 mm，面積 A = 33×0.028 = 0.924 m²，整體應力 σ = 60,900/0.924 ≈ 65.9 MPa，遠低於鋼材降伏。但同一頂板在輪載下的局部彎曲應力幅可能達數十 MPa，循環次數以億計，因此頂板厚度與 U 肋焊縫通常由疲勞而非整體強度控制。若頂板由 14 mm 加厚到 18 mm，局部應力約降為 0.605 倍，疲勞壽命約提高 4.5 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表港珠澳大橋的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Viaduct box-girder exercise: a 110 m continuous steel box span is lifted in large segments of 3,000 t and 130 m, so self-weight is w = 3,000/130×9.81 ≈ 226 kN/m. The hogging moment over an interior support is roughly M = w·L²/10 = 226×110²/10 ≈ 2.74×10⁵ kN·m. With depth h = 4.5 m, the top flange tension is F = M/h ≈ 60,900 kN; a 33 m wide top plate with ribs smeared to 28 mm gives A = 33×0.028 = 0.924 m² and a global stress σ = 60,900/0.924 ≈ 65.9 MPa, far below yield. Yet the same plate sees local wheel-bending stress ranges of tens of MPa over hundreds of millions of cycles, so plate thickness and rib welds are usually governed by fatigue rather than global strength. Thickening the plate from 14 mm to 18 mm cuts local stress to about 0.605 times and raises fatigue life about 4.5 times. Values are teaching assumptions, not the HZMB design.

title: 里翁—安提里翁大橋
summary: 里翁—安提里翁大橋以 286+3×560+286 m 共 2,252 m 的連續全懸吊橋面跨越希臘科林斯灣口，四座塔立在直徑 90 m、坐於 3 m 礫石層上的基礎，下方以 2 m 鋼管插入物加勁軟弱海床。本課從 0.48 g 地震與 2 m 斷層位移、熔斷限制器與黏滯阻尼器、加勁土壤與沉箱浮運，到張力腿駁船的海床整備、平衡懸臂架設、WEASHM 監測、雷擊斷索與混凝土耐久。
summaryEn: The Rion–Antirion Bridge crosses the mouth of the Gulf of Corinth with a 2,252 m continuous fully suspended deck of 286+3×560+286 m; its four pylons stand on 90 m diameter footings resting on a 3 m gravel layer above soft seabed reinforced with 2 m steel-pipe inclusions. The course runs from 0.48 g shaking and 2 m fault movement, fuse restrainers and viscous dampers, reinforced soil and floating caissons, to seabed preparation from a tension-leg barge, balanced-cantilever erection, the WEASHM monitoring system, the lightning-caused stay failure and concrete durability.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：比較一座 90 m 基礎在地震中「不滑移」與「可滑移」時傳到上部結構的水平力。設基礎與塔座、墩身的有效質量 M = 80,000 t，若完全固定，以譜加速度 1.2 g 估算慣性力 F = M·S_a = 80,000×1.2×9.81 ≈ 941,800 kN。若基礎坐在礫石層上、摩擦係數 μ = tan35° ≈ 0.70、有效垂直力 N = 600,000 kN（扣除浮力），滑移前最大水平力 H = μ·N ≈ 420,000 kN，只有固定時的 420,000/941,800 ≈ 45%。代價是滑移位移：若地震造成 0.5 m 永久滑移，需確認伸縮縫與阻尼器的位移預算仍足夠（主墩阻尼器行程 −1,650 至 +1,850 mm）。若礫石摩擦角改為 30°（tan30° ≈ 0.577），H ≈ 346,400 kN，力量更低但滑移量會增加。質量、垂直力與摩擦角為教學假設，非本橋設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare the horizontal force passed to the superstructure by a 90 m footing that cannot slide with one that can. Take an effective mass of footing, base and shaft M = 80,000 t; if fully fixed, a spectral acceleration of 1.2 g gives an inertia force F = M·S_a = 80,000×1.2×9.81 ≈ 941,800 kN. If the footing rests on gravel with friction coefficient μ = tan35° ≈ 0.70 and effective vertical force N = 600,000 kN after buoyancy, the largest horizontal force before sliding is H = μ·N ≈ 420,000 kN, only 420,000/941,800 ≈ 45% of the fixed case. The price is sliding displacement: if the earthquake leaves 0.5 m of permanent slip, the displacement budget of joints and dampers must still suffice (main-pier damper stroke −1,650 to +1,850 mm). With a 30° gravel friction angle (tan30° ≈ 0.577), H ≈ 346,400 kN, a lower force but more sliding. Mass, vertical force and friction angle are teaching assumptions, not design values for this bridge.

title: 諾曼第大橋
summary: 諾曼第大橋 1995 年通車時以 856 m 主跨創下斜張橋紀錄：主跨中央 624 m 為正交異性鋼箱梁，兩端各 116 m 與背跨為預力混凝土，184 根鋼絞線斜索掛在兩座約 214 m 高的倒 Y 形混凝土塔上。本課從混合主梁的重量配置、倒 Y 形塔的抗扭貢獻、斜索與樁基，經混凝土平衡懸臂與鋼節段吊裝，到現地風量測、長索振動與阻尼器加裝、斜索多層防腐與單股更換。
summaryEn: When it opened in 1995 the Pont de Normandie set the cable-stayed span record at 856 m: the central 624 m of the main span is an orthotropic steel box, while 116 m at each end and the back spans are prestressed concrete, and 184 strand stays hang from two inverted-Y concrete pylons about 214 m tall. The course runs from the weight layout of the hybrid deck, the torsional contribution of the inverted-Y pylons, stays and piles, through concrete balanced cantilevers and steel-segment lifting, to on-site wind measurement, long-stay vibration and retrofitted dampers, multi-layer stay corrosion protection and single-strand replacement.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算鋼與混凝土兩種中央段方案對單根長索的影響。設主跨中央某根長索負擔 19.65 m 的節段，鋼橋面 10 t/m 時恆載 W = 19.65×10 ≈ 197 t（約 1,930 kN）；若改為 40 t/m 的混凝土，W = 786 t（約 7,710 kN）。斜索與水平夾角 θ = 25°，sin25° ≈ 0.423，鋼方案索力 T = 1,930/0.423 ≈ 4,560 kN，混凝土方案 T ≈ 7,710/0.423 ≈ 18,240 kN。以每股使用拉力 10 t（約 98 kN）計，鋼方案需約 4,560/98 ≈ 47 股，混凝土方案需約 186 股，超過 53 股的上限三倍以上。若夾角提高到 30°（sin30° = 0.5），鋼方案索力降為約 3,860 kN、約 40 股。數值為教學假設，未計活載與動力效應。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare the effect of steel and concrete central zones on one long stay. Suppose a long stay near mid-span supports a 19.65 m segment; at 10 t/m for a steel deck the dead load is W = 19.65×10 ≈ 197 t (about 1,930 kN), while a 40 t/m concrete deck gives W = 786 t (about 7,710 kN). At θ = 25° to the horizontal, sin25° ≈ 0.423, so the steel option needs T = 1,930/0.423 ≈ 4,560 kN and the concrete option T ≈ 7,710/0.423 ≈ 18,240 kN. At a service tension of 10 t (about 98 kN) per strand, the steel option needs about 4,560/98 ≈ 47 strands and the concrete option about 186, more than three times the 53-strand maximum. Raising the angle to 30° (sin30° = 0.5) lowers the steel option to about 3,860 kN, about 40 strands. Values are teaching assumptions excluding live load and dynamic effects.

title: 聯邦大橋（加拿大）
summary: 聯邦大橋連接愛德華王子島與新布倫瑞克省，全長約 12.9 公里，是跨越冬季結冰海域最長的橋梁，主橋段以約 250 公尺的跨徑排列，設計壽命 100 年。本課從浮冰荷載與冰盾錐體出發，拆解主梁懸臂與掛梁組成的預製體系、高性能混凝土與墩身接合，再看陸上預製場、浮吊 Svanen 與高峰期每週一跨的安裝節奏，最後談冰力監測、強風管制、除冰鹽與凍融，以及 2032 年特許營運結束時的交接。
summaryEn: Confederation Bridge links Prince Edward Island and New Brunswick over about 12.9 km, the longest bridge over ice-covered water, with main spans of about 250 m and a 100-year design life. Starting from pack-ice loads and the ice-shield cones, the course unpacks the precast system of cantilevered main girders and drop-in spans, high-performance concrete and pier joints, then the land casting yard, the floating crane Svanen and a peak rate of one span a week, ending with ice-force monitoring, wind restrictions, de-icing salt and freeze–thaw, and the handover when the concession ends in 2032.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 冰盾設計練習：某主墩水線寬 D = 14 m，設計冰厚 h = 0.6 m。垂直面壓碎力 F_c = σ_c·h·D = 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN；錐面彎曲破壞力 F_b = k·σ_f·h² = 10×0.7×0.6² ≈ 2.52 MN。冰力作用點到墩座接合面的力臂取 25 m，彎矩分別為 16.8×25 = 420 MN·m 與 2.52×25 = 63 MN·m。接合面面積 A = 40 m²、斷面模數 S = 60 m³，彎曲應力分別為 420/60 = 7.0 MPa 與 63/60 = 1.05 MPa。若上方主梁重 7,500 t（約 73.6 MN），平均壓應力 73.6/40 ≈ 1.84 MPa：錐面情況下 1.84 > 1.05，接合面不會張開；垂直面情況下需再增加約 (7.0 − 1.84)×40 ≈ 206 MN 的預力才能保持全斷面受壓。結論是冰盾錐體大幅減少了墩身與接合面所需的預力。數值為教學假設，不代表聯邦大橋的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Ice-shield exercise: a main pier is D = 14 m wide at the waterline with design ice thickness h = 0.6 m. Crushing on a vertical face gives F_c = σ_c·h·D = 2.0×0.6×14 = 16.8 MN; bending failure on a cone gives F_b = k·σ_f·h² = 10×0.7×0.6² ≈ 2.52 MN. With a 25 m lever arm to the base joint, the moments are 16.8×25 = 420 MN·m and 2.52×25 = 63 MN·m. For a joint area A = 40 m² and section modulus S = 60 m³, the bending stresses are 420/60 = 7.0 MPa and 63/60 = 1.05 MPa. A 7,500 t girder above (about 73.6 MN) gives an average compression of 73.6/40 ≈ 1.84 MPa: with the cone, 1.84 > 1.05 and the joint stays closed; with a vertical face about (7.0 − 1.84)×40 ≈ 206 MN of extra prestress would be needed to keep the section in compression. The cone therefore greatly reduces the prestress demand on shaft and joint. Values are teaching assumptions, not the Confederation Bridge design.

title: 雪梨港灣大橋
summary: 雪梨港灣大橋是跨度 503 公尺的雙鉸鋼拱橋，拱頂高出水面 134 公尺，橋面同時承載公路、鐵路、自行車道與人行道，1932 年通車。本課從雙鉸拱的推力與荷載路徑出發，分析桁架深度變化、鉚接與支承銷，再拆解兩岸以 128 條隧道錨碇鋼索支撐半拱懸臂架設、1930 年拱頂合龍與 1932 年 96 輛機車的載重試驗，最後談鉚接細節的疲勞評估、大面積塗裝維護，以及作為工程遺產的修繕與交接。
summaryEn: Sydney Harbour Bridge is a two-hinged steel arch spanning 503 m, its crown 134 m above the water, carrying road, rail, cycleway and footway since 1932. workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 拱橋推力與溫度練習：取跨度 L = 503 m、拱矢 f = 120 m、總荷載 w = 700 kN/m。拋物線拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f) = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN，每側垂直反力 V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN；每側兩片桁架分擔，單一支承合力 ≈ √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN。若拱矢減為 110 m，H 升到約 201,300 kN，增加約 9%，說明矢跨比對推力很敏感。溫度方面，拋物線拱弧長 s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 503 + 8×120²/(3×503) ≈ 579.3 m；升溫 30 °C 時弧長增加 Δs = 1.2×10⁻⁵×579.3×30 ≈ 0.209 m，跨度固定時拱矢增加 Δf ≈ 3L·Δs/(16f) = 3×503×0.209/(16×120) ≈ 0.164 m，與公開資料所說熱天拱頂升高約 18 公分同量級。數值為教學假設，不代表雪梨港灣大橋的設計計算。
workedExample.textEn: Arch thrust and temperature exercise: take span L = 503 m, rise f = 120 m and total load w = 700 kN/m. A parabolic arch has thrust H = w·L²/(8f) = 700×503²/(8×120) ≈ 184,500 kN and vertical reaction per side V = w·L/2 ≈ 176,000 kN; with two trusses per side, one bearing's resultant is about √(88,000² + 92,200²) ≈ 127,500 kN. Reducing the rise to 110 m raises H to about 201,300 kN, about 9% more, showing how sensitive thrust is to the rise-to-span ratio. For temperature, the parabolic arc length is s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 503 + 8×120²/(3×503) ≈ 579.3 m; a 30 °C rise lengthens it by Δs = 1.2×10⁻⁵×579.3×30 ≈ 0.209 m, and with the span fixed the rise grows by Δf ≈ 3L·Δs/(16f) = 3×503×0.209/(16×120) ≈ 0.164 m, the same order as the roughly 18 cm crown rise on hot days cited publicly. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design calculations of the bridge.

title: 新河峽大橋
summary: 新河峽大橋位於美國西維吉尼亞州，主拱跨度 1,700 英尺（約 518 公尺），全長 3,030 英尺（約 924 公尺），橋面高出新河約 876 英尺（約 267 公尺），1977 年通車，以免塗裝的 COR-TEN 耐候鋼建造。本課從兩鉸桁架拱與峽谷地形出發，分析排架立柱、上承式桁架、焊接箱形弦桿與低溫韌性，再拆解跨越峽谷的纜索吊運、以油井套管作背拉索的懸臂架設與 1976 年以 16 具千斤頂完成的合龍，最後談線形量測、載重評等、耐候鋼維護與橋梁日活動的管理。
summaryEn: New River Gorge Bridge in West Virginia has a 1,700 ft (about 518 m) arch, a total length of 3,030 ft (about 924 m) and a deck about 876 ft (about 267 m) above the New River; it opened in 1977, built of unpainted COR-TEN weathering steel. Starting from the two-hinged truss arch and the gorge, the course examines spandrel bents, deck trusses, welded box chords and low-temperature toughness, then the cableway across the gorge, cantilever erection held by oil-well-casing tiebacks and the 1976 closure with 16 hydraulic jacks, ending with geometry surveys, load rating, care of weathering steel and managing Bridge Day.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 合龍千斤頂練習：假設合龍前每個半拱重 W = 4,000 t（約 39.2 MN），重心距拱腳鉸 110 m，背拉索對鉸的力臂 60 m，所需背拉力 T = W·x/h = 39.2×110/60 ≈ 71.9 MN。每側 8 具 1,250 短噸千斤頂，能力約 8×1,250×0.907×9.81 ≈ 89 MN，利用率約 81%。下放時放出背拉索 Δc = 0.15 m，半拱轉角 θ = 0.15/60 = 2.5 mrad；拱頂端點距鉸高約 112.8 m、水平約 259 m，端點向中央移動約 2.5×10⁻³×112.8 ≈ 0.28 m，下降約 2.5×10⁻³×259 ≈ 0.65 m。半拱弧長約 292 m，溫度變化 10 °C 使長度變化約 292×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 35 mm，所以最後幾公分的對位必須在溫度穩定時完成。數值為教學假設，不代表新河峽大橋的實際設計或施工數據。
workedExample.textEn: Closure-jack exercise: assume each half-arch weighs W = 4,000 t (about 39.2 MN) before closure, with its centroid 110 m from the arch-foot hinge and a 60 m tieback lever arm about the hinge, so the required tieback force is T = W·x/h = 39.2×110/60 ≈ 71.9 MN. Eight 1,250 short-ton jacks per side give about 8×1,250×0.907×9.81 ≈ 89 MN, a utilisation of about 81%. Paying out Δc = 0.15 m of tieback rotates the half-arch by θ = 0.15/60 = 2.5 mrad; with the tip about 112.8 m above and about 259 m horizontally from the hinge, it moves about 2.5×10⁻³×112.8 ≈ 0.28 m toward mid-span and drops about 2.5×10⁻³×259 ≈ 0.65 m. A half-arch about 292 m long changes length by about 292×1.2×10⁻⁵×10 ≈ 35 mm for 10 °C, so the last few centimetres of alignment must be made when temperature is stable. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual design or erection data of the bridge.

title: 皇后渡口大橋
summary: 皇后渡口大橋含引橋全長約 2.7 km，三座約 207 m 高的單柱塔支承 221+650+650+221 m 的斜張橋段，通車時為全球最長的三塔斜張橋，也是規模最大、斜索在跨中交叉的斜張橋。本課從中塔缺乏背索錨固的問題、交叉索的勁度、鋼—混凝土組合橋面與塔基沉箱，經平衡懸臂吊裝與兩處合龍，到防風屏障與車輛穩定、約 2,000 個感測器的監測、積冰掉落與營運檢查交接。
summaryEn: The Queensferry Crossing is about 2.7 km long including approaches; three monopole towers about 207 m tall carry a 221+650+650+221 m cable-stayed section, making it, at opening, the world’s longest three-tower cable-stayed bridge and the largest with stays that cross at mid-span. The course runs from the central tower’s lack of back-stay anchorage, the stiffness of crossing stays, the composite steel–concrete deck and tower caissons, through balanced-cantilever lifting and two closures, to wind shielding and vehicle stability, monitoring with about 2,000 sensors, falling ice and operational inspection handover.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：比較三塔斜張橋在單跨加載時，以交叉索或加粗中塔兩種方式控制中塔頂位移。設單跨活載造成中塔頂不平衡水平力 H = 30 MN，目標位移 δ ≤ 0.5 m，所需總勁度 k = H/δ = 60 MN/m。方案 A：塔本身勁度 20 MN/m，另以交叉索補足 40 MN/m；若每根交叉索有效水平勁度約 4.8×0.5 = 2.4 MN/m，需約 40/2.4 ≈ 17 根。方案 B：完全靠塔，懸臂塔頂勁度 k = 3EI/h³，取 h = 200 m、E = 35 GPa，所需 I = k·h³/(3E) = 60,000 kN/m×8.0×10⁶ m³/(3×3.5×10⁷ kN/m²) ≈ 4,570 m⁴，約為 20 MN/m 對應 I ≈ 1,520 m⁴ 的三倍，塔斷面將大幅加粗。若目標放寬到 δ ≤ 0.75 m，所需 k = 40 MN/m，交叉索只需約 20/2.4 ≈ 9 根。數值為教學假設，非本橋設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare crossing stays with a stiffer central tower for controlling central-tower displacement under one-span loading. Live load on one span applies H = 30 MN at the central tower head; for δ ≤ 0.5 m the required stiffness is k = H/δ = 60 MN/m. Option A: the tower supplies 20 MN/m and crossing stays add 40 MN/m; at about 4.8×0.5 = 2.4 MN/m effective horizontal stiffness per crossing stay, about 40/2.4 ≈ 17 stays are needed. Option B: the tower alone, with cantilever head stiffness k = 3EI/h³; with h = 200 m and E = 35 GPa, the required I = k·h³/(3E) = 60,000 kN/m×8.0×10⁶ m³/(3×3.5×10⁷ kN/m²) ≈ 4,570 m⁴, three times the I ≈ 1,520 m⁴ that gives 20 MN/m, so the tower section grows greatly. Relaxing the target to δ ≤ 0.75 m needs k = 40 MN/m, and only about 20/2.4 ≈ 9 crossing stays. Values are teaching assumptions, not this bridge’s design.

title: 伊拉斯謨大橋
summary: 鹿特丹的伊拉斯謨大橋全長 802 m，以 139 m 高、彎折不對稱的鋼塔支承約 284 m 的斜張主跨，南端另有 89 m 的開合橋；橋面寬 33.8 m，由兩根箱形主梁與每 4.9 m 一道的橫梁組成，承載車道、電車軌道與人行自行車道。本課從背索如何降低塔的彎矩、橋面橫向受力、鋼塔焊接、開合橋配重與電車軌伸縮，到 1996 年通車後的雨風振動觀測、調諧液壓阻尼器、塗裝與開合機械的長期維護。
summaryEn: Rotterdam’s Erasmus Bridge is 802 m long; a bent, asymmetric 139 m steel pylon carries a cable-stayed main span of about 284 m, and an 89 m bascule sits at the south end. The 33.8 m deck, two box spines with cross beams every 4.9 m, carries traffic lanes, tram tracks, footpaths and cycle tracks. The course runs from how back stays cut pylon bending, transverse deck action, pylon welding, bascule counterweighting and tram-rail expansion, to observation of rain–wind vibration after the 1996 opening, tuned hydraulic dampers and long-term care of coatings and bascule machinery.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算加裝阻尼器後，雨風振動中斜索振幅的變化量級。設某主跨斜索 T = 3,000 kN、m = 60 kg/m、L = 250 m，第一頻率 f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m) = (1/500)×√(50,000) ≈ 0.447 Hz。原始阻尼比 ζ₀ = 0.2%，在某風雨條件下每週期輸入的能量使振幅穩定在 A₀ = 0.30 m。若氣動輸入近似為負阻尼 ζ_a = −0.15%，淨阻尼 0.05% 時振幅受非線性限制停在 0.30 m；加裝 x_d/L = 0.02 的最佳阻尼器後，附加阻尼約 1.0%，淨阻尼 ζ = 0.2% + 1.0% − 0.15% = 1.05% 為正，振動不再成長而衰減。以對數遞減 δ = 2πζ ≈ 0.066 計，振幅從 0.30 m 衰減到 0.03 m 需要 ln(10)/0.066 ≈ 35 個週期，以第 3 模態約 1.34 Hz 計約 26 秒。若阻尼器只能裝在 x_d/L = 0.01，附加阻尼約 0.5%，淨阻尼 0.55%，衰減到同樣振幅約需 67 個週期。數值為教學假設，不代表本橋實測。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate how damper retrofit changes stay amplitude under rain–wind excitation. A main-span stay has T = 3,000 kN, m = 60 kg/m and L = 250 m, so f₁ = (1/2L)·√(T/m) = (1/500)×√(50,000) ≈ 0.447 Hz. With inherent damping ζ₀ = 0.2%, a wind–rain condition feeds enough energy to hold amplitude at A₀ = 0.30 m. Treating the aerodynamic input as negative damping ζ_a = −0.15%, the small net value lets nonlinear effects cap the motion at 0.30 m; adding an optimal damper at x_d/L = 0.02 gives about 1.0% added damping, so net ζ = 0.2% + 1.0% − 0.15% = 1.05% is positive and motion decays instead of growing. With logarithmic decrement δ = 2πζ ≈ 0.066, decaying from 0.30 m to 0.03 m takes ln(10)/0.066 ≈ 35 cycles, about 26 seconds in mode 3 at about 1.34 Hz. If the damper can only sit at x_d/L = 0.01, added damping is about 0.5%, net 0.55%, and the same decay takes about 67 cycles. Values are teaching assumptions, not measurements on this bridge.

title: 瀨戶大橋橋群
summary: 瀨戶大橋是連接本州岡山與四國香川的六座橋梁，海峽段約 9.4 km，全部為上層公路、下層鐵路的雙層結構，1988 年 4 月 10 日同時通車。本課從如何沿海峽配置三座懸索橋、兩座斜張橋與一座桁架橋出發，說明南北備讚瀨戶大橋的三跨連續構造與索股交叉的共用錨碇、11 座設置沉箱與預壘骨材水中混凝土、起重船牽引導索與工廠全尺寸預組，最後談鍍鋅鋼絲防蝕、乾燥空氣與公路鐵路並存下的維護。
summaryEn: Seto Ohashi is a group of six bridges linking Okayama on Honshu with Kagawa on Shikoku across about 9.4 km of sea, all double-deck with road above and rail below, opened together on 10 April 1988. The course starts from how three suspension bridges, two cable-stayed bridges and a truss bridge were arranged along the strait, explains the three-span continuous Kita and Minami Bisan-Seto bridges and their shared anchorage where strands cross, eleven placed caissons with prepacked underwater concrete, crane-ship pilot ropes and full factory trial assembly, and ends with galvanised-wire protection, dry air and maintenance with road and rail side by side.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：比較南備讚瀨戶大橋型懸索橋在不同鋼絲直徑下的主纜狀態。主纜 271 股×127 根 = 34,417 根鋼絲，張力約 45,000 t（≈ 441 MN），主纜直徑 107 cm（毛面積 0.899 m²）。若鋼絲直徑 5.10 mm，單絲面積 20.4 mm²，總面積 ≈ 0.703 m²，應力 ≈ 441/0.703 ≈ 628 N/mm²，對 1,570 N/mm² 鋼絲的安全係數 ≈ 2.50，空隙率 ≈ 22%。若直徑為 5.00 mm，單絲 19.6 mm²、總面積 ≈ 0.676 m²，應力 ≈ 653 N/mm²、係數 ≈ 2.40，空隙率 ≈ 25%；若為 5.20 mm，總面積 ≈ 0.731 m²、係數 ≈ 2.60、空隙率 ≈ 19%。可見「約 5 mm」的 0.1 mm 差異就會改變安全係數約 4% 與空隙率約 3 個百分點。除公開的股數、直徑與張力外，數值為教學假設，不代表瀨戶大橋的設計計算。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare the cable state of a Minami Bisan-Seto type suspension bridge for different wire diameters. The cable has 271 strands × 127 wires = 34,417 wires, a tension of about 45,000 t (≈ 441 MN) and a diameter of 107 cm (gross area 0.899 m²). With 5.10 mm wire, each wire is 20.4 mm², the total area ≈ 0.703 m², the stress ≈ 441/0.703 ≈ 628 N/mm², the safety factor on 1,570 N/mm² wire ≈ 2.50 and the void ratio ≈ 22%. With 5.00 mm wire, each is 19.6 mm², the total ≈ 0.676 m², the stress ≈ 653 N/mm², the factor ≈ 2.40 and voids ≈ 25%; with 5.20 mm, the total ≈ 0.731 m², the factor ≈ 2.60 and voids ≈ 19%. A 0.1 mm difference within ‘about 5 mm’ changes the safety factor by about 4% and the void ratio by about 3 points. Apart from the published strand count, diameter and tension, values are teaching assumptions, not Seto Ohashi design calculations.

title: 哈里發塔
summary: 從 Y 形扶壁核心的傳力與各向同性勁度、螺旋退縮與風洞定向出發，計算 C80 牆體在徐變下的鋼筋分擔、3.7 m 筏基與摩擦樁的承載，再處理自爬模核心先行、約 600 m 的混凝土泵送、GPS 垂直度控制、應變監測分解，最後是鹽水地層的基礎耐久與外牆維護系統的交接。
summaryEn: Starting from the load path and direction-independent stiffness of the Y-shaped buttressed core and from spiralling setbacks and wind-tunnel orientation, compute creep-driven load sharing in C80 walls and the capacity of the 3.7 m raft and friction piles, then handle core-first self-climbing formwork, pumping concrete to about 600 m, GPS verticality control and strain decomposition, ending with foundation durability in saline ground and the handover of the façade access system.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 垂直縮短補償練習：某核心牆長期軸壓 15 MPa，C80 混凝土 E_c = 43.8 GPa。彈性應變 15/43,800 ≈ 342 με；徐變係數取 1.2，徐變應變約 411 με；乾縮取 200 με，總應變約 953 με。牆高 400 m 時總縮短約 953×10⁻⁶×400,000 ≈ 381 mm，平均每 3.5 m 樓層約 3.3 mm，因此每層模板標高可預加約 3 mm，並在施工中依量測修正。若改用 E_c = 36 GPa 的較低強度混凝土，彈性應變約 417 με、總應變約 1,117 με，總縮短增為約 447 mm，每層約 3.9 mm。周邊柱若應力較高、縮短較多，牆柱之間的差異縮短會使樓板傾斜，必須分別補償。數值為教學假設，不代表哈里發塔的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Vertical shortening compensation: a core wall carries 15 MPa sustained stress in C80 concrete with E_c = 43.8 GPa. The elastic strain is 15/43,800 ≈ 342 με; with a creep coefficient of 1.2 the creep strain is about 411 με, and shrinkage of 200 με brings the total to about 953 με. Over 400 m of wall this is about 953×10⁻⁶×400,000 ≈ 381 mm of shortening, or about 3.3 mm per 3.5 m storey, so each floor's formwork level can be raised by about 3 mm and corrected from measurements during construction. With a lower-strength concrete of E_c = 36 GPa the elastic strain is about 417 με, the total about 1,117 με and the shortening rises to about 447 mm, about 3.9 mm per storey. If perimeter columns are more highly stressed and shorten more, the differential shortening between walls and columns tilts the slabs and must be compensated separately. Values are teaching assumptions, not Burj Khalifa's design values.

title: 上海中心大廈
summary: 從 120° 扭轉外形帶來的 24% 風載折減與上海軟土的長週期地震需求出發，計算 C70 巨柱的軸壓比與雙層外伸桁架的斜桿力，再處理圓形地下連續壁與 6 m 筏基的一次澆置、鋼平台爬模與超高泵送、後注漿長樁驗證、性能設計的層間變位檢核，最後是懸掛式外層帷幕與超高速電梯鋼索在營運期的維護。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 外形與巨柱連動練習：某超高層矩形對照方案的基底彎矩 M₀ = 30 GN·m，扭轉外形使風載折減 24%，M = 22.8 GN·m。外伸臂把 60% 傾覆彎矩交給巨柱，受拉與受壓側巨柱群力臂 50 m、每側 3 支巨柱：未扭轉時 ΔN = 0.6×30,000/(50×3) = 120 MN，扭轉後 ΔN = 0.6×22,800/(50×3) ≈ 91.2 MN。巨柱斷面 18.0 m²、含鋼率 4.5%，軸壓比分母 31.8×17.19 + 295×0.81 ≈ 786 MN；重力軸力 400 MN 時，未扭轉 μ = 520/786 ≈ 0.66，超過 0.65 限值，扭轉後 μ = 491.2/786 ≈ 0.63，符合要求。也就是說，外形帶來的風載折減可能決定巨柱是否需要加大；若不改外形而改為增加鋼骨，分母須達 520/0.65 = 800 MN，約需多出 (800 − 786)/(295 − 31.8) ≈ 0.055 m² 鋼骨，含鋼率由 4.5% 升到約 4.8%。數值為教學假設，不代表上海中心的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Form and mega-column exercise: a rectangular comparison scheme has base moment M₀ = 30 GN·m, and a twisting form cuts wind load by 24% to M = 22.8 GN·m. Outriggers pass 60% of overturning to the mega-columns, with 50 m between tension and compression groups and 3 columns per side: without the twist ΔN = 0.6×30,000/(50×3) = 120 MN, with it ΔN = 0.6×22,800/(50×3) ≈ 91.2 MN. For an 18.0 m² mega-column with 4.5% steel, the axial-ratio denominator is 31.8×17.19 + 295×0.81 ≈ 786 MN; with 400 MN of gravity load the untwisted case gives μ = 520/786 ≈ 0.66, above the 0.65 limit, while the twisted case gives μ = 491.2/786 ≈ 0.63, which complies. The form-driven wind reduction can therefore decide whether the mega-columns must grow; keeping the form and adding steel instead requires a denominator of 520/0.65 = 800 MN, or about (800 − 786)/(295 − 31.8) ≈ 0.055 m² of extra steel, raising the steel ratio from 4.5% to about 4.8%. Values are teaching assumptions, not Shanghai Tower's design values.

title: 東京晴空塔
summary: 從三角形基底到圓形頂部的塔身斷面與格構風力出發，理解心柱與鋼塔之間以油壓阻尼器耦合的減振機制，計算直徑 2.3 m 鋼管與節狀壁樁的容量，再處理日照彎曲下的施工測量、在中央豎井內頂升天線塔、阻尼器的雙線性特性驗證、2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查，最後是冬季落冰與鋼管塔的防蝕維護。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 三腳塔腳柱受力練習：底部為邊長 s = 68 m 的正三角形，三支腳柱到形心距 R = s/√3 ≈ 39.3 m。若風造成的傾覆彎矩 M = 3,000 MN·m 作用於平行某一邊的軸，對應頂點腳柱的軸力變化 F₁ = M/(1.5R) ≈ 3,000/58.9 ≈ 50.9 MN，另兩腳各 F₂ = M/(3R) ≈ 25.5 MN、方向相反。設總重 400 MN、每腳 133.3 MN：頂點腳柱減壓後剩 133.3 − 50.9 ≈ 82.4 MN，另兩腳增為約 158.8 MN；風向反轉時頂點腳約 184.3 MN、另兩腳約 107.9 MN。若地震垂直加速度使重力暫時減少 30%，頂點腳只剩 0.7×133.3 − 50.9 ≈ 42.4 MN。若底邊縮為 50 m，R ≈ 28.9 m、F₁ ≈ 69.3 MN，頂點腳剩約 64.1 MN，餘裕明顯縮小。由此可見基底寬度與節狀壁樁的拉拔能力為何同樣重要。數值為教學假設，不代表東京晴空塔的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Tripod leg forces: the base is an equilateral triangle with side s = 68 m, so each leg is R = s/√3 ≈ 39.3 m from the centroid. An overturning moment M = 3,000 MN·m about an axis parallel to one side changes the apex leg force by F₁ = M/(1.5R) ≈ 3,000/58.9 ≈ 50.9 MN and the other two legs by F₂ = M/(3R) ≈ 25.5 MN each in the opposite sense. With a total weight of 400 MN, 133.3 MN per leg, the apex leg drops to 133.3 − 50.9 ≈ 82.4 MN while the other two rise to about 158.8 MN; with the wind reversed the apex leg carries about 184.3 MN and the others about 107.9 MN. If vertical earthquake acceleration briefly reduces gravity by 30%, the apex leg keeps only 0.7×133.3 − 50.9 ≈ 42.4 MN. With a 50 m base side, R ≈ 28.9 m and F₁ ≈ 69.3 MN, leaving the apex leg about 64.1 MN, a clearly reduced margin. This is why base width and the uplift capacity of the knuckle wall piles matter equally. Values are teaching assumptions, not Tokyo Skytree's design values.

title: 吉隆坡雙子星塔

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 筏基連續澆置練習：某塔筏基約 13,200 m³，要求連續澆置不留冷縫。若配置 4 部泵車、每部名目 80 m³/h、效率 75%，實際供料 4×80×0.75 = 240 m³/h，約需 13,200/240 = 55 小時；以 8 m³ 的預拌車計，每小時約需 240/8 = 30 車。若筏基面積約 2,900 m²、分層厚 0.5 m，每層約 1,450 m³，需 1,450/240 ≈ 6.0 小時才能覆蓋整層；混凝土初凝時間若為 6 小時，已無餘裕。一部泵車故障使供料降為 180 m³/h 時，每層需約 8.1 小時、總時數增為約 73 小時，下層會在被覆蓋前初凝而形成冷縫，因此必須改用斜坡分層以縮小外露面積、加緩凝劑或預備備用泵。數值為教學假設，不代表雙子星塔的實際施工。
workedExample.textEn: Continuous raft pour: a tower raft of about 13,200 m³ must be placed without cold joints. With 4 pumps of 80 m³/h nominal at 75% efficiency, actual supply is 4×80×0.75 = 240 m³/h, needing about 13,200/240 = 55 hours and, with 8 m³ trucks, about 240/8 = 30 trucks per hour. If the raft is about 2,900 m² and placed in 0.5 m layers, each layer is about 1,450 m³ and takes 1,450/240 ≈ 6.0 hours to cover; with an initial set of 6 hours there is no margin. If one pump breaks down and supply falls to 180 m³/h, each layer takes about 8.1 hours and the total about 73 hours, so the layer below sets before it is covered and forms a cold joint; the plan must therefore use sloped layering to shrink the exposed face, add retarder or keep a standby pump. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual Petronas operation.

title: 世界貿易中心一號大樓
summary: 世界貿易中心一號大樓以約 61 m 見方的基座、逐漸削角收分的體量，把 14,000 psi 高強混凝土核心筒與周邊延性抗彎鋼框架組成混合抗側系統，再以展開基腳與岩錨坐落在曼哈頓岩盤上。本課從削角形體的風荷載、核心筒剛度與替代傳力路徑，走到岩盤基腳、尖塔分段吊裝、大體積高強混凝土的溫控與驗收，最後談強健性設計在營運期的改裝管制與尖塔維護。
summaryEn: One World Trade Center rises from a base about 61 m square with chamfered, tapering faces, combining a 14,000 psi high-strength concrete core and a ductile perimeter steel moment frame into a hybrid lateral system founded on Manhattan bedrock with spread footings and rock anchors. The course moves from wind on the chamfered form, core stiffness and alternate load paths to rock footings, staged spire erection, temperature control and acceptance of high-strength mass concrete, and finally to protecting robustness during later alterations and maintaining the spire.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：以核心筒外圈牆檢核在重力與風力共同作用下是否出現拉應力。核心筒外邊 33.5 m、壁厚 1.2 m，面積 A = 33.5² − 31.1² ≈ 155.0 m²，慣性矩 I ≈ 27,000 m⁴，斷面模數 S = I/(33.5/2) ≈ 1,612 m³。核心筒承受重力 N = 1.2×10⁶ kN，平均壓應力 σ_N = 1.2×10⁶/155.0 ≈ 7.74 MPa。第 1 單元的收分基座力矩 8.52×10⁶ kN·m 中由核心筒分擔 60%，M = 5.11×10⁶ kN·m，彎曲應力 σ_M = 5.11×10⁶/1,612 ≈ 3.17 MPa。最大壓應力 7.74 + 3.17 ≈ 10.9 MPa，只有 96.5 MPa（14,000 psi）的約 11%；最小應力 7.74 − 3.17 ≈ 4.57 MPa 仍為壓力。若某段牆的重力只有 0.4×10⁶ kN，σ_N ≈ 2.58 MPa，最小應力變為 2.58 − 3.17 ≈ −0.59 MPa 的拉應力，就需要配置受拉鋼筋或岩錨來處理上拔。數值為教學假設，忽略開口、內牆與動力效應，不代表實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: check whether the outer core walls go into tension under gravity plus wind. The core is 33.5 m outside with 1.2 m walls, so A = 33.5² − 31.1² ≈ 155.0 m², I ≈ 27,000 m⁴ and the section modulus S = I/(33.5/2) ≈ 1,612 m³. With a gravity load N = 1.2×10⁶ kN, the average compression is σ_N = 1.2×10⁶/155.0 ≈ 7.74 MPa. Taking 60% of the tapered base moment of 8.52×10⁶ kN·m from unit 1, M = 5.11×10⁶ kN·m and the bending stress σ_M = 5.11×10⁶/1,612 ≈ 3.17 MPa. The maximum compression 7.74 + 3.17 ≈ 10.9 MPa is only about 11% of 96.5 MPa (14,000 psi), and the minimum 7.74 − 3.17 ≈ 4.57 MPa is still compressive. If a wall segment carried only 0.4×10⁶ kN of gravity, σ_N ≈ 2.58 MPa and the minimum stress becomes 2.58 − 3.17 ≈ −0.59 MPa tension, calling for tension reinforcement or rock anchors to resist uplift. Values are teaching assumptions that ignore openings, interior walls and dynamic effects and do not represent the actual design.

title: 樂天世界塔
summary: 樂天世界塔高 554.5 m、地上 123 層，以鋼筋混凝土核心筒與八根巨柱承擔重力與側力，兩道外伸臂與多道帶狀桁架把巨柱與核心筒綁在一起，並把頂部斜交網格燈籠與飯店柱轉換到巨柱上。基礎是 6.5 m 厚的筏基，斷層帶以不與筏基相連的補強樁改良地盤。本課沿著重力分擔、外伸臂、巨柱細長效應、帶狀桁架延遲鎖定、筏基一次澆置、預拱、監測與長期潛變，拆解這座韓國最高建築的工程邏輯。
summaryEn: Lotte World Tower is 554.5 m tall with 123 storeys above ground; a reinforced-concrete core and eight mega-columns carry gravity and lateral load, two outrigger levels and several belt trusses tie the columns to the core and transfer the diagrid lantern and hotel columns onto the mega-columns. It stands on a 6.5 m thick mat, with ground-reinforcing piles, not connected to the mat, improving fault zones. The course follows gravity sharing, outriggers, mega-column slenderness, delayed locking of belt trusses, a single-pour mat, camber, monitoring and long-term creep to unpack Korea's tallest building.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：檢核筏基在重力加風力下的接觸壓力。塔樓垂直荷重約 75 萬公噸，W = 750,000×9.81 ≈ 7.36×10⁶ kN；筏基 72 m×72 m，A = 5,184 m²，平均接觸壓力 q = 7.36×10⁶/5,184 ≈ 1,419 kPa。設計風傾覆力矩取 M = 2.5×10⁷ kN·m，斷面模數 S = B³/6 = 72³/6 = 62,208 m³，壓力變化 ΔM/S ≈ 402 kPa，故 q_max ≈ 1,821 kPa、q_min ≈ 1,017 kPa，與容許承壓 3,000 kPa 相比利用率約 61%；偏心 e = M/W ≈ 3.4 m 小於 B/6 = 12 m，筏基全面受壓。若 M 加倍為 5.0×10⁷ kN·m，q_max ≈ 2,223 kPa、q_min ≈ 616 kPa，利用率約 74%，e ≈ 6.8 m 仍小於 12 m。荷重與筏基尺寸取自公開資料的約略值，風力矩與承壓判讀為教學假設，不代表實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: check mat contact pressure under gravity plus wind. The tower's vertical load is about 750,000 t, so W = 750,000×9.81 ≈ 7.36×10⁶ kN; the mat is 72 m×72 m, A = 5,184 m², giving an average contact pressure q = 7.36×10⁶/5,184 ≈ 1,419 kPa. Take a design wind overturning moment M = 2.5×10⁷ kN·m; the section modulus is S = B³/6 = 72³/6 = 62,208 m³, so the pressure change is M/S ≈ 402 kPa, q_max ≈ 1,821 kPa and q_min ≈ 1,017 kPa, a utilisation of about 61% of the 3,000 kPa allowable; the eccentricity e = M/W ≈ 3.4 m is below B/6 = 12 m, so the whole mat stays in compression. If M doubles to 5.0×10⁷ kN·m, q_max ≈ 2,223 kPa and q_min ≈ 616 kPa, utilisation about 74%, and e ≈ 6.8 m is still below 12 m. Load and mat size are approximate public values; the wind moment and bearing interpretation are teaching assumptions, not the actual design.

title: 威利斯大樓
summary: 威利斯大樓（原希爾斯大樓）由 Fazlur Khan 與 SOM 設計，九個 75 ft（22.9 m）見方的鋼框管組成 225 ft 見方的束筒，管筒在 50、66、90 層分批終止，只留兩管到頂。本課從束筒如何以內部框架減少剪力遲滯、分段收進如何降低質心與造成扭轉，到 15 ft 柱距框管、75 ft 複合樓板桁架、每週兩層的鋼構安裝與岩盤沉箱，再到週期量測、外牆熱隔離，以及 2017–2020 年在營運中改造底座時的柱補強與傳力路徑管理。
summaryEn: Willis Tower, formerly Sears Tower, designed by Fazlur Khan and SOM, bundles nine 75 ft (22.9 m) square steel framed tubes into a 225 ft square plan; the tubes stop in groups at floors 50, 66 and 90, leaving two to the top. The course covers how interior frames reduce shear lag, how staged terminations lower the mass centroid and create torsion, the 15 ft column module, 75 ft composite floor trusses, erection at two floors a week and rock caissons, then period measurement, thermal isolation by the skin, and column strengthening and load-path control during the 2017–2020 base repositioning of the occupied tower.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：以平截面假設估算束筒翼板柱在風傾覆力矩下的軸力。取均布風荷載 w = 1.4 kPa×68.6 m ≈ 96.0 kN/m、高度 H = 442 m，基座力矩 M = wH²/2 = 96.0×442²/2 ≈ 9.38×10⁶ kN·m。抵抗彎矩的翼板線位於 y = ±34.29 m（外牆）與 y = ±11.43 m（內部框架），每線 16 根同斷面柱，Σy² = 16×(2×34.29² + 2×11.43²) ≈ 41,806 m²。角柱軸力 F = M·y/Σy² = 9.38×10⁶×34.29/41,806 ≈ 7,690 kN，內部框架柱約 2,560 kN。若沒有內部框架（單一大管），Σy² = 16×2×34.29² ≈ 37,626 m²，角柱軸力升到約 8,550 kN，增加約 11%；而且單管的剪力遲滯會讓角柱實際軸力再高出更多。若風荷載提高 20%，所有軸力同比例增加。數值為教學假設，忽略腹板柱、剪力遲滯與收進，不代表實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate flange-column axial forces in the bundled tube under wind overturning using plane sections. Take a uniform wind load w = 1.4 kPa×68.6 m ≈ 96.0 kN/m and height H = 442 m, so the base moment M = wH²/2 = 96.0×442²/2 ≈ 9.38×10⁶ kN·m. The flange lines resisting the moment lie at y = ±34.29 m (exterior walls) and y = ±11.43 m (interior frames), each with 16 identical columns, so Σy² = 16×(2×34.29² + 2×11.43²) ≈ 41,806 m². The corner-column force is F = M·y/Σy² = 9.38×10⁶×34.29/41,806 ≈ 7,690 kN, and an interior-frame column carries about 2,560 kN. Without interior frames (one large tube), Σy² = 16×2×34.29² ≈ 37,626 m² and the corner force rises to about 8,550 kN, about 11% more, and shear lag in a single tube would push the real corner force higher still. A 20% increase in wind load raises every axial force by the same proportion. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring web columns, shear lag and setbacks, not the actual design.

title: 香港環球貿易廣場
summary: 環球貿易廣場高 484 m、地上 108 層（樓層編號至 118），坐落在西九龍填海區的九龍站上方。結構以鋼筋混凝土核心筒、八根巨柱與四道外伸臂組成，最低一道為預力混凝土外伸臂，其餘三道為鋼構；凹角平面與上部 1° 內傾減弱颱風下的渦流激振，巨柱在底部外撇約 3°。岩盤深約 70 至 130 m 且起伏如懸崖，因此改用平均深約 70 m 的灌漿摩擦型壁樁。本課從颱風風荷載、外伸臂、預力與外撇巨柱，到壁樁施工、高空風速管控、風洞縮尺、載重試驗、海埔地耐久與颱風後交接。
summaryEn: The International Commerce Centre is 484 m tall with 108 storeys above ground (numbered to 118), standing over Kowloon Station on West Kowloon reclamation. Its structure combines a reinforced-concrete core, eight mega-columns and four outrigger levels, the lowest in prestressed concrete and the other three in steel; notched corners and a 1° inward lean of the upper façades weaken typhoon vortex excitation, and the mega-columns splay outward about 3° at the base. With bedrock about 70 to 130 m down in a cliff-like profile, shaft-grouted friction barrettes averaging about 70 m deep were used. The course runs from typhoon wind, outriggers, prestress and splayed columns to barrette construction, wind control at height, wind-tunnel scaling, load testing, durability on reclaimed land and post-typhoon handover.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算颱風下外伸臂傳給巨柱的軸力變化。以第 1 單元凹角平面的基座力矩 M = 2.2×1.5×60×484²/2 ≈ 2.32×10⁷ kN·m 為例，假設外伸臂把其中 40% 轉成巨柱的拉壓力偶，M_o ≈ 9.28×10⁶ kN·m。兩側巨柱群力臂 d = 50 m、每側 4 根巨柱，每根巨柱軸力變化 ΔP = M_o/(d×4) = 9.28×10⁶/(50×4) ≈ 46,400 kN。若每根巨柱的重力軸力為 250,000 kN，迎風側巨柱的壓力只減少約 18.6%，不會出現淨拉力；若外伸臂分擔提高到 60%，ΔP ≈ 69,600 kN（約 27.8%），仍維持受壓，但外伸臂與巨柱接頭的設計力同比例增加，長期差異縮短造成的附加力也必須一併檢核。數值為教學假設，不代表實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the change in mega-column axial force delivered by outriggers under typhoon wind. Take the notched-plan base moment from unit 1, M = 2.2×1.5×60×484²/2 ≈ 2.32×10⁷ kN·m, and assume the outriggers convert 40% of it into a column couple, M_o ≈ 9.28×10⁶ kN·m. With a lever arm d = 50 m between column groups and four mega-columns per side, each column's axial force changes by ΔP = M_o/(d×4) = 9.28×10⁶/(50×4) ≈ 46,400 kN. If each column carries 250,000 kN of gravity, the windward columns lose only about 18.6% of their compression and never go into net tension; raising the outrigger share to 60% gives ΔP ≈ 69,600 kN (about 27.8%), still in compression, but outrigger and joint design forces rise in proportion and the added forces from long-term differential shortening must be checked as well. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual design.

title: 碎片大廈
summary: 碎片大廈由 Renzo Piano 設計、WSP 擔任結構設計、Mace 承建，官方高度 309.6 m、共 95 層。結構依用途分區：下部辦公層為複合鋼構，上部飯店與住宅層為 200 mm 後拉預力混凝土平板，塔頂以鋼構「散熱器」與桅桿收尾；中央混凝土核心筒是主要抗側骨幹，以費氏桁架與 A 形轉換調整柱距。英國首次採用由上而下的核心筒施工，讓核心筒在地下室開挖時同步上升。本課涵蓋分區質量、扭轉、預力樓板、轉換構件、由上而下施工、尖塔與塔吊、風洞、鄰近鐵路監測、帷幕牆與帽桁架的交接。
summaryEn: The Shard, designed by Renzo Piano with WSP as structural designer and Mace as contractor, is officially 309.6 m tall with 95 storeys. Its structure is zoned by use: composite steel for the lower offices, 200 mm post-tensioned concrete flat slabs for the hotel and homes above, and a steel radiator and mast at the crown; a central concrete core is the main lateral spine, with Vierendeel trusses and A-frames changing column spacing. It was the first UK use of top-down core construction, letting the core rise while the basement was being dug. The course covers zoned mass, torsion, post-tensioned slabs, transfer structures, top-down construction, spire and cranes, wind-tunnel testing, monitoring of adjacent rail assets, curtain-wall joints and the handover of hat trusses.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：由允許擺幅反推核心筒所需勁度與牆厚。以等效均布風荷載 w = 60 kN/m 作用於 H = 306 m 的懸臂，頂部變位 Δ = wH⁴/(8EI)。若容許 Δ = 0.40 m，需 EI = wH⁴/(8Δ) = 60×306⁴/(8×0.40) ≈ 1.64×10¹¹ kN·m²；取混凝土 E = 40 GPa，I = 1.64×10¹¹/(4.0×10⁷) ≈ 4,110 m⁴。以邊長 b = 20 m 的薄壁方形核心 I ≈ (2/3)t·b³ 估算，t = 4,110/((2/3)×8,000) ≈ 0.77 m。若改要求 Δ = 0.30 m，EI 增為約 2.19×10¹¹ kN·m²，I ≈ 5,480 m⁴，t ≈ 1.03 m，牆厚增加約三分之一；若改以外伸帽桁架提供部分勁度，則可在不加厚牆的情況下達到相同變位。數值為教學假設，未計開口、翼牆、背包次核心與動力效應，不代表實際設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: back-calculate core stiffness and wall thickness from the allowed sway. Apply an equivalent uniform wind load w = 60 kN/m to a cantilever H = 306 m tall, with top drift Δ = wH⁴/(8EI). For an allowed Δ = 0.40 m, EI = wH⁴/(8Δ) = 60×306⁴/(8×0.40) ≈ 1.64×10¹¹ kN·m²; with E = 40 GPa, I = 1.64×10¹¹/(4.0×10⁷) ≈ 4,110 m⁴. For a thin-walled square core of side b = 20 m, I ≈ (2/3)t·b³, so t = 4,110/((2/3)×8,000) ≈ 0.77 m. Tightening the limit to Δ = 0.30 m raises EI to about 2.19×10¹¹ kN·m², I ≈ 5,480 m⁴ and t ≈ 1.03 m, about a third thicker; letting outrigger hat trusses supply part of the stiffness reaches the same drift without thickening the walls. Values are teaching assumptions ignoring openings, wing walls, the Backpack core and dynamic effects, not the actual design.

title: 雪梨歌劇院
summary: 從烏戎競圖中無法計算的帆形輪廓出發，說明 Arup 如何以半徑約 75 m 的共同球面把屋殼改為預鑄肋拱，再處理肋段斷面、環氧膠結與後拉預力、伸縮式架設拱與逐段吊裝、電腦化幾何控制，以及風洞與結構模型驗證。最後談海港環境中瓷磚蓋板扣件、預力與混凝土的耐久，以及世界遺產建築的檢測與交接紀錄。
summaryEn: Starting from Utzon's competition sails that could not be calculated, the course shows how Arup turned the shells into precast rib arches cut from a common sphere of about 75 m radius, then covers rib sections, epoxy bonding and post-tensioning, telescopic erection arches and segment-by-segment lifting, computerised geometry control, and wind-tunnel and structural-model verification. It ends with the durability of tile-lid fixings, prestress and concrete in a harbour environment and the inspection and handover records of a World Heritage building.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：檢核一處肋段接縫在風載下是否仍保持受壓。接縫面積 A = 0.90 m²、斷面模數 Z = 0.15 m³，以 7 根 15.2 mm 鋼絞線預壓，每根 140 mm²、有效應力 1,200 MPa：P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN，σ_P = P/A = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.31 MPa。風吸力在該接縫造成彎矩 M = 0.12 MN·m，σ_M = M/Z = 0.12/0.15 = 0.80 MPa。保守忽略自重軸壓，最小應力 σ_min = 1.31 − 0.80 = 0.51 MPa > 0，接縫保持閉合。若長期損失使有效應力降到 1,000 MPa（σ_P ≈ 1.09 MPa），同時風洞修正使彎矩增為 1.5 倍（σ_M = 1.20 MPa），σ_min = 1.09 − 1.20 = −0.11 MPa，接縫邊緣轉為受拉而可能張開，需要增加預力或重新分區。所有數值為教學假設，不代表雪梨歌劇院的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: check whether a rib-segment joint stays in compression under wind. The joint has area A = 0.90 m² and section modulus Z = 0.15 m³ and is stressed by seven 15.2 mm strands of 140 mm² at an effective stress of 1,200 MPa: P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN and σ_P = P/A = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.31 MPa. Wind suction causes a joint moment M = 0.12 MN·m, so σ_M = M/Z = 0.12/0.15 = 0.80 MPa. Conservatively ignoring self-weight compression, σ_min = 1.31 − 0.80 = 0.51 MPa > 0 and the joint stays closed. If long-term losses lower the effective stress to 1,000 MPa (σ_P ≈ 1.09 MPa) while a wind-tunnel correction raises the moment by 1.5 times (σ_M = 1.20 MPa), σ_min = 1.09 − 1.20 = −0.11 MPa, the joint edge goes into tension and may open, calling for more prestress or re-zoning. All values are teaching assumptions, not the design values of the Sydney Opera House.

title: 北京國家體育場
summary: 北京國家體育場（鳥巢）把屋蓋、立面與樓梯整合成一個由交織平面桁架構成的鋼結構外殼，屋蓋平面約 313 m × 266 m，與內部混凝土看台結構完全分離。課程從空間門式結構與三級地震性能目標出發，處理 1.2 m 箱形桿件的板厚與扭曲面、複雜節點的原型試驗、78 個臨時支撐點上的分段組裝與分級卸載，再談溫度與施工監測、ETFE 與 PTFE 雙層膜、防蝕排水維護與賽後再利用。
summaryEn: The Beijing National Stadium, the Bird's Nest, merges roof, façade and stairs into one steel shell of interlaced plane trusses, about 313 m × 266 m on plan and fully separated from the concrete seating bowl inside. The course starts from the portalised space-truss system and three-level seismic performance targets, then covers plate thickness and twisted surfaces of 1.2 m box members, prototype tests of congested nodes, sectional assembly and staged unloading on 78 temporary support points, thermal and construction monitoring, the double ETFE and PTFE membranes, corrosion and drainage maintenance and post-Games reuse.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算屋蓋卸載時一個支撐點的反力變化。假設主桁架與環桁架在卸載前總重 30,000 t，由 78 個臨時支撐點承托，平均反力 R̄ = 30,000×9.81/78 ≈ 3,770 kN。該點預測卸載總下沉 270 mm，分 10 級、每級 27 mm；桁架在該點的勁度 k = 15 kN/mm。若千斤頂操作落後一級，附加反力 ΔR = 15×27 = 405 kN，約為 R̄ 的 10.7%；若落後兩級，ΔR = 810 kN，約 21%，已超過常見的 10% 停止門檻。若把每級改為 13.5 mm（20 級），同樣落後一級只增加約 203 kN，約 5.4%。這說明級數越多、單級位移越小，對同步誤差越不敏感，但卸載時間會加倍。所有數值為教學假設，不代表北京國家體育場的實際施工數據。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the change in one support reaction during roof unloading. Assume the primary and ring trusses weigh 30,000 t before unloading, carried by 78 temporary support points, so the mean reaction is R̄ = 30,000×9.81/78 ≈ 3,770 kN. The point is predicted to settle 270 mm in total, unloaded in 10 stages of 27 mm, and the truss stiffness there is k = 15 kN/mm. If its jack lags one stage, the added reaction is ΔR = 15×27 = 405 kN, about 10.7% of R̄; lagging two stages gives ΔR = 810 kN, about 21%, beyond a typical 10% stop threshold. Using 13.5 mm stages (20 stages), the same one-stage lag adds only about 203 kN, about 5.4%. More, smaller stages make unloading less sensitive to synchronisation error, at the cost of doubling its duration. All values are teaching assumptions, not actual construction data of the Beijing National Stadium.

title: 新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園
summary: 濱海灣金沙空中花園是長約 340 m、最寬約 40 m 的鋼構平台，以巨型桁架與鋼箱梁跨越三座 55 層混凝土塔樓，並在北塔外懸挑約 66.5 m。課程從三塔相對變位與懸臂人致振動出發，處理鋼箱梁與後拉預力、塔頂 V 形斜撐與多向滑動支承、1,270 t 箱梁以鋼絞線千斤頂提升到約 200 m、塔樓斜腿的施工控制，再談提升監測、阻尼器驗收、無邊際泳池接縫調平與長期徐變維護。
summaryEn: The Marina Bay Sands SkyPark is a steel platform about 340 m long and up to about 40 m wide that bridges three 55-storey concrete towers with mega-trusses and steel box girders and cantilevers about 66.5 m beyond the north tower. The course starts from relative tower movement and crowd-induced vibration of the cantilever, then covers box girders and post-tensioning, rooftop V-struts and multidirectional sliding bearings, strand-jack lifting of a 1,270 t girder pair to about 200 m and construction control of the leaning tower legs, before turning to lift monitoring, damper acceptance, infinity-pool joints and levelling, and long-term creep and maintenance.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算懸臂箱梁提升所需的鋼絞線數與提升時間。提升件為一對約 80 m 長的箱梁，假設重 1,270 t，F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN。選用 15.7 mm 鋼絞線，最小破斷力 279 kN，要求安全係數 2.5：所需根數 n = 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112 根，以 4 台千斤頂分配每台 28 根。提升高度 200 m、速度 14 m/h，純提升時間 t = 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h。若高空風速 15 m/s，箱梁迎風面 80 m × 10 m、阻力係數 2.0，橫向風力約 0.5×1.225×15²×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN，約為吊重的 1.8%，鋼絞線偏角約 atan(220/12,460) ≈ 1.0°。若安全係數改為 3.0，需約 134 根，每台 34 根；若風速增為 20 m/s，風力約 392 kN，偏角約 1.8°。所有數值為教學假設，不代表濱海灣金沙的實際提升設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the strands and lifting time for the cantilever box-girder lift. The load is a pair of box girders about 80 m long, assumed to weigh 1,270 t, F = 1,270×9.81 ≈ 12,460 kN. Using 15.7 mm strand with a 279 kN minimum breaking load and a safety factor of 2.5, the number of strands is n = 12,460×2.5/279 ≈ 112, or 28 per jack for 4 jacks. Lifting 200 m at 14 m/h takes t = 200/14 ≈ 14.3 h of pure lifting. At a wind speed of 15 m/s at height, with an 80 m × 10 m frontal area and drag coefficient 2.0, the lateral force is about 0.5×1.225×15²×800×2.0 ≈ 220 kN, about 1.8% of the weight, giving a strand inclination of about atan(220/12,460) ≈ 1.0°. A safety factor of 3.0 needs about 134 strands, 34 per jack; a 20 m/s wind gives about 392 kN and an inclination of about 1.8°. All values are teaching assumptions, not the actual lifting design at Marina Bay Sands.

title: 倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋
summary: 千禧巨蛋並非結構意義上的穹頂，而是由 12 支約 100 m 高的桅桿以吊索與拉索撐起的穹形索網，上覆 PTFE 塗覆玻璃纖維膜，整個屋頂比室內空氣還輕。課程從索網與桅桿的傳力、輕屋蓋的荷載反轉出發，處理膜材選擇、索夾與吊索節點、地面組裝後絞升索網、索長精度與預張力，再談風洞試驗的雷諾數問題、索力現場量測、2022 年風暴後的膜片更換，以及改建為 The O2 時的荷載管理。
summaryEn: The Millennium Dome is not a dome in the structural sense but a dome-shaped cable net held up by hanger and tie-down cables from 12 masts about 100 m high and clad in PTFE-coated glass-fibre fabric, the whole roof weighing less than the air inside. The course starts from the load path of net and masts and load reversal on a lightweight roof, then covers fabric choice, clamps and hanger nodes, winching the ground-assembled net, cable-length accuracy and pretension, Reynolds-number issues in wind-tunnel tests, field measurement of cable forces, panel replacement after the 2022 storm and load control during conversion to The O2.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：評估在一根徑向索上增掛設備的影響。該索吊點間跨距 L = 25 m、垂度 f = 1.0 m、受荷寬 14 m，均布荷載 0.6 kPa，w = 0.6×14 = 8.4 kN/m，原水平張力 H₀ = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×625/8 ≈ 656 kN。現擬在跨中吊掛 10 t 設備，P = 10×9.81 ≈ 98 kN，以集中荷載近似附加 ΔH = PL/(4f) = 98×25/4 ≈ 613 kN，總張力約 1,269 kN，為原值的 1.93 倍。若索的設計上限為 1,000 kN，就不可行；改成在兩個吊點附近各掛 5 t，跨中彎曲效應大減，附加張力可降到原值的一小部分（需以非線性模型重算）。若把垂度設計成 1.5 m，H₀ ≈ 438 kN、ΔH ≈ 409 kN，總計約 847 kN。所有數值為教學假設，不代表千禧巨蛋的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: assess the effect of hanging equipment from one radial cable. The cable spans L = 25 m between hangers with sag f = 1.0 m and a 14 m loaded width; at 0.6 kPa, w = 0.6×14 = 8.4 kN/m and the original horizontal tension is H₀ = wL²/(8f) = 8.4×625/8 ≈ 656 kN. Hanging 10 t at midspan, P = 10×9.81 ≈ 98 kN, adds by the point-load approximation ΔH = PL/(4f) = 98×25/4 ≈ 613 kN, a total of about 1,269 kN or 1.93 times the original. Against a design limit of 1,000 kN this is not acceptable; hanging 5 t near each of the two hanger points greatly reduces the midspan effect and the added tension falls to a small fraction (to be recomputed with a nonlinear model). Designing the sag as 1.5 m gives H₀ ≈ 438 kN and ΔH ≈ 409 kN, about 847 kN in total. All values are teaching assumptions, not the design values of the Millennium Dome.

title: 慕尼黑奧林匹克體育場屋蓋
summary: 慕尼黑奧林匹克公園的帳篷屋蓋由多片鞍形索網組成，總面積約 74,800 m²，覆蓋體育場、體育館與游泳館，網目統一為 75 × 75 cm，上鋪約 8,300 片壓克力板。課程從負高斯曲率索網的預拉平衡與邊索、桅桿、重力錨塊的傳力出發，處理等網目索網與鑄鋼節點、壓克力板的熱脹與接合、地面編網吊升與預拉力導入，再談由實體模型走向迭代電腦計算的形狀確認、安裝量測、板材老化更換，以及列管古蹟屋蓋的重新計算與維護。
summaryEn: The tent roof of Munich's Olympic Park consists of several saddle-shaped cable nets totalling about 74,800 m² over the stadium, arena and swimming hall, all with a uniform 75 × 75 cm mesh and covered by about 8,300 acrylic panels. The course starts from prestress equilibrium of anticlastic nets and the load path through edge cables, masts and gravity anchor blocks, then covers the uniform-mesh net and cast-steel nodes, thermal movement and fixing of acrylic panels, ground assembly, lifting and introduction of pretension, and the move from physical models to iterative computer form finding, before turning to as-built survey, panel ageing and replacement, and recalculation and maintenance of a listed roof.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：檢查鞍形網區在雪載下穩定索是否鬆弛。網區懸掛索曲率半徑 R₁ = 40 m、穩定索 R₂ = 60 m，網目 0.75 m。設穩定索預拉 t₂ = 15 kN/m，由 t₁/R₁ = t₂/R₂ 得懸掛索 t₁ = 15×40/60 = 10 kN/m，每根索分別約 11.3 kN 與 7.5 kN。施加 1.0 kPa 雪載並假設兩組各承一半：Δt₁ = +0.5×40 = +20 kN/m，Δt₂ = −0.5×60 = −30 kN/m，穩定索變為 −15 kN/m，即鬆弛，不可接受。要讓穩定索在此荷載下仍保有 5 kN/m，需 t₂ ≥ 30 + 5 = 35 kN/m，對應 t₁ = 35×40/60 ≈ 23.3 kN/m，雪載下懸掛索升至約 43.3 kN/m，每根約 32.5 kN。若把 R₂ 改為 40 m（曲率加大），同一荷載下 Δt₂ 只需 −20 kN/m，t₂ ≥ 25 kN/m 即可。所有數值為教學假設，不代表慕尼黑屋蓋的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: check whether the arching cables of a saddle zone go slack under snow. The hanging cables have curvature radius R₁ = 40 m, the arching cables R₂ = 60 m, with a 0.75 m mesh. With arching prestress t₂ = 15 kN/m, t₁/R₁ = t₂/R₂ gives hanging prestress t₁ = 15×40/60 = 10 kN/m, about 11.3 kN and 7.5 kN per cable respectively. Under 1.0 kPa of snow shared equally, Δt₁ = +0.5×40 = +20 kN/m and Δt₂ = −0.5×60 = −30 kN/m, so the arching family drops to −15 kN/m, which is slack and unacceptable. To keep 5 kN/m in the arching cables under this load needs t₂ ≥ 30 + 5 = 35 kN/m, giving t₁ = 35×40/60 ≈ 23.3 kN/m, and under snow the hanging cables reach about 43.3 kN/m, about 32.5 kN per cable. Reducing R₂ to 40 m (more curvature) lowers Δt₂ to −20 kN/m for the same load, so t₂ ≥ 25 kN/m suffices. All values are teaching assumptions, not the design values of the Munich roof.

title: 懸索橋主纜架設
summary: 主纜是懸索橋唯一幾乎無法更換的主構件，它的品質在架設時就已決定。本課比較空中紡線（金門大橋、大貝爾特東橋）與預製平行鋼絲索股（明石海峽大橋、瀨戶大橋、1915 恰納卡萊大橋）兩種工法，計算裸纜懸鏈線、索鞍彎曲應力、貓道張力與擠壓後直徑，說明鋼絲等級與鍍層、索股量測與統計允收，並依美國聯邦公路總署的指引談開纜檢查、腐蝕分級與剩餘強度評估。
summaryEn: The main cable is the one primary member of a suspension bridge that can almost never be replaced, and its quality is fixed during erection. This course compares aerial spinning (Golden Gate, Great Belt East) with prefabricated parallel-wire strands (Akashi Kaikyo, Seto Ohashi, 1915 Çanakkale), computes bare-cable catenaries, saddle bending stress, catwalk tension and compacted diameter, explains wire grades and coatings, strand survey and statistical acceptance, and, following US Federal Highway Administration guidance, covers cable openings, corrosion staging and remaining-strength evaluation.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：比較兩種工法完成同一條主纜的現場作業量。主纜需 36,000 根直徑 5.4 mm 的鋼絲，鋼絲面積 36,000×22.90 mm² ≈ 824,000 mm²，以 1,770 N/mm² 計破斷力 ≈ 1,459 MN。PWS 方案每股 127 根，需 284 股（最後一股不足 127 根時仍要一個完整錨頭），兩端共 568 個錨頭；若每夜牽引 4 股，約需 71 夜。空中紡線方案每束約 500 根，需 72 束、144 個索靴；若每日可鋪 1,600 根全長鋼絲，約需 36,000/1,600 ≈ 23 個有效工作日，但若可作業日比例只有 60%，實際約需 38 日曆天，並需加上每束垂度調整。擠壓後空隙率 20% 時主纜直徑 ≈ √(4×0.824/(π×0.80)) ≈ 1.15 m。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的施工紀錄。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compare site effort for the two methods on the same cable. The cable needs 36,000 wires of 5.4 mm, a steel area of 36,000×22.90 mm² ≈ 824,000 mm² and, at 1,770 N/mm², a breaking force ≈ 1,459 MN. The PWS option with 127 wires per strand needs 284 strands (the last, though short of 127 wires, still needs a full socket), 568 sockets at the two ends; at 4 strands a night it takes about 71 nights. The aerial-spinning option with about 500 wires per bundle needs 72 bundles and 144 strand shoes; laying 1,600 full-length wires a day takes about 36,000/1,600 ≈ 23 working days, but if only 60% of days are workable it takes about 38 calendar days, plus sag adjustment for each bundle. With 20% voids after compaction the cable diameter is ≈ √(4×0.824/(π×0.80)) ≈ 1.15 m. Values are teaching assumptions, not construction records of any real bridge.

title: 斜張橋斜索張力調整
summary: 斜張橋的線形與內力幾乎完全由斜索索力決定，索力調整是把設計意圖變成實際結構的核心工序。本課以諾曼第大橋、里翁—安提里翁大橋、蘇通大橋與亞武茲蘇丹塞利姆大橋等公開案例為參照，說明成橋目標索力、影響矩陣法、平行鋼絞線的逐股等張張拉、錨具調整量、施工階段預拱、溫度修正、振動法與舉升試驗量測、長期索力漂移，以及允收準則與營運期再調整的決策流程。
summaryEn: The profile and internal forces of a cable-stayed bridge are set almost entirely by its stay forces, so tuning them is the core operation that turns design intent into the real structure. Referring to public cases such as the Pont de Normandie, Rion–Antirion, Sutong and Yavuz Sultan Selim bridges, the course explains completed-state target forces, the influence-matrix method, strand-by-strand equal-tension stressing, anchorage adjustment, construction-stage camber, temperature correction, vibration and lift-off measurement, long-term force drift, and acceptance criteria and in-service re-tuning decisions.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某斜張橋通車前複測一組 4 根索（同塔同側），溫度修正後與目標的偏差為 +3%、−7%、+2%、−1%，目標力均為 5,000 kN，即實測 5,150、4,650、5,100、4,950 kN。單索容許 ±5%：第 2 根不合格。索組總和 = 19,850 kN，對目標 20,000 kN 偏差 −0.75%，在 ±2% 內。以影響矩陣估算：若第 2 根每增加 1 MN，自身增加 1.0 MN、第 1 與第 3 根各減少 0.15 MN、錨點上升 18 mm，則把第 2 根提高 350 kN 至 5,000 kN 需要的錨具調整量，以有效勁度 6,435×0.6 ≈ 3,861 N/mm 計約 350,000/3,861 ≈ 91 mm；調整後第 1 與第 3 根各降約 0.15×350 ≈ 53 kN，分別變為約 5,097 與 5,047 kN（+1.9% 與 +0.9%），錨點上升約 0.35×18 ≈ 6.3 mm。若可用螺紋長度只剩 60 mm，必須改由相鄰索分擔或安排換索。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: before opening, a group of 4 stays on one side of one pylon is re-measured, and after temperature correction the deviations from target are +3%, −7%, +2% and −1% for 5,000 kN targets, i.e. 5,150, 4,650, 5,100 and 4,950 kN. With a ±5% single-stay tolerance, stay 2 fails. The group sum is 19,850 kN, −0.75% against 20,000 kN, within ±2%. From the influence matrix, if each extra 1 MN in stay 2 raises it by 1.0 MN, lowers stays 1 and 3 by 0.15 MN each and lifts its anchorage 18 mm, then raising stay 2 by 350 kN to 5,000 kN needs, at an effective stiffness of 6,435×0.6 ≈ 3,861 N/mm, an anchorage adjustment of about 350,000/3,861 ≈ 91 mm; stays 1 and 3 then drop about 0.15×350 ≈ 53 kN to about 5,097 and 5,047 kN (+1.9% and +0.9%), and the anchorage rises about 0.35×18 ≈ 6.3 mm. If only 60 mm of thread remains, the correction must be shared with neighbouring stays or the stay replaced. Values are teaching assumptions.

title: 橋梁節塊平衡懸臂施工
summary: 從懸臂負彎矩與變高度箱梁出發，計算施工期不平衡荷載與墩頂臨時固結，再處理懸臂鋼腱、節塊接縫、懸臂工作車循環、溫度與潛變造成的線形偏差與跨中閉合，最後以伸長量、測量回饋與長期撓度監測驗證，並以 Bendorf 橋、Stolma 橋與 Koror–Babeldaob 橋的成敗對照。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一座 150 m 主跨的場鑄平衡懸臂箱梁，計算第 10 號節塊端點的澆置預拱。預測各項撓度（向下為負）：本節塊與後續節塊自重 −45 mm、懸臂鋼腱上拱 +20 mm、長期潛變與乾縮 −30 mm、閉合與連續鋼腱 +6 mm、鋪面與護欄 −12 mm，合計 −45 + 20 − 30 + 6 − 12 = −61 mm，所以節塊須澆在完工高程之上 61 mm。工作車在濕混凝土下另下撓 8 mm，因此模板應設在完工高程之上 61 + 8 = 69 mm。若實際潛變係數比假設大 25%，潛變項變為 −30×1.25 = −37.5 mm，總預拱變為 68.5 mm，模板須設在 76.5 mm；若仍以 69 mm 澆置，該點長期約低 7.5 mm。這說明潛變參數的不確定性為何要在設計時做敏感度分析並在施工中回饋修正。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: for a 150 m cast-in-place balanced-cantilever box girder, compute the casting camber at the tip of segment 10. Predicted deflections (downward negative): self-weight of this and later segments −45 mm, cantilever prestress uplift +20 mm, long-term creep and shrinkage −30 mm, closure and continuity tendons +6 mm, surfacing and barriers −12 mm, totalling −45 + 20 − 30 + 6 − 12 = −61 mm, so the segment must be cast 61 mm above the final profile. The traveler deflects another 8 mm under wet concrete, so the forms are set 61 + 8 = 69 mm above the final profile. If the real creep coefficient is 25% higher than assumed, the creep term becomes −30×1.25 = −37.5 mm, the total camber 68.5 mm and the form setting 76.5 mm; casting at 69 mm would leave that point about 7.5 mm low in the long term. This shows why creep uncertainty needs a design sensitivity study and feedback correction during construction. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設
summary: 從簡支箱梁的正彎矩與體外預力需求出發，計算架橋機對橋墩的施工荷載，再處理乾接縫與環氧接縫、轉向塊與錨碇橫隔、架橋機推進穩定、整跨荷重轉換與預製場幾何控制，最後以鋼腱振動頻率、接縫監測與可更換性驗收交接，並以佛州 Long Key 橋、Seven Mile 橋與曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路為案例。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 工程規劃練習：一條 12.6 km 的高架橋採 42 m 簡支跨，共 12,600/42 = 300 跨，每跨 14 個節塊，總計 300×14 = 4,200 個節塊。若每部架橋機每 2.5 天完成一跨（含推進），單部需要 300×2.5 = 750 個工作天；投入 3 部架橋機則約 250 個工作天。供料需求為 3×14/2.5 = 16.8 個節塊／天，若每個短線台座每天產出 1 個節塊，至少需要 17 個台座，另加故障與養護餘裕。為吸收颱風或運輸中斷，堆置場若要儲備 30 天用量，需容納約 30×16.8 ≈ 504 個節塊。若架設循環變為 3 天／跨，總工期增為 300×3/3 = 300 天，日需求降為 3×14/3 = 14 個節塊。這說明逐跨工法的關鍵路徑常在預製與運輸，而不只是架設本身。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際工程的計畫。
workedExample.textEn: Planning exercise: a 12.6 km viaduct with 42 m simple spans has 12,600/42 = 300 spans; at 14 segments per span it needs 300×14 = 4,200 segments. If each gantry completes a span every 2.5 days including launching, one gantry needs 300×2.5 = 750 working days; three gantries need about 250. Supply demand is 3×14/2.5 = 16.8 segments per day, so with one segment per short-line cell per day at least 17 cells are needed, plus margin for breakdowns and curing. To ride out a typhoon or transport stoppage with 30 days of buffer, the storage yard must hold about 30×16.8 ≈ 504 segments. If the erection cycle slips to 3 days per span, the duration grows to 300×3/3 = 300 days while daily demand drops to 3×14/3 = 14 segments. This shows that the critical path of span-by-span work often lies in casting and transport, not only in erection. Values are teaching assumptions, not the plan of any real project.

title: 橋梁頂推施工
summary: 從頂推過程中每一斷面輪流經過墩頂與跨中所產生的交變彎矩出發，計算導梁長度與中心預力需求，再處理導梁上墩、滑移支承與側向導向、橋台後預製台座的每週循環、臨時墩與鋼橋面頂推，最後以支承反力、頂推力與摩擦監測驗證並完成永久支承安裝與交接，案例涵蓋 Caroní 橋、Kufstein 茵河橋、Ravensbosch 高架橋與 Millau 高架橋。
summaryEn: Starting from the alternating moments that arise as every section passes alternately over piers and midspans, compute launching-nose length and centric prestress, then handle nose landing, sliding bearings and lateral guides, the weekly cycle of the casting bed behind the abutment, temporary piers and steel-deck launching, and finally verify with support reactions, launch force and friction monitoring before installing permanent bearings and handing over, with the Caroní, Kufstein Inn, Ravensbosch and Millau bridges as cases.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計比較練習：跨度 L = 50 m、梁重 w = 200 kN/m、導梁 15 kN/m，比較三種導梁長度。導梁 0.5L = 25 m 時，混凝土懸臂 25 m，M = 200×25²/2 + 15×25×(25 + 12.5) ≈ 76,563 kN·m；導梁 0.62L = 31 m 時 M ≈ 52,143 kN·m；導梁 0.7L = 35 m 時懸臂彎矩降為 200×15²/2 + 15×35×(15 + 17.5) ≈ 39,563 kN·m，但此時控制值改為連續梁墩頂彎矩 wL²/12 ≈ 41,667 kN·m。取 S = 10.0 m³、A = 7.0 m²、容許拉應力 1.5 MPa、每束有效力 1,875 kN，所需中心預力分別為：0.5L 時 (76,563/10 − 1,500)×7.0 ≈ 43,094 kN（約 23 束）；0.62L 時約 26,000 kN（14 束）；0.7L 時 (41,667/10 − 1,500)×7.0 ≈ 18,667 kN（10 束）。導梁由 0.5L 加長到 0.62L 可省約 9 束，但再加長到 0.7L 只再省 4 束，且導梁更長更重、上墩撓度更大。這說明導梁長度約取跨度 60% 至 65% 的工程理由。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design comparison: span L = 50 m, girder w = 200 kN/m, nose 15 kN/m, three nose lengths. With a 0.5L = 25 m nose the concrete cantilever is 25 m and M = 200×25²/2 + 15×25×(25 + 12.5) ≈ 76,563 kN·m; with 0.62L = 31 m, M ≈ 52,143 kN·m; with 0.7L = 35 m the cantilever moment drops to 200×15²/2 + 15×35×(15 + 17.5) ≈ 39,563 kN·m, but the continuous-beam support moment wL²/12 ≈ 41,667 kN·m then governs. With S = 10.0 m³, A = 7.0 m², 1.5 MPa allowable tension and 1,875 kN effective per tendon, the centric prestress needed is (76,563/10 − 1,500)×7.0 ≈ 43,094 kN (about 23 tendons) for 0.5L, about 26,000 kN (14 tendons) for 0.62L and (41,667/10 − 1,500)×7.0 ≈ 18,667 kN (10 tendons) for 0.7L. Lengthening the nose from 0.5L to 0.62L saves about 9 tendons, but going on to 0.7L saves only 4 more while the nose gets longer, heavier and sags more at landing. This is the engineering reason for noses of about 60% to 65% of the span. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 橋梁轉體施工
summary: 從平行於鐵路、道路或河道建造、再轉到跨越位置的工法邏輯出發，計算轉體重量、重心偏心與撐腳間隙，再處理球鉸接觸應力與摩擦力矩、下轉盤局部承壓、牽引系統、到位精調與封鉸，最後以稱重試驗、轉動監測與封固後的沉陷與淨空檢核驗收，並以比利時 Ben-Ahin 斜張橋、塞維亞 Barqueta 拱橋的浮力旋轉與石板坡鋼箱梁的轉向對照。

workedExample.text: 設計比較練習：轉體重 W = 150,000 kN，牽引半徑 4.5 m 由兩台千斤頂形成力偶，啟動靜摩擦 μ_s = 0.08、運行動摩擦 μ_d = 0.04，比較球鉸半徑 R = 2.0 m 與 2.5 m。R = 2.0 m：接觸應力 150,000/(π×2.0²) ≈ 11.9 MPa；啟動力矩 (2/3)×0.08×150,000×2.0 = 16,000 kN·m，每台千斤頂 16,000/(2×4.5) ≈ 1,778 kN；運行力矩 8,000 kN·m，每台約 889 kN。R = 2.5 m：接觸應力降為 150,000/(π×2.5²) ≈ 7.6 MPa（降低約 36%），但啟動力矩升為 20,000 kN·m，每台約 2,222 kN；運行力矩 10,000 kN·m，每台約 1,111 kN（增加 25%）。若 60 m 懸臂端轉動 70°（弧長約 73.3 m）且端點速度限 1.2 m/min，純轉動約 73.3/1.2 ≈ 61 min。結論：加大球鉸換來較低的接觸應力與較大的承壓餘裕，代價是牽引力與千斤頂規格提高，兩者需與封鎖時段及設備可用性一起權衡。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design comparison: rotating weight W = 150,000 kN, a 4.5 m traction radius with two jacks in a couple, static breakaway μ_s = 0.08 and running μ_d = 0.04, comparing hinge radii R = 2.0 m and 2.5 m. For R = 2.0 m the contact stress is 150,000/(π×2.0²) ≈ 11.9 MPa; the breakaway torque is (2/3)×0.08×150,000×2.0 = 16,000 kN·m, so each jack needs 16,000/(2×4.5) ≈ 1,778 kN; the running torque is 8,000 kN·m, about 889 kN per jack. For R = 2.5 m the contact stress falls to 150,000/(π×2.5²) ≈ 7.6 MPa, about 36% lower, but the breakaway torque rises to 20,000 kN·m, about 2,222 kN per jack, and the running torque to 10,000 kN·m, about 1,111 kN per jack, 25% more. Turning a 60 m tip through 70°, an arc of about 73.3 m, at a 1.2 m/min tip limit takes about 73.3/1.2 ≈ 61 min. Conclusion: a larger hinge buys lower contact stress and more bearing margin at the cost of higher traction and larger jacks, to be weighed together with the possession window and equipment availability. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 鋼拱橋拱肋合龍
summary: 大跨度鋼拱多半以兩側半拱懸臂伸出、在拱頂合龍的方式架設，合龍是整個施工中結構體系改變最劇烈、對幾何與溫度最敏感的時刻。本課以雪梨港灣大橋 1930 年放索合龍、新河峽大橋 1976 年以 16 具千斤頂下放合龍，以及上海盧浦大橋以臨時斜拉索懸臂架設為例，說明合龍前後的力學、架設方法選擇、合龍段構造、溫度場、線形調整、鎖定時機、扣索卸載與驗收，最後談強迫對位的風險與合龍紀錄的交接。
summaryEn: Most long-span steel arches are built by cantilevering half-arches from both sides and closing them at the crown, and closure is the moment of the most drastic system change in the whole erection, the most sensitive to geometry and temperature. Using the 1930 cable-release closure of Sydney Harbour Bridge, the 1976 jack-down closure of New River Gorge Bridge with 16 jacks and the temporary cable-stayed cantilevering of Shanghai's Lupu Bridge, the course explains the mechanics before and after closure, choice of erection method, closure-segment detailing, temperature fields, geometry adjustment, locking time, tieback release and acceptance, ending with the risks of forced fit and the handover of closure records.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 合龍規劃練習：某鋼拱 L = 400 m、拱矢 f = 80 m、施工階段自重 w = 180 kN/m。成拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f) = 180×400²/(8×80) = 45,000 kN。合龍前每個半拱懸臂 200 m，拱腳彎矩 M = w·(L/2)²/2 = 180×200²/2 = 3.6×10⁶ kN·m；扣索力臂 50 m 時扣索力 T = 3.6×10⁶/50 = 72,000 kN。扣索長 250 m、斷面 0.08 m²、E = 195 GPa，彈性伸長 δ = 72×10⁶×250/(195×10⁹×0.08) ≈ 1.15 m，必須納入預拱與扣索長度設定。拱軸弧長 s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 400 + 8×80²/1,200 ≈ 442.7 m，溫度變化 10 °C 時合龍間隙改變 1.2×10⁻⁵×442.7×10 ≈ 53 mm，遠大於螺栓孔容許的數公釐，因此必須以實測溫度與間隙決定合龍段尺寸與鎖定時段。若拱矢提高到 100 m，推力降為 36,000 kN（減少 20%），但拱肋更長、溫度間隙變化與扣索高度都增加。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Closure-planning exercise: a steel arch has L = 400 m, rise f = 80 m and erection-stage self-weight w = 180 kN/m. The completed thrust is H = w·L²/(8f) = 180×400²/(8×80) = 45,000 kN. Before closure each half-arch cantilevers 200 m with a foot moment M = w·(L/2)²/2 = 180×200²/2 = 3.6×10⁶ kN·m; with a 50 m tieback lever arm the tieback force is T = 3.6×10⁶/50 = 72,000 kN. A 250 m tieback of 0.08 m² with E = 195 GPa stretches δ = 72×10⁶×250/(195×10⁹×0.08) ≈ 1.15 m, which must be built into camber and tieback length settings. The arc length is s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 400 + 8×80²/1,200 ≈ 442.7 m, so a 10 °C change alters the closure gap by 1.2×10⁻⁵×442.7×10 ≈ 53 mm, far more than the few millimetres bolt holes allow, which is why measured temperature and gap must set the closure-piece size and locking window. Raising the rise to 100 m cuts thrust to 36,000 kN (20% less) but lengthens the ribs, increasing thermal gap change and tieback height. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 正交異性鋼橋面板製作
summary: 從輪載經面板、縱肋、橫梁到主梁的局部與整體傳力出發，以疲勞為主控計算面板厚度，再處理 U 形肋冷彎、肋—面板部分滲透焊、面板單元焊接變形、工地拼接收縮、非破壞檢測與試拼裝，最後以鋪面協同、疲勞熱點檢查與裂縫成長評估交接，並以金門大橋 1982 至 1986 年換裝鋼橋面、Lions Gate 橋與 Millau 高架橋為案例。
summaryEn: Starting from the local and global load path from wheel to deck plate, ribs, floorbeams and main girders, size the deck plate with fatigue governing, then handle cold-formed U-ribs, rib-to-deck partial-penetration welds, panel welding distortion, site-splice shrinkage, non-destructive testing and trial assembly, and finally hand over with surfacing interaction, fatigue hot-spot inspection and crack-growth assessment, using the Golden Gate Bridge's 1982–1986 redecking, Lions Gate and Millau as cases.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計取捨練習：一座寬 30 m、長 1,000 m 的鋼橋面（面積 30,000 m²），比較面板厚度 12、16、18 mm。局部彎曲應力約與厚度平方成反比：由 12 mm 改為 16 mm，應力幅降為 (12/16)² ≈ 0.56 倍，以 m = 3 的 S–N 曲線計，疲勞壽命約增為 (16/12)⁶ ≈ 5.6 倍；增加的鋼重為 0.004 m × 7,850 kg/m³ = 31.4 kg/m²，全橋約 31.4×30,000/1,000 ≈ 942 t。再由 16 mm 加到 18 mm，應力幅降為 (16/18)² ≈ 0.79 倍，壽命約增為 (18/16)⁶ ≈ 2.0 倍，增重 15.7 kg/m²，全橋約 471 t。若再考慮常溫鋪面合成可使板條勁度增為約 5.3 倍、夏季高溫只剩約 1.9 倍，設計應以高溫狀態檢核重車道細部。結論：在重車道使用較厚面板、在輕載區維持標準厚度，是兼顧重量與疲勞的常見作法。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Trade-off exercise: a steel deck 30 m wide and 1,000 m long (30,000 m²) compares deck plates of 12, 16 and 18 mm. Local bending stress varies roughly with the inverse square of thickness: going from 12 mm to 16 mm cuts the stress range to (12/16)² ≈ 0.56 times, so with an m = 3 S–N curve the fatigue life rises about (16/12)⁶ ≈ 5.6 times; the added steel is 0.004 m × 7,850 kg/m³ = 31.4 kg/m², about 31.4×30,000/1,000 ≈ 942 t for the bridge. Going on from 16 mm to 18 mm cuts the stress range to (16/18)² ≈ 0.79 times and raises life about (18/16)⁶ ≈ 2.0 times for 15.7 kg/m², about 471 t. Allowing for surfacing composite action, which raises strip stiffness about 5.3 times at moderate temperature but only about 1.9 times in summer heat, heavy-lane details should be checked for the hot condition. Conclusion: thicker plates in heavy lanes and standard thickness elsewhere is a common balance of weight and fatigue. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換
summary: 從溫度、乾縮、潛變與活載造成的梁端位移出發，決定伸縮縫型式與間隙數，檢核中梁輪載衝擊與疲勞，再處理錨碇箱與後澆混凝土、安裝溫度預設、通車條件下的分幅更換、出廠疲勞與防水試驗、現場間隙—溫度量測，最後以止水排水維護與生命週期更換策略交接，並以新 Tappan Zee 橋的 LR18 模組式伸縮縫、Øresund 橋的旋轉橫梁伸縮縫更換與漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋伸縮縫翻修為案例。
summaryEn: Starting from girder-end movements due to temperature, shrinkage, creep and live load, choose the joint type and number of gaps and check centre-beam wheel impact and fatigue, then handle anchorage boxes and blockout concrete, temperature presetting at installation, staged replacement under traffic, factory fatigue and watertightness tests and field gap–temperature measurements, and finally hand over with seal and drainage maintenance and a life-cycle replacement strategy, using the LR18 modular joints of the new Tappan Zee crossing, the swivel-joist joint replacement on the Øresund Bridge and the joint rehabilitation of Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge as cases.
