workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 選型練習：一座鋼橋伸縮長度 480 m，α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C，結構溫度範圍 −5 至 +55°C（ΔT = 60°C）：溫度位移 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×60 ≈ 346 mm；加上活載轉角與煞車往復 ±20 mm 共 40 mm，合計約 386 mm。若模組式每間隙 80 mm，需 386/80 ≈ 4.8，取 5 個間隙（400 mm），中位開口 200 mm（每間隙 40 mm），參考溫度 25°C。安裝時結構溫度 35°C，梁較中位長 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×10 ≈ 58 mm，預設總開口 200 − 58 ≈ 142 mm，平均每間隙約 28.5 mm。若耐震要求另需容納 150 mm 地震位移，總需求約 536 mm，需 536/80 ≈ 6.7，取 7 個間隙；或改採在地震時允許犧牲、事後快速更換的設計，兩者須與業主的震後通行目標一起比較。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Selection exercise: a steel bridge has a 480 m expansion length, α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C and a structure temperature range of −5 to +55°C (ΔT = 60°C), so thermal movement is 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×60 ≈ 346 mm; adding ±20 mm, 40 mm in all, for live-load rotation and braking gives about 386 mm. At 80 mm per modular gap, 386/80 ≈ 4.8, so 5 gaps (400 mm) with a mid opening of 200 mm (40 mm per gap) at a 25°C reference. Installed at a structure temperature of 35°C, the girder is 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×10 ≈ 58 mm longer than at mid, so the preset total opening is 200 − 58 ≈ 142 mm, about 28.5 mm per gap. If seismic design also requires 150 mm of earthquake displacement, the demand becomes about 536 mm, needing 536/80 ≈ 6.7, so 7 gaps; alternatively a design that may be sacrificed in an earthquake and quickly replaced afterwards can be compared, together with the owner's post-earthquake access objective. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 球面支承安裝
summary: 從支承配置與熱位移出發，量化球面支承的轉角需求、滑動材料承壓、曲面摩擦力矩與偏心，再處理工廠預設偏移、墊層灌漿、運輸固定件拆除、型式試驗、現場位移指標與累積滑移磨耗，最後以萊茵河上兩座斜張橋的 120 MN 級球面支承更換與新建案例，說明頂升更換與交接紀錄。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一聯鋼—混凝土複合連續梁，縱向固定點設在中間墩，最遠的活動支承距固定點 L = 180 m，α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C，設計梁溫 −5 至 45°C、參考溫度 20°C。最大伸縮 1.2×10⁻⁵×180,000×25 = 54 mm，即 ±54 mm，加 ±20 mm 餘裕後滑板行程 ±74 mm。安裝時梁溫 32°C，溫度預設 1.2×10⁻⁵×180,000×12 ≈ 26 mm（複合梁乾縮另計）。豎向反力 N = 12 MN、滑動材料容許壓力 45 MPa，A = 12/45 ≈ 0.267 m²，D = √(4A/π) ≈ 0.58 m。摩擦水平力 H = μN：常溫 0.03×12 = 0.36 MN，低溫啟動 0.05×12 = 0.6 MN，需由墩帽與錨栓承受。若把固定點移到聯的一端使 L = 360 m，行程變為 ±108 mm 加餘裕、預設約 52 mm，滑板與伸縮縫都要加大。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a steel–concrete composite continuous girder has its longitudinal fixed point at a central pier, the farthest sliding bearing is L = 180 m away, α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C, design girder temperatures run from −5 to 45°C with a 20°C reference. Maximum movement is 1.2×10⁻⁵×180,000×25 = 54 mm, i.e. ±54 mm, and with ±20 mm margin the plate travel is ±74 mm. Installed at a girder temperature of 32°C, the thermal preset is 1.2×10⁻⁵×180,000×12 ≈ 26 mm (composite-deck shrinkage added separately). For a vertical reaction N = 12 MN and an allowable sliding pressure of 45 MPa, A = 12/45 ≈ 0.267 m² and D = √(4A/π) ≈ 0.58 m. The friction force H = μN is 0.03×12 = 0.36 MN normally and 0.05×12 = 0.6 MN at cold breakaway, to be carried by the pier cap and anchors. Moving the fixed point to one end makes L = 360 m, so travel becomes ±108 mm plus margin and the preset about 52 mm, enlarging both plate and expansion joint. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 鉛心橡膠支承隔震
summary: 從週期移轉與設計反應譜出發，以雙線性模型量化鉛心橡膠支承的特徵強度、屈服後勁度、等效週期與阻尼，再處理疊層橡膠的形狀係數與應變、安裝初始偏移、常時約束與隔震縫、原型與量產試驗、振動台驗證、材料性質上下限與震後檢查，並以紐西蘭最早的隔震橋、金門大橋引道高架橋改造與 921 地震後的集鹿大橋研究為例。
summaryEn: Starting from period shift and the design spectrum, use a bilinear model to quantify a lead-rubber bearing's characteristic strength, post-yield stiffness, effective period and damping, then handle laminated-rubber shape factor and strains, initial installation offset, service restraint and isolation gaps, prototype and production tests, shake-table verification, property bounds and post-earthquake inspection, drawing on New Zealand's first isolated bridges, the Golden Gate Bridge approach-viaduct retrofit and post-Chi-Chi studies of the Chi-Lu Bridge.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某連續梁橋每座墩承載 W = 6,000 kN，設兩顆鉛心橡膠支承，每顆 W = 3,000 kN。支承直徑 800 mm、鉛心 150 mm、橡膠總厚 T_r = 200 mm、G = 0.4 MPa，得 Q_d = 10 MPa×0.0177 m² ≈ 177 kN、K_d = 400×0.485/0.2 ≈ 970 kN/m、K_u ≈ 9,700 kN/m、D_y ≈ 0.020 m。設計譜 S_D1 = 0.6 g。先假設 D = 0.25 m：K_eff = 177/0.25 + 970 ≈ 1,678 kN/m，T_eff = 2π√(3,000/(9.81×1,678)) ≈ 2.68 s，β = 2×177×(0.25 − 0.020)/(π×1,678×0.25²) ≈ 24.7%，B_L = (0.247/0.05)^0.3 ≈ 1.61，D = 0.25×0.6×2.68/1.61 ≈ 0.249 m，與假設相符而收斂。每顆支承剪力 V = K_eff·D ≈ 1,678×0.249 ≈ 418 kN，約為 W 的 14%；若同一墩固接、週期 0.63 s 落在譜高原段（教學假設 S_DS = 1.0 g），彈性剪力約為 W 的 100%。若改用 β = 5% 的無鉛心橡膠支承，位移增為約 0.40 m，隔震縫與伸縮縫都要放大。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: each pier of a continuous girder bridge carries W = 6,000 kN on two lead-rubber bearings of W = 3,000 kN each. Bearing diameter 800 mm, lead core 150 mm, total rubber T_r = 200 mm and G = 0.4 MPa give Q_d = 10 MPa×0.0177 m² ≈ 177 kN, K_d = 400×0.485/0.2 ≈ 970 kN/m, K_u ≈ 9,700 kN/m and D_y ≈ 0.020 m. The design spectrum has S_D1 = 0.6 g. Assume D = 0.25 m: K_eff = 177/0.25 + 970 ≈ 1,678 kN/m, T_eff = 2π√(3,000/(9.81×1,678)) ≈ 2.68 s, β = 2×177×(0.25 − 0.020)/(π×1,678×0.25²) ≈ 24.7%, B_L = (0.247/0.05)^0.3 ≈ 1.61 and D = 0.25×0.6×2.68/1.61 ≈ 0.249 m, matching the assumption, so it converges. Bearing shear V = K_eff·D ≈ 1,678×0.249 ≈ 418 kN, about 14% of W; if the same pier were fixed with a 0.63 s period on the spectral plateau (teaching assumption S_DS = 1.0 g), elastic shear would be about 100% of W. Using plain rubber bearings with β = 5% would raise displacement to about 0.40 m and enlarge both isolation gaps and expansion joints. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 橋墩塑鉸韌性設計
titleEn: Ductile plastic-hinge design for bridge piers
summary: 從 1989 年賽普勒斯高架橋、1995 年阪神高速神戶線與 1999 年 921 地震的橋墩破壞出發，建立容量設計層級與位移韌性需求，量化圍束箍筋、塑鉸長度與轉角容量，再處理箍筋與續接器施工、反覆載重試驗、震後殘留漂移、塑鉸區腐蝕與既有橋墩的剪力退化評估，說明為何塑鉸只能出現在預先選定、詳細配筋且可檢查的位置。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a single cantilever circular pier with D = 2.0 m, height L = 10 m and axial load P = 8 MN has 46 bars of 36 mm (A_s ≈ 0.0468 m², ρ_l ≈ 1.5%) with f_ye = 475 MPa, and moment–curvature analysis gives M_p ≈ 12 MN·m (teaching assumption). Yield curvature φ_y ≈ 2.25×0.002375/2.0 ≈ 0.00267 1/m and Δ_y = φ_y·L²/3 ≈ 0.089 m. A 22 mm spiral at 100 mm gives ρ_s = 0.0080, ε_cu ≈ 0.0136 and φ_u ≈ 0.0136/0.5 ≈ 0.0272 1/m. L_p = 0.08×10 + 0.022×475×0.036 ≈ 1.18 m, θ_p ≈ (0.0272 − 0.0027)×1.18 ≈ 0.029 rad, Δ_p ≈ 0.029×9.41 ≈ 0.27 m, so capacity Δ_c ≈ 0.36 m and μ_c ≈ 0.36/0.089 ≈ 4.0 (at least 3). With demand Δ_D = 0.30 m, μ_D ≈ 3.4 (at most 4) and Δ_c/Δ_D ≈ 1.2. Capacity protection: M_o = 1.2×12 = 14.4 MN·m and V_o = 1.44 MN govern foundation and column shear design. Widening the spiral pitch to 130 mm lowers ε_cu to about 0.0114 and Δ_c to about 0.31 m, nearly erasing the margin. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 橋墩纖維複材耐震補強
titleEn: FRP seismic strengthening of bridge piers
summary: 從舊橋墩的剪力、圍束與柱底搭接三種缺陷出發，說明纖維複材套管為何只沿環向布纖維、如何以側向圍束壓力與有效應變計算層數與剪力貢獻，再處理表面處理、露點與圓角、濕式積層、拉拔與脫層檢驗、補強前後反覆載重驗證、紫外線與撞擊耐久以及震後量測，並以賓州 I-84 跨越橋 1995 年的塑鉸區包覆與舊金山碼頭 250 支沉箱套管為例。

workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: an old circular column with D = 1.5 m and f′_c = 27.5 MPa has inadequate hoops, and pushover shows μ_c ≈ 1.5 against a demand μ_D ≈ 3.5. A carbon wet lay-up with E_f = 230 GPa, t_f = 0.165 mm per ply, ε*_fu = 0.017, exterior C_E = 0.85 and κ_ε = 0.55 gives ε_fe ≈ 0.0079. With 6 plies f_l = 2×230,000×6×0.165×0.0079/1,500 ≈ 2.41 MPa and f_l/f′_c ≈ 0.088, at least 0.08. Confined strength f′_cc = f′_c + 0.95×3.3×f_l ≈ 27.5 + 7.6 ≈ 35.1 MPa; ultimate strain ε_ccu = 0.002×[1.5 + 12×0.088×(0.0079/0.002)^0.45] ≈ 0.0069, about 2.3 times the unconfined 0.003. The shear contribution with a 0.004 strain limit and θ = 45° is V_j = (π/2)×6×0.165×230,000×0.004×1,500 ≈ 2.15 MN, about 1.82 MN after a 0.85 reduction. With only 4 plies f_l/f′_c ≈ 0.058, so no confinement gain may be counted, and the shear contribution falls to about 1.43 MN. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge or product.

title: 橋梁基礎沖刷監測
summary: 從長期河床降低、束縮沖刷與橋墩局部沖刷三個分量出發，以 HEC-18 公式估算沖刷深度並評估擴展基礎與樁基的暴露後果，再處理拋石保護、聲納與磁性滑環等固定式監測儀的安裝、施工期河道束縮、即時警戒值、振動頻率識別、行動計畫與洪後檢查，並以 1987 年紐約 Schoharie 溪橋、2000 年高屏大橋與 2008 年后豐大橋的斷橋為鑑。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某跨河橋圓頭墩寬 a = 2.0 m，設計洪水上游水深 y₁ = 5.0 m、流速 V = 4.0 m/s。Fr = 4.0/√(9.81×5.0) ≈ 0.571，局部沖刷 y_s = 2.0×2.0×1.1×(5.0/2.0)^0.35×0.571^0.43 ≈ 2.0×2.0×1.1×1.378×0.786 ≈ 4.8 m；施工期圍堰使寬度 300 m 縮為 240 m，束縮沖刷 5.0×(1.25^0.69 − 1) ≈ 0.83 m；長期降低取 1.0 m，總沖刷約 6.6 m。擴展基礎底面在河床下 5.0 m，將被淘空約 1.6 m，必須改用樁基或加設保護工。墩周拋石 D50 = 0.692×(1.5×4.0)²/(1.65×2×9.81) ≈ 0.77 m。監測方面，原河床 EL +10.0 m、臨界沖刷高程 EL +5.5 m，警戒值 EL +7.75 m、封橋值 EL +6.75 m（含 ±0.15 m 儀器精度）；以率定曲線 Q = 300·(h − 1.0)^1.5 反推，封橋流量 8,000 m³/s 對應水位約 9.9 m。若墩軸與洪水斜交 15°（長寬比 4），局部沖刷增為約 7.5 m，總沖刷超過 9 m，警戒與封橋值都須重訂。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a river bridge has a round-nosed pier of width a = 2.0 m, with design-flood approach depth y₁ = 5.0 m and velocity V = 4.0 m/s. Fr = 4.0/√(9.81×5.0) ≈ 0.571, so local scour y_s = 2.0×2.0×1.1×(5.0/2.0)^0.35×0.571^0.43 ≈ 2.0×2.0×1.1×1.378×0.786 ≈ 4.8 m; construction cofferdams narrowing 300 m to 240 m add contraction scour of 5.0×(1.25^0.69 − 1) ≈ 0.83 m; with 1.0 m of long-term degradation the total is about 6.6 m. A spread footing 5.0 m below the bed would be undermined by about 1.6 m, so piles or countermeasures are required. Pier riprap D50 = 0.692×(1.5×4.0)²/(1.65×2×9.81) ≈ 0.77 m. For monitoring, with the original bed at EL +10.0 m and a critical scour elevation of EL +5.5 m, the alert level is EL +7.75 m and the closure level EL +6.75 m including ±0.15 m instrument accuracy; from the rating Q = 300·(h − 1.0)^1.5, a closure discharge of 8,000 m³/s corresponds to a stage of about 9.9 m. If the pier is skewed 15° to the flood (length-to-width ratio 4), local scour rises to about 7.5 m, total scour exceeds 9 m and both alarm levels must be reset. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗
summary: 從 1940 年塔科馬海峽橋的扭轉顫振崩塌出發，建立橋面設計風速、氣動現象分類、斷面外形與扭轉勁度、Scruton 數等結構參數，再處理施工懸臂階段的抗風、節段模型的彈簧懸吊試驗與縮尺換算、全橋氣動彈性模型、營運期渦振與阻尼器改善以及改裝前的風洞複核，並以明石海峽大橋的全橋模型風洞試驗與伏爾加格勒大橋 2010 年振動事件為例。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某斜張橋主梁寬 B = 32 m、深 D = 3.5 m，扭轉頻率 f_t = 0.35 Hz、豎向頻率 f_b = 0.12 Hz、每延公尺質量 18,000 kg/m、對數衰減率 0.03。基本風速 40 m/s、橋面高 70 m，取 α = 0.125：U_d = 40×7^0.125 ≈ 51.0 m/s，顫振需求取 1.2 倍約 61.2 m/s。1/50 節段模型、頻率比 f_m/f_p = 5，速度縮尺 (1/50)×5 = 0.1。原斷面在模型 5.6 m/s 發生顫振，對應原型 56 m/s，折減風速 56/(0.35×32) = 5.0，小於 61.2 m/s，不合格；加裝整流罩後折減風速提升到 6.5，原型顫振風速 6.5×0.35×32 ≈ 72.8 m/s，滿足需求。渦振方面，St = 0.11 時豎向渦振臨界風速 U_cr = 0.12×3.5/0.11 ≈ 3.8 m/s，Sc = 2×18,000×0.03/(1.25×3.5²) ≈ 70.5；若完工實測阻尼只有一半，Sc 約 35，渦振振幅約加倍，需預留阻尼器空間。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的試驗結果。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a cable-stayed girder is B = 32 m wide and D = 3.5 m deep, with torsional frequency f_t = 0.35 Hz, vertical frequency f_b = 0.12 Hz, 18,000 kg/m mass and a logarithmic decrement of 0.03. With a 40 m/s basic speed, a 70 m deck height and α = 0.125, U_d = 40×7^0.125 ≈ 51.0 m/s, and the flutter requirement at 1.2 times is about 61.2 m/s. A 1/50 section model with frequency ratio f_m/f_p = 5 has velocity scale (1/50)×5 = 0.1. The original section flutters at 5.6 m/s in the model, 56 m/s at full scale, a reduced velocity of 56/(0.35×32) = 5.0, below 61.2 m/s, so it fails; adding fairings raises the reduced velocity to 6.5, giving a full-scale flutter speed of 6.5×0.35×32 ≈ 72.8 m/s, which meets the requirement. For vortex shedding with St = 0.11 the vertical onset speed is U_cr = 0.12×3.5/0.11 ≈ 3.8 m/s and Sc = 2×18,000×0.03/(1.25×3.5²) ≈ 70.5; if as-built damping is only half, Sc is about 35 and vortex amplitude roughly doubles, so space for dampers should be reserved. Values are teaching assumptions, not test results for any real bridge.

title: 斜張索雨風振動抑制
titleEn: Rain–wind vibration mitigation for stay cables
summary: 雨風振動是斜張索在中等風速與降雨同時出現時發生的大振幅振動，1980 年代在日本名港西大橋首次被系統記錄，之後在諾曼第大橋與伊拉斯謨大橋等通車初期都曾出現。本課從上緣水線的氣動機制、史庫頓數門檻、HDPE 套管的螺旋凸肋，到外置與內置阻尼器的選型、交叉索、現場監測、自由衰減驗收、錨口彎曲疲勞與阻尼器維護，建立從量測到對策與驗收的完整流程。
summaryEn: Rain–wind vibration is a large-amplitude motion of stay cables that occurs when moderate wind and rain coincide; it was first systematically recorded on Japan’s Meiko-Nishi Bridge in the 1980s and later appeared soon after opening on bridges such as the Pont de Normandie and the Erasmus Bridge. The course builds a full workflow from measurement to remedy and acceptance: the aerodynamics of the upper rivulet, the Scruton number threshold, helical ribs on HDPE ducts, selection of external and internal dampers, cross-ties, field monitoring, free-decay acceptance, bending fatigue at the anchor exit and damper maintenance.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：為一根長 300 m 的斜索選擇抑振方案。已知 m = 60 kg/m、D = 0.16 m、固有阻尼 ζ₀ = 0.15%，ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m，Sc₀ = 60×0.0015/0.032 ≈ 2.8，遠低於門檻約 10。方案 A：只用外置阻尼器，需 ζ ≥ 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53%，附加阻尼至少 0.38%，所需位置 x_d ≥ 2×0.0038×300 ≈ 2.3 m（以最佳係數計）；保留 50% 餘裕取 ζ_add = 0.57%，x_d ≈ 3.4 m。方案 B：採用螺旋凸肋套管，若試驗證明門檻可放寬到約 5，則需 ζ ≥ 5×0.032/60 ≈ 0.27%，附加阻尼 0.12% 即可，x_d ≈ 0.72 m，內置阻尼器就可能達到；代價是阻力係數若由 0.55 增至 0.6，50 m/s 下每根索的風力由約 1,531×0.55×0.16×300 ≈ 40.4 kN 增至約 44.1 kN（+9%）。若索長改為 450 m，方案 A 的位置需增至約 5.1 m。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: choose a suppression scheme for a 300 m stay with m = 60 kg/m, D = 0.16 m and inherent damping ζ₀ = 0.15%. With ρ·D² = 0.032 kg/m, Sc₀ = 60×0.0015/0.032 ≈ 2.8, far below the threshold of about 10. Option A, external damper only: ζ ≥ 10×0.032/60 ≈ 0.53% requires at least 0.38% added damping, so the position is x_d ≥ 2×0.0038×300 ≈ 2.3 m at optimum coefficient; with 50% margin, ζ_add = 0.57% and x_d ≈ 3.4 m. Option B, helical-rib duct: if tests show the threshold can be relaxed to about 5, then ζ ≥ 5×0.032/60 ≈ 0.27% needs only 0.12% added damping and x_d ≈ 0.72 m, within reach of an internal damper; the price is drag rising from 0.55 to 0.6, so wind force per stay at 50 m/s goes from about 1,531×0.55×0.16×300 ≈ 40.4 kN to about 44.1 kN (+9%). For a 450 m stay, option A’s position grows to about 5.1 m. Values are teaching assumptions.

title: 懸索橋主纜除濕系統
summary: 主纜內部的水分會先消耗鍍鋅層、再腐蝕高強度鋼絲，而主纜幾乎無法更換。本課以本州四國連絡橋首創的主纜乾燥空氣送氣（管理目標相對濕度 40%）與大貝爾特東橋 2014 至 2015 年的除濕改造為主軸，說明腐蝕門檻與露點、送氣與排氣流路、彈性體包覆與索夾密封、除濕機與預冷、改造施工與啟動乾燥曲線、感測器判讀與開纜比對，最後以能耗與生命週期比較說明業主如何決策。
summaryEn: Moisture inside a main cable first consumes the zinc and then corrodes high-strength wire, and the cable can almost never be replaced. Built around the Honshu-Shikoku bridges' pioneering dry-air cable injection (managed to 40% relative humidity) and the 2014–2015 dehumidification retrofit of the Great Belt East Bridge, this course explains corrosion thresholds and dew point, injection and exhaust flow paths, elastomeric wrapping and cable-band seals, dehumidifiers and pre-coolers, retrofit construction and the start-up dry-out curve, sensor interpretation and comparison with cable openings, and finally energy use and the life-cycle comparison behind an owner's decision.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：為一段 300 m 的主纜區段規劃送氣。主纜直徑 0.87 m、空隙率 20%，空隙體積約 0.594×0.20×300 ≈ 35.7 m³。若在中央送氣、兩端排氣，每側流動距離 150 m；以等效滲透率 1×10⁻⁹ m²、流動斷面 0.6 m²、壓差 2,000 Pa 估算，每側流量約 27 L/min，合計約 53 L/min（3.2 m³/h），每天換氣約 76.8 m³，約為空隙體積的 2.2 倍。送入 25 °C、15% RH 空氣（約 3.4 g/m³），出口 40% RH（約 9.2 g/m³），每天可帶走約 0.44 kg 水。若段內殘留 10 kg 水，約需 23 天；若改為只在一端送氣、另一端排氣，流動距離 300 m 使流量減為約 13 L/min，乾燥時間增為約 91 天。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: plan injection for a 300 m cable section. The cable is 0.87 m in diameter with 20% voids, a void volume of about 0.594×0.20×300 ≈ 35.7 m³. Injecting at mid-length with exhausts at both ends gives a 150 m flow length each way; with equivalent permeability 1×10⁻⁹ m², flow section 0.6 m² and 2,000 Pa, each side carries about 27 L/min, about 53 L/min (3.2 m³/h) in total, or about 76.8 m³ a day, about 2.2 times the void volume. Injecting air at 25 °C and 15% RH (about 3.4 g/m³) with exhaust at 40% RH (about 9.2 g/m³) removes about 0.44 kg of water a day, so 10 kg of trapped water takes about 23 days. Injecting at one end and exhausting at the other makes the flow length 300 m, cutting flow to about 13 L/min and stretching drying to about 91 days. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 橋面超高性能混凝土接縫
summary: 從快速橋梁施工中預鑄橋面板接縫的荷載路徑出發，說明超高性能混凝土為何能以約 150 mm 寬的接縫完成鋼筋非接觸搭接，量化介面應力、收縮約束、搭接長度與鋼纖維用量，再處理介面粗糙化、模板密封與溢流、流度與強度驗收、接縫性能監測、氯離子耐久與交接維修，並以紐約州 2009 年首批現澆 UHPC 接縫與 2013 年 I-81 雪城四座橋的 10 天封路更換為例。
summaryEn: Starting from the load path through joints between precast deck elements in accelerated bridge construction, explain why ultra-high-performance concrete completes non-contact lap splices in joints about 150 mm wide, quantify interface stress, restrained shrinkage, lap length and steel-fibre content, then cover interface roughening, form sealing and overfill, flow and strength acceptance, joint performance monitoring, chloride durability and handover and repair, using New York's first field-cast UHPC connections in 2009 and the 2013 replacement of four I-81 bridges in Syracuse under 10-day closures.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：兩塊全深度預鑄橋面板厚 200 mm，以 UHPC 橫向接縫連接，伸出 16 mm 鋼筋@150 mm（f_y = 420 MPa，低於 75 ksi），保護層 50 mm（≥ 3d_b = 48 mm）。依 FHWA 規則 ℓ_d = 8d_b = 128 mm、ℓ_s ≥ 0.75×128 = 96 mm，採 120 mm 搭接、152 mm 接縫，兩側各留 16 mm 允差。若改用 100 ksi 級鋼筋且保護層 40 mm（2.5d_b），ℓ_d = 12d_b = 192 mm、ℓ_s ≥ 144 mm，接縫應加寬到約 203 mm。一道 12 m 長接縫 UHPC 體積 0.152×0.2×12 ≈ 0.365 m³，含 10% 損耗約 0.40 m³，鋼纖維約 0.40×157 ≈ 63 kg。介面剪力以剪力摩擦估算：粗糙化 6 mm 約 895 kN/m，未粗糙化約 442 kN/m，差約 2 倍。驗收：流度 178 至 254 mm，抗壓達 97 MPa（14 ksi）才拆模與承受施工荷重，28 天大於 145 MPa（21 ksi）；76.2 mm 圓柱試體破壞荷重 680 kN 即約 149 MPa。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: two full-depth precast deck panels 200 mm thick are joined by a transverse UHPC joint with projecting 16 mm bars at 150 mm (f_y = 420 MPa, below 75 ksi) and 50 mm cover (at least 3d_b = 48 mm). By the FHWA rule ℓ_d = 8d_b = 128 mm and ℓ_s ≥ 0.75×128 = 96 mm, so a 120 mm lap in a 152 mm joint leaves 16 mm tolerance each side. With 100 ksi bars and 40 mm cover (2.5d_b), ℓ_d = 12d_b = 192 mm and ℓ_s ≥ 144 mm, so the joint should widen to about 203 mm. A 12 m joint holds 0.152×0.2×12 ≈ 0.365 m³ of UHPC, about 0.40 m³ with 10% waste and about 0.40×157 ≈ 63 kg of steel fibre. Shear friction gives interface capacity of about 895 kN/m when roughened to 6 mm and about 442 kN/m unroughened, roughly a factor of 2. Acceptance: flow of 178 to 254 mm, stripping and construction loading only at 97 MPa (14 ksi), and above 145 MPa (21 ksi) at 28 days; a 76.2 mm cylinder failing at 680 kN is about 149 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 預力混凝土孔道灌漿
summary: 從 1985 年威爾斯 Ynys-y-Gwas 橋的突然崩塌與英國 1992 年暫停新建灌漿後拉橋的決定出發，說明灌漿如何同時提供防蝕與握裹，量化鋼腱斷絲的預力損失、高點泌水、氯離子含量與孔道面積比，再處理灌漿壓力與流速、錨頭封護與真空補灌、流度泌水與密度試驗、空洞非破壞檢測、硫酸鹽與氯離子劣化以及灌漿紀錄與風險分級，並以 2000 年夏洛特賽車場人行橋與倫敦漢默史密斯高架橋為鑑。
summaryEn: Starting from the sudden 1985 collapse of the Ynys-y-Gwas bridge in Wales and Britain's 1992 halt on new grouted post-tensioned bridges, explain how grout provides both corrosion protection and bond, quantify force loss from broken strands, bleed at high points, chloride content and duct area ratio, then cover grouting pressure and rate, anchorage protection and vacuum regrouting, fluidity, bleed and density testing, non-destructive void detection, sulfate and chloride deterioration and grouting records and risk ranking, learning from the 2000 Charlotte Motor Speedway footbridge and London's Hammersmith Flyover.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一條 100 m 長、19 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線的連續梁鋼腱（A_ps = 2,660 mm²，有效應力 1,100 MPa，P_e ≈ 2.93 MN），孔道內徑 100 mm，面積比 7,854/2,660 ≈ 2.95，理論淨灌漿量 5,194 mm²×100 m ≈ 0.52 m³。以 30 L/min 灌注，推進速度約 5.8 m/min、需時約 17 分鐘；墩頂高點高出灌漿口 3 m，靜水壓約 56 kPa。灌漿 w/c = 0.40、水泥比重 3.15，理論密度約 1.95 kg/L，若出口量得 1.89 kg/L，代表 w/c 約 0.45、可能加水，應退料。拌合水氯離子 500 mg/L 帶入 0.02%，材料 0.05%，合計 0.07% 低於 0.08%。完工對帳實際灌入 0.49 m³，短少 30 L，約 5.8 m 孔道體積；以波以耳法量測高點空洞約 5.7 L 並真空補灌。若此鋼腱因空洞腐蝕斷 3 股，預力損失約 16%（0.46 MN）。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁或產品的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 100 m continuous-girder tendon of 19 strands of 15.2 mm (A_ps = 2,660 mm², effective stress 1,100 MPa, P_e ≈ 2.93 MN) sits in a 100 mm duct with an area ratio of 7,854/2,660 ≈ 2.95 and a theoretical net grout volume of 5,194 mm²×100 m ≈ 0.52 m³. Pumping at 30 L/min advances about 5.8 m/min and takes about 17 minutes; the pier crest is 3 m above the inlet, a static head of about 56 kPa. With w/c = 0.40 and cement specific gravity 3.15 the theoretical density is about 1.95 kg/L; an outlet reading of 1.89 kg/L implies w/c of about 0.45, probably added water, so the batch is rejected. Mixing water at 500 mg/L chloride adds 0.02% and the material 0.05%, 0.07% in total, below 0.08%. Reconciliation shows 0.49 m³ injected, a 30 L shortfall equal to about 5.8 m of duct; Boyle's-law measurement finds a crest void of about 5.7 L, which is vacuum regrouted. If the tendon later lost 3 strands to corrosion in a void, the force loss would be about 16% (0.46 MN). Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge or product.

title: 橋梁預力鋼腱更換
summary: 從預鑄節塊箱梁外置鋼腱的荷載路徑與冗餘度出發，說明灌漿離析與泌水如何讓鋼絞線在低氯離子下仍然腐蝕斷裂，再處理可更換細部、舊鋼腱去張的能量控制、新鋼腱張拉與伸長量核對、全橋普查、振動與聲射監測，並以美國 Mid-Bay、Ringling 堤道與 Wando River 等橋的鋼腱更換為實例。
summaryEn: Starting from the load path and redundancy of external tendons in precast segmental box girders, explain how segregated, bleeding grout lets strands corrode and rupture even at low chloride, then cover replaceable detailing, energy control when detensioning the old tendon, force and elongation checks on the new one, network-wide surveys, and vibration and acoustic-emission monitoring, using the tendon replacements at the Mid-Bay, Ringling Causeway and Wando River bridges in the United States.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某預鑄節塊箱梁每跨 6 條 19 股 15.2 mm 外置鋼腱，每條有效預力 2.97 MN；斷面 A = 6.0 m²、S_b = 3.5 m³、e = 1.2 m，服務彎矩 M = 30 MN·m，其中恆載 22 MN·m、活載 8 MN·m。(1) 六條鋼腱時底緣 σ_b = −17.82/6.0 − 17.82×1.2/3.5 + 30/3.5 ≈ −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 = −0.51 MPa。(2) 去張一條後 P = 14.85 MN，底緣零應力可承受的彎矩 M_0 = S_b·(P/A + P·e/S_b) = 3.5×(2.475 + 5.091) ≈ 26.5 MN·m，扣除恆載 22 MN·m 後活載只能用 4.5 MN·m，約為設計活載的 56%，需要封閉車道或禁行重車。(3) 新鋼腱以 P_j ≈ 3,857 kN 張拉，μ = 0.25、α = 0.20 rad、L = 120 m，平均力約 3,763 kN，伸長量 ΔL ≈ 0.87 m，250 mm 行程需 4 次。(4) 若改變一個輸入：更換期間加裝兩支臨時預力棒共 2.0 MN、偏心相同，底緣再增加壓應力 2.0/6.0 + 2.0×1.2/3.5 ≈ 1.02 MPa，M_0 升至約 30.0 MN·m，可恢復全部活載。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a precast segmental box girder has six external tendons of 19 × 15.2 mm strands per span, each with 2.97 MN effective prestress; the section has A = 6.0 m², S_b = 3.5 m³ and e = 1.2 m, and the service moment is M = 30 MN·m, of which 22 MN·m is dead load and 8 MN·m live load. (1) With six tendons the bottom fibre is σ_b = −17.82/6.0 − 17.82×1.2/3.5 + 30/3.5 ≈ −2.97 − 6.11 + 8.57 = −0.51 MPa. (2) With one tendon detensioned, P = 14.85 MN and the moment at zero bottom stress is M_0 = S_b·(P/A + P·e/S_b) = 3.5×(2.475 + 5.091) ≈ 26.5 MN·m; after 22 MN·m of dead load only 4.5 MN·m of live load remains, about 56% of the design live load, so lanes must be closed or heavy vehicles banned. (3) The new tendon is stressed to P_j ≈ 3,857 kN with μ = 0.25, α = 0.20 rad and L = 120 m; the average force is about 3,763 kN and the elongation ΔL ≈ 0.87 m, needing 4 strokes of 250 mm. (4) Changing one input: adding two temporary prestressing bars totalling 2.0 MN at the same eccentricity adds 2.0/6.0 + 2.0×1.2/3.5 ≈ 1.02 MPa of bottom compression, raising M_0 to about 30.0 MN·m so full live load can return. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 鋼橋疲勞裂縫評估與修復

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 1970 年代鋼板梁橋受拉翼板的蓋板端部屬 AASHTO E′ 類（A = 3.9×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 1.28×10¹¹ MPa³，常幅門檻約 18 MPa）。現場應變量測得有效應力範圍 S_re = 25 MPa、每天約 1,500 次循環（約 547,500 次/年）。(1) 疲勞壽命 N = 1.28×10¹¹/25³ ≈ 8.2×10⁶ 次，約 15 年，說明通車數十年的此類細節出現裂縫並不意外。(2) 檢查發現半長 a = 30 mm 的邊緣裂縫，取孔邊尖峰應力範圍限值 110 MPa、設計應力範圍 Δσ = 50 MPa：ρ ≥ 4×30×(50/110)² ≈ 24.8 mm，孔徑約 49.6 mm，邊緣裂縫加大 25% 約 62 mm，選用 64 mm（2.5 in）環形鑽，落在 FHWA 手冊 2 至 4 in 的經驗範圍。(3) 再以螺栓拼接板跨越蓋板端部，讓力量繞過受損斷面，並於一年內追蹤檢查孔緣。(4) 若改變一個輸入：S_re 改為 30 MPa，壽命變為 8.2×10⁶×(25/30)³ ≈ 4.7×10⁶ 次，約 8.6 年，應力範圍增加 20% 使壽命少了約 42%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a cover-plate end on the tension flange of a 1970s steel plate-girder bridge is AASHTO Category E′ (A = 3.9×10⁸ ksi³ ≈ 1.28×10¹¹ MPa³, constant-amplitude threshold about 18 MPa). Field strain measurement gives an effective stress range S_re = 25 MPa and about 1,500 cycles a day (about 547,500 a year). (1) Fatigue life N = 1.28×10¹¹/25³ ≈ 8.2×10⁶ cycles, about 15 years, so cracking at such a detail after decades of service is no surprise. (2) Inspection finds an edge crack of half-length a = 30 mm; with a peak hole-edge stress-range limit of 110 MPa and design stress range Δσ = 50 MPa, ρ ≥ 4×30×(50/110)² ≈ 24.8 mm, a diameter of about 49.6 mm, raised by 25% for an edge crack to about 62 mm, so a 64 mm (2.5 in) annular cutter is chosen, within the 2 to 4 in range supported in the FHWA manual. (3) Bolted splice plates then bridge the cover-plate end so force bypasses the damaged section, and the hole edges are re-inspected within a year. (4) Changing one input: with S_re = 30 MPa the life becomes 8.2×10⁶×(25/30)³ ≈ 4.7×10⁶ cycles, about 8.6 years, so a 20% higher stress range cuts life by about 42%. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real bridge.

title: 橋梁健康監測感測網
summary: 以香港青馬大橋等橋的風與結構健康監測系統、明尼阿波利斯 I-35W St. Anthony Falls 新橋內建感測器與加州收費橋梁的強震儀為例，說明如何由監測目的決定量測項目與感測器配置，處理感測原理、安裝與供電、資料擷取與時間同步、施工期基準值、模態識別與溫度效應、警戒值與誤報率，以及系統維護與資料交接。
summaryEn: Using the wind and structural health monitoring system on Hong Kong's Tsing Ma and neighbouring bridges, the built-in sensors of Minneapolis's new I-35W St. Anthony Falls Bridge and the strong-motion instruments on California toll bridges, explain how monitoring objectives set what is measured and where sensors go, then cover sensing principles, installation and power, data acquisition and time synchronisation, construction-stage baselines, modal identification and temperature effects, alert thresholds and false-alarm rates, and system maintenance and data handover.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：為一座教學用斜張橋規劃監測網，共 40 個加速度通道（100 Hz）、60 個應變通道（20 Hz）與 20 個溫度通道（1 Hz），每筆 4 bytes。(1) 資料率 = (40×100 + 60×20 + 20×1)×4 = 20,880 B/s，每天約 1.80 GB，每年約 659 GB。(2) 關心的最高模態約 3 Hz，若要求相位誤差 ≤ 1°，Δt ≤ 1/(360×3) ≈ 0.93 ms，一般網路校時不夠，需 GNSS 授時或 IEEE 1588 同步。(3) 以每小時判斷一次的殘差警戒，3σ 每年約 23.7 次誤報、4σ 約 0.55 次，選擇以 3σ 作為注意級、4σ 作為警告級。(4) 遠端節點耗電 5 W，需 720 Wh 電池與 50 W 太陽板。(5) 若改變一個輸入：加速度改以 200 Hz 取樣，資料率增為 36,880 B/s，每天約 3.19 GB，儲存與傳輸成本約增加 77%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的監測設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: plan a monitoring network for a teaching cable-stayed bridge with 40 acceleration channels at 100 Hz, 60 strain channels at 20 Hz and 20 temperature channels at 1 Hz, 4 bytes per sample. (1) Data rate = (40×100 + 60×20 + 20×1)×4 = 20,880 B/s, about 1.80 GB a day and about 659 GB a year. (2) The highest mode of interest is about 3 Hz; a phase error of no more than 1° needs Δt ≤ 1/(360×3) ≈ 0.93 ms, which ordinary network time cannot deliver, so GNSS timing or IEEE 1588 synchronisation is required. (3) With hourly residual checks, 3σ gives about 23.7 false alarms a year and 4σ about 0.55, so 3σ is used for the notice level and 4σ for the warning level. (4) A remote node drawing 5 W needs a 720 Wh battery and a 50 W panel. (5) Changing one input: sampling acceleration at 200 Hz raises the rate to 36,880 B/s, about 3.19 GB a day, increasing storage and transmission by about 77%. Values are teaching assumptions, not the monitoring design of any real bridge.

title: 橋梁動態荷重試驗
summary: 從車輛動力效應與人群同步振動出發，說明試驗載重與預期反應的計算、儀器與取樣率、趟次矩陣與封橋安全、強迫振動與人群試驗、動力放大與頻率判讀、以試驗修正係數更新評等，以及舒適度改善與基準交接，並以倫敦千禧橋的人群試驗與阻尼改造、雪梨港灣大橋 1932 年的機車載重試驗與 1940 年塔科馬海峽橋為對照。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一座 30 m 簡支鋼—混凝土組合梁橋，以 300 kN 試驗車做動態試驗。(1) 預測：M = 300×30/4 = 2,250 kN·m，最受力主梁分配 0.6 為 1,350 kN·m，S = 0.045 m³，σ = 30 MPa，ε_c = 150 με。(2) 實測：慢速峰值 ε_T = 120 με，80 km/h 三趟峰值的動力放大為 1.18、1.22、1.15，平均 1.183，95% 上限約 1.27，低於規範 1.33。(3) 頻率：模型 f = (π/2L²)√(EI/m) ≈ 4.51 Hz，實測 4.80 Hz，勁度比約 1.13。(4) 評等：K_a = 150/120 − 1 = 0.25，K_b 取 0.5，K = 1.125，RF 由 0.92 提升至約 1.04。(5) 若改變一個輸入：伸縮縫出現高差，使 80 km/h 峰值升為 168 με，DAF = 168/120 = 1.40，已超過規範的 1.33，這時不但不能以實測值放寬評等，還應先修復伸縮縫再重新試驗。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 30 m simply supported steel–concrete composite girder bridge is tested dynamically with a 300 kN truck. (1) Prediction: M = 300×30/4 = 2,250 kN·m, 0.6 of it to the most loaded girder gives 1,350 kN·m, S = 0.045 m³, σ = 30 MPa and ε_c = 150 με. (2) Measurement: the crawl peak is ε_T = 120 με, and three 80 km/h runs give amplifications of 1.18, 1.22 and 1.15, mean 1.183 and 95% upper bound about 1.27, below the code's 1.33. (3) Frequency: the model gives f = (π/2L²)√(EI/m) ≈ 4.51 Hz, the test 4.80 Hz, a stiffness ratio of about 1.13. (4) Rating: K_a = 150/120 − 1 = 0.25, K_b = 0.5, K = 1.125, so RF rises from 0.92 to about 1.04. (5) Changing one input: if a step develops at the expansion joint and the 80 km/h peak rises to 168 με, DAF = 168/120 = 1.40, above the code's 1.33, so the measured value cannot relax the rating and the joint should be repaired and the bridge retested first. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real bridge.

title: 自行式模組運輸車換橋
summary: 從整跨上部結構改由運輸車支承時的彎矩反轉出發，計算動態放大、軸線數量、臨時支撐塔穩定與行駛路徑地盤承載，再處理封閉時段時程、落梁行程與支承對位、移動中的應變與水平監測、地盤預壓試驗，最後檢核既有下部結構、評估用路人成本並交接，案例取自 FHWA 手冊中的佛州 I-4/Graves Avenue、荷蘭 Badhoevedorp A4/A5 與芝加哥 Wells Street 換橋。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一跨 40 m、總重 10,000 kN（w = 250 kN/m）的預力梁橋，以 SPMT 運輸，比較運輸支點內縮距離 a。a = 3.0 m：跨中彎矩 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m，梁端負彎矩含 15% 動態放大 1.15×250×3²/2 ≈ 1,294 kN·m；a = 4.5 m：跨中 250×31²/8 − 250×4.5²/2 = 27,500 kN·m，梁端 1.15×250×4.5²/2 ≈ 2,911 kN·m；a = 6.0 m：跨中 20,000 kN·m，梁端 ≈ 5,175 kN·m。若梁端頂緣容許的附加負彎矩上限為 3,000 kN·m，則 a ≤ √[2×3,000/(1.15×250)] ≈ 4.57 m，取 a = 4.5 m 以內。軸線數量以 (10,000 + 1,000)×1.15/235 ≈ 54 軸線、利用率 80% 時約 68 軸線計，選 72 軸線。若橋重因加裝護欄增加 5%，所需軸線變為 54×1.05/0.8 ≈ 71，仍在 72 軸線內但餘裕幾乎用盡。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 40 m prestressed span weighing 10,000 kN (w = 250 kN/m) is moved by SPMT, comparing the support inset a. For a = 3.0 m, midspan moment is 250×34²/8 − 250×3²/2 = 35,000 kN·m and the end hogging moment with 15% dynamic allowance is 1.15×250×3²/2 ≈ 1,294 kN·m; for a = 4.5 m, midspan 250×31²/8 − 250×4.5²/2 = 27,500 kN·m and end 1.15×250×4.5²/2 ≈ 2,911 kN·m; for a = 6.0 m, midspan 20,000 kN·m and end about 5,175 kN·m. If the girder-end top fibre can accept at most 3,000 kN·m of added hogging, a ≤ √[2×3,000/(1.15×250)] ≈ 4.57 m, so a is kept within 4.5 m. Axle lines: (10,000 + 1,000)×1.15/235 ≈ 54, about 68 at 80% utilisation, so 72 are chosen. If barriers add 5% to the weight, the need becomes 54×1.05/0.8 ≈ 71, still within 72 but with almost no margin. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.

title: 浮吊大型橋段吊裝
titleEn: Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments
summary: 從岸上預製、水上運送、整段吊裝的工法邏輯出發，計算吊索力、擺動週期與動態放大，再處理吊耳承壓、構件吊裝狀態受力、浮吊錨泊、落位時潮汐與吃水變化，接著以吊鉤荷重與重心量測、天候窗口與預報係數驗證，最後處理吊孔封填、吊耳移除後的疲勞與交接紀錄，並以聯邦大橋的 Svanen 雙體浮吊、舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段與新 Tappan Zee 橋的剪腿式浮吊為案例。
summaryEn: Starting from the logic of prefabricating on shore, transporting over water and lifting whole segments, compute sling forces, swing periods and dynamic amplification, then handle lug bearing, the lifted-state behaviour of members, crane-barge mooring and tide and draft changes at set-down, verify with hook-load and centre-of-gravity measurements, weather windows and forecast factors, and finally treat lifting-hole sealing, fatigue after lug removal and handover records, with the Svanen catamaran at Confederation Bridge and the shear-leg crane at the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge east span and the new Tappan Zee crossing as cases.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 吊裝規劃練習：一件預製橋段靜重 15,000 kN，重量裕度 5%，吊具與吊梁 400 kN，動態放大係數 1.10，則吊鉤設計荷重 = (15,000×1.05 + 400)×1.10 = (15,750 + 400)×1.10 ≈ 17,765 kN，約 17,765/9.81 ≈ 1,811 t。若浮吊在所需工作半徑的額定容量為 2,000 t，利用率約 0.91；但若因墩旁水深不足必須退後，工作半徑加大使額定容量降為 1,800 t，利用率升為約 1.01，超過容許值。可行對策包括：浚深或改用定位樁縮短半徑、改用較輕的吊梁、把構件分成較輕的兩段，或改在流速較低的平潮時段以較小動態放大係數作業（需經海事保證審查）。另以 30 m 吊索的擺動週期約 11 s 檢查是否接近預報的波浪週期。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際工程的吊裝計畫。
workedExample.textEn: Lift-planning exercise: a prefabricated segment has a static weight of 15,000 kN, a 5% weight contingency, 400 kN of rigging and spreader, and a dynamic amplification factor of 1.10, so the design hook load is (15,000×1.05 + 400)×1.10 = (15,750 + 400)×1.10 ≈ 17,765 kN, about 17,765/9.81 ≈ 1,811 t. If the crane's rated capacity at the required radius is 2,000 t, utilisation is about 0.91; but if shallow water beside the pier forces the vessel to stand off, the larger radius drops capacity to 1,800 t and utilisation rises to about 1.01, beyond the allowable. Options include dredging or using spuds to shorten the radius, a lighter spreader, splitting the member into two lighter pieces, or working at slack water with a smaller dynamic factor subject to marine warranty review. The 30 m rigging's swing period of about 11 s should also be checked against the forecast wave period. Values are teaching assumptions, not the lift plan of any real project.

title: 高層建築核心筒滑模施工
summary: 滑模把核心筒牆體當成一條不停的生產線：約 1.2 m 高的模板由千斤頂沿爬桿每隔數分鐘上升一小段，下緣出模的混凝土必須已能自立，上方同時綁紮鋼筋、安裝埋件並澆置。本課以 CN Tower、ThyssenKrupp 羅特魏爾試驗塔與亞特蘭大電梯試驗塔為例，說明滑升速度與凝結時間、爬桿挫屈、埋件協調、垂直度與扭轉控制、冷縫與養護、以及竣工紀錄。
summaryEn: Slipforming turns a core wall into a non-stop production line: forms about 1.2 m high are jacked up rods a small step every few minutes, concrete leaving the bottom edge must already stand on its own, and above it crews fix rebar, set embeds and place concrete at the same time. Using the CN Tower, the ThyssenKrupp test tower in Rottweil and the elevator test tower in Atlanta, the course covers slip rate versus setting time, climbing-rod buckling, embed coordination, verticality and twist control, cold joints and curing, and as-built records.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 規劃練習：一座 120 m 高的核心筒，牆體總長 150 m、厚 0.4 m，以滑模施工。模板高 1.2 m、頂部預留 0.2 m，20°C 時初凝 4 h，容許速度上限 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h，採用 0.10 m/h 保留裕度；日升 2.4 m，純滑升 120/2.4 = 50 天，加上 3 次計畫停機各 1 天，約 53 天。混凝土供應 150×0.4×0.10 = 6.0 m³/h，全程約 150×0.4×120 = 7,200 m³。平台荷重約 4,055 kN，爬桿 48.3×4 mm 在 1.5 m 無支撐長的容許荷重約 48 kN，需約 84 支千斤頂。若改在冬季施工，成熟度要求使速度降為約 0.067 m/h：純滑升 120/(0.067×24) ≈ 75 天，供料降為約 4.0 m³/h，工期增加約 25 天，但千斤頂數量不變。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的施工計畫。
workedExample.textEn: Planning exercise: a 120 m core with 150 m of wall at 0.4 m thick is slipformed. With 1.2 m forms and 0.2 m freeboard and initial set at 4 h at 20°C, the upper rate limit is 1.0/4 = 0.25 m/h, and 0.10 m/h is chosen for margin; the core rises 2.4 m a day, so sliding takes 120/2.4 = 50 days, about 53 days with three planned one-day stops. Concrete supply is 150×0.4×0.10 = 6.0 m³/h, about 150×0.4×120 = 7,200 m³ in total. Deck load is about 4,055 kN and a 48.3×4 mm rod with 1.5 m unbraced length allows about 48 kN, so about 84 jacks are needed. In winter the maturity requirement cuts the rate to about 0.067 m/h: sliding takes 120/(0.067×24) ≈ 75 days, supply falls to about 4.0 m³/h and the programme grows by about 25 days, while the number of jacks is unchanged. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building's construction plan.

title: 高層建築液壓爬模施工
summary: 液壓自動爬模與滑模不同：每層混凝土澆置後先硬化，再由油壓缸把模板與多層工作平台沿爬升軌道推到上一層，荷載經由預埋錨錐傳入早齡牆體。本課以哈里發塔的 226 組自爬單元與 3 天樓層循環、樂天世界塔的核心筒與巨柱爬模為例，說明循環時程、錨點荷載路徑、油壓機構、模板側壓、平台荷重、爬升停檢點、早齡強度驗收、同步監測、錨孔處理與拆除交接。
summaryEn: Hydraulic automatic climbing forms differ from slipforms: each lift of concrete hardens first, then hydraulic cylinders push the forms and multi-level working platforms along climbing rails to the next storey, with loads passing through cast-in anchor cones into young walls. Using the 226 self-climbing units and three-day floor cycle at Burj Khalifa and the core and megacolumn climbing forms at Lotte World Tower, the course covers cycle time, the anchor load path, hydraulics, form pressure, platform loads, climbing hold points, early-strength acceptance, synchronisation monitoring, anchor-hole treatment and dismantling handover.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 規劃練習：一座 180 層次澆置、每層 3.7 m 的核心筒採用自動爬模。標準循環 72 h，總計 180×3 = 540 天。每個爬升單元垂直荷載 60 kN、偏心 1.2 m，錨點水平力偶 36 kN；錨點拉拔基本強度在 10 MPa 時約 58 kN，因此放行強度訂為 10 MPa。油壓缸缸徑 125 mm、油壓 32 MPa，推力約 393 kN，爬升 3.7 m、速度 0.2 m/min 約 18.5 min。牆模側壓以 R = 2 m/h、20°C 計約 48.7 kPa，繫結 1.2 m 間距時每支約 70 kN。冬季時早齡強度在 20 h 只有約 8.0 MPa，若每層需再等 6.6 h，循環變為約 78.6 h，180 層多出約 180×6.6/24 ≈ 50 天；若改用自充填混凝土，側壓升為約 88.8 kPa，繫結力增為約 128 kN，模板與繫結必須重新設計。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的施工計畫。
workedExample.textEn: Planning exercise: a core cast in 180 lifts of 3.7 m uses automatic climbing forms. The standard cycle is 72 h, so 180×3 = 540 days in total. Each climbing unit carries 60 kN at 1.2 m eccentricity, giving a 36 kN anchor couple; the basic anchor pull-out strength at 10 MPa is about 58 kN, so the release strength is set at 10 MPa. A 125 mm cylinder at 32 MPa gives about 393 kN and climbs 3.7 m at 0.2 m/min in about 18.5 min. Wall-form pressure at R = 2 m/h and 20°C is about 48.7 kPa, about 70 kN per tie at 1.2 m spacing. In winter, early strength at 20 h is only about 8.0 MPa; waiting another 6.6 h each storey stretches the cycle to about 78.6 h and adds about 180×6.6/24 ≈ 50 days over 180 lifts. Switching to self-consolidating concrete raises pressure to about 88.8 kPa and tie force to about 128 kN, so forms and ties must be redesigned. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building's construction plan.

title: 巨型柱—外伸臂結構系統
summary: 以台北 101、哈里發塔與上海中心為例，從外伸臂約束核心轉角的旋轉彈簧模型與單道外伸臂的最佳高度出發，處理巨柱有效長度與樓板支撐力、外伸桁架穿入核心牆的力傳遞，再到差異縮短與延遲鎖定、雙層高桁架的焊接收縮、應變監測回推勁度、阻尼外伸臂，最後是外伸臂樓層的改裝管控與長期徐變監測。
summaryEn: Using Taipei 101, Burj Khalifa and Shanghai Tower as examples, start from the rotational-spring model of how outriggers restrain core rotation and from the optimum level of a single outrigger, handle mega-column effective length and floor bracing forces and force transfer where outrigger trusses enter core walls, then differential shortening and delayed lock-off, weld shrinkage in two-storey trusses, strain monitoring to back-calculate stiffness and damped outriggers, ending with alteration control on outrigger floors and long-term creep monitoring.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 單道外伸臂設計練習：某 300 m 高樓的核心筒 EI = 7.0×10¹³ N·m²，均布風載 w = 150 kN/m，只有核心時頂部位移 Δ₀ = wH⁴/(8EI) = 150,000×300⁴/(8×7.0×10¹³) ≈ 2.17 m。兩側巨柱群各 EA = 1.4×10¹¹ N、間距 d = 40 m。外伸臂放在離地 a = 165 m 時，以 M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²)) 求得回復彎矩約 2.29 GN·m，每側巨柱群軸力約 2.29×10⁹/40 ≈ 57 MN，頂部位移減少約 54%，剩約 1.00 m。若改放頂部，只減少約 41%（剩約 1.28 m）；若巨柱軸向勁度減半，最佳位置仍在約 0.54H，但減少量降為約 39%（剩約 1.32 m）。這說明外伸臂的高度與巨柱勁度同樣重要，而且在這個簡化模型中最佳高度與柱勁度無關。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Single-outrigger exercise: a 300 m tower has a core with EI = 7.0×10¹³ N·m² and a uniform wind load w = 150 kN/m, so the core alone drifts Δ₀ = wH⁴/(8EI) = 150,000×300⁴/(8×7.0×10¹³) ≈ 2.17 m at the top. The mega-column groups on each side have EA = 1.4×10¹¹ N and are d = 40 m apart. With the outrigger at a = 165 m, M = θ_w(a)/(a/EI + 2a/(EA·d²)) gives a restoring moment of about 2.29 GN·m and a column-group force of about 2.29×10⁹/40 ≈ 57 MN, cutting top drift by about 54% to about 1.00 m. Placed at the top it cuts only about 41%, leaving about 1.28 m; with column axial stiffness halved the optimum stays near 0.54H but the reduction falls to about 39%, leaving about 1.32 m. Outrigger level and column stiffness therefore matter equally, and in this simplified model the optimum level does not depend on column stiffness. title: 高層建築斜交網格結構
summary: 以紐約赫斯特大樓、倫敦聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號與廣州國際金融中心為例，從斜柱角度如何在剪力與彎曲勁度之間取捨、樓板如何以環向拉力平衡斜柱外推力出發，處理螺栓與焊接節點、鋼管混凝土斜柱，再到斜柱逐層安裝的穩定與測量控制、節點原型試驗、以實測週期驗證勁度，最後是外露斜柱的耐火防蝕與改裝管控。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 斜交網格初步選角練習：某高 180 m、平面 36 m 見方的辦公塔，以 4 層一組的斜交網格抵抗側力，每個面有 n = 6 根斜柱，設計基底剪力 V = 10 MN、均布風載下基底彎矩 M = V·H/2 = 10×180/2 = 900 MN·m。剪力由兩個腹面承擔：斜柱軸力 N_s = V/(2n·cosθ)；彎矩由翼面以力偶承擔：翼面合力 F = M/B = 900/36 = 25 MN，每根斜柱垂直分量 25/6 ≈ 4.17 MN，軸力 N_b = 4.17/sinθ。θ = 69° 時 N_s ≈ 10/(12×0.358) ≈ 2.33 MN、N_b ≈ 4.46 MN；θ = 60° 時 N_s ≈ 1.67 MN、N_b ≈ 4.81 MN。以容許應力 207 MPa 估算，69° 時彎曲控制的斜柱需約 21,600 mm²、剪力只需約 11,200 mm²；改為 60° 時彎曲需求增加約 8% 至約 23,200 mm²，剪力需求降為約 8,100 mm²。細長塔由彎曲控制，因此較陡的角度通常較省鋼；若建築改為更矮胖的比例，剪力比重上升，最佳角度就會變平。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Preliminary diagrid angle study: a 180 m office tower, 36 m square, resists lateral load with a four-storey diagrid of n = 6 diagonals per face; the design base shear is V = 10 MN and under uniform wind the base moment is M = V·H/2 = 10×180/2 = 900 MN·m. Shear is carried by the two web faces, giving diagonal force N_s = V/(2n·cosθ); the moment is carried as a couple by the flange faces, with a flange resultant F = M/B = 900/36 = 25 MN, a vertical component of 25/6 ≈ 4.17 MN per diagonal and axial force N_b = 4.17/sinθ. At θ = 69°, N_s ≈ 10/(12×0.358) ≈ 2.33 MN and N_b ≈ 4.46 MN; at θ = 60°, N_s ≈ 1.67 MN and N_b ≈ 4.81 MN. At an allowable stress of 207 MPa, the bending-governed diagonal at 69° needs about 21,600 mm² while shear needs only about 11,200 mm²; at 60° the bending demand rises about 8% to about 23,200 mm² and the shear demand falls to about 8,100 mm². A slender tower is governed by bending, so steeper angles usually save steel; a squatter building, with shear more important, would favour a flatter optimum. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

title: 束筒高層結構系統

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 剪力滯後與抗傾覆練習：某鋼構框架筒翼面寬 68.6 m，翼面共 16 支柱、每支 0.06 m²，角柱容許應力 200 MPa。以力偶近似抗傾覆能力 M ≈ η·σ_c·ΣA·B。單一大筒中央與角柱應力比 r = 0.4，η = 1 − (2/3)(0.6) = 0.60，M ≈ 0.60×200×10⁶×(16×0.06)×68.6 ≈ 7.9 GN·m；改為 3×3 束筒，內部腹框使 r 提高到 0.85，η = 0.90，M ≈ 11.9 GN·m，增加約 50%。若窗間梁變淺使單筒 r 降到 0.3，η ≈ 0.53，M 只剩約 7.0 GN·m。也就是說，在角柱應力相同的前提下，束筒的內部腹框把同樣的鋼柱變成更有效的抗傾覆力偶；代價是內部多了框架線，影響平面使用。數值為教學假設，不代表威利斯大樓的設計值。
workedExample.textEn: Shear lag and overturning exercise: a steel framed tube has a 68.6 m flange with 16 columns of 0.06 m² each and an allowable corner stress of 200 MPa. Approximating overturning resistance as a couple, M ≈ η·σ_c·ΣA·B. For a single large tube with a centre-to-corner ratio r = 0.4, η = 1 − (2/3)(0.6) = 0.60 and M ≈ 0.60×200×10⁶×(16×0.06)×68.6 ≈ 7.9 GN·m; as a 3×3 bundle whose interior webs raise r to 0.85, η = 0.90 and M ≈ 11.9 GN·m, about 50% more. If shallower spandrels drop the single tube's r to 0.3, η ≈ 0.53 and M falls to about 7.0 GN·m. For the same corner stress, then, the bundle's interior webs turn the same steel columns into a more effective overturning couple, at the price of extra interior frame lines that affect floor planning. Values are teaching assumptions, not Willis Tower's design values.

title: 高層建築調諧質量阻尼器
titleEn: Tuned mass dampers for tall buildings
summary: 從超高層的橫風向渦流振動與居住舒適度出發，建立主結構模態與擺錘的雙自由度模型，依 Den Hartog 準則決定調頻與阻尼，再處理數百公噸質量塊的吊裝、現場調頻、阻尼器試驗、行程限制與長期監測，最後以台北 101 與上海中心大廈的實例比較油壓與渦電流兩種耗能方式。
summaryEn: Starting from across-wind vortex shedding and occupant comfort in supertall towers, build a two-degree-of-freedom model of the building mode and pendulum, set tuning and damping with the Den Hartog criteria, then handle the erection of a mass of several hundred tonnes, on-site tuning, damper testing, stroke limits and long-term monitoring, comparing hydraulic and eddy-current dissipation through Taipei 101 and Shanghai Tower.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某超高層第一模態 f₁ = 0.140 Hz、結構阻尼 ζ_s = 1%、頂部廣義質量 M* = 100,000 t，選用 m_d = 660 t 擺錘。質量比 μ = 660/100,000 = 0.0066；最佳頻率比 f_opt = 1/(1+μ) = 0.9934，阻尼器頻率 f_d = 0.140×0.9934 ≈ 0.139 Hz；最佳阻尼比 ζ_d = √[3μ/(8(1+μ)³)] = √[0.0198/8.159] ≈ 0.049；擺長 L = g/(2πf_d)² = 9.81/0.763 ≈ 12.9 m；阻尼係數 c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d ≈ 2×0.049×660,000×0.873 ≈ 56,500 N·s/m。以雙自由度模型掃頻，共振放大由 1/(2×0.01) = 50 降到約 13.6，相當於等效阻尼約 3.7%，風致加速度約降為原來的 √(1%/3.7%) ≈ 52%。若頻率偏離 5%，等效阻尼只剩約 2.1%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a supertall tower has f₁ = 0.140 Hz, structural damping ζ_s = 1% and a top generalised mass M* = 100,000 t, and a 660 t pendulum is chosen. The mass ratio is μ = 660/100,000 = 0.0066; the optimum frequency ratio is f_opt = 1/(1+μ) = 0.9934, so f_d = 0.140×0.9934 ≈ 0.139 Hz; the optimum damping ratio is ζ_d = √[3μ/(8(1+μ)³)] = √[0.0198/8.159] ≈ 0.049; the pendulum length is L = g/(2πf_d)² = 9.81/0.763 ≈ 12.9 m; the damping coefficient is c_d = 2ζ_d·m_d·ω_d ≈ 2×0.049×660,000×0.873 ≈ 56,500 N·s/m. A two-degree-of-freedom sweep lowers the resonant amplification from 1/(2×0.01) = 50 to about 13.6, equivalent to about 3.7% damping, so wind-induced acceleration falls to roughly √(1%/3.7%) ≈ 52% of the original. A 5% frequency offset leaves only about 2.1% equivalent damping. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某住宅塔樓第一模態 f₁ = 0.20 Hz、結構阻尼 1.5%、頂部廣義質量 M* = 30,000 t，目標有效質量比 μ = 1.5%，即 m_eff = 450 t。選用內淨長 L = 6.0 m、水深 h = 0.60 m 的淺水槽：ω² = (πg/L)·tanh(πh/L) = 5.137×0.304 ≈ 1.563 rad²/s²，f ≈ 0.199 Hz；第一晃動模態參與比例 8·tanh(πh/L)/(π³·h/L) = 8×0.304/3.10 ≈ 0.785，故總水量約 450/0.785 ≈ 573 t。每槽 6 m × 4 m × 0.60 m = 14.4 m³，40 槽共 576 m³。若加裝後總阻尼達 4.0%，均方根加速度約降為 √(1.5/4.0) ≈ 61%。若完工實測 f₁ 只有 0.185 Hz，水深須降到約 0.50 m，水量減為約 479 m³，有效質量比只剩約 1.26%，必須增至約 48 槽才能回到原目標。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a residential tower has f₁ = 0.20 Hz, 1.5% structural damping and a top generalised mass M* = 30,000 t, with a target effective mass ratio μ = 1.5%, so m_eff = 450 t. Choose shallow tanks with internal length L = 6.0 m and water depth h = 0.60 m: ω² = (πg/L)·tanh(πh/L) = 5.137×0.304 ≈ 1.563 rad²/s², so f ≈ 0.199 Hz; the first-mode participation ratio 8·tanh(πh/L)/(π³·h/L) = 8×0.304/3.10 ≈ 0.785, so the total water is about 450/0.785 ≈ 573 t. Each tank holds 6 m × 4 m × 0.60 m = 14.4 m³, and 40 tanks hold 576 m³. If total damping reaches 4.0% with the dampers, RMS acceleration falls to about √(1.5/4.0) ≈ 61%. If the completed building measures only 0.185 Hz, the depth must drop to about 0.50 m, the water to about 479 m³ and the effective mass ratio to about 1.26%, so about 48 tanks are needed to restore the target. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 驗收練習：規格 C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4、α = 0.4。出廠試驗以振幅 u₀ = 50 mm、頻率 f = 1.0 Hz 的正弦位移進行，尖峰速度 v = 2π×1.0×0.05 ≈ 0.314 m/s，預期尖峰力 F = 1,500×0.314^0.4 ≈ 944 kN。非線性阻尼器每循環耗能 E = λ·C·u₀^(1+α)·ω^α，α = 0.4 時 λ ≈ 3.58，E ≈ 3.58×1,500×0.0151×2.09 ≈ 169 kJ。若量得迴圈面積 152 kJ，偏差 −10%，在 ±15% 內可允收；若只有 140 kJ（約 −17%）則不合格。若改用在 0.314 m/s 時同樣出力的線性阻尼器（C ≈ 3,005 kN·s/m），每循環耗能 π·F·u₀ ≈ 148 kJ；速度加倍到 0.628 m/s 時線性阻尼器力約 1,888 kN，α = 0.4 的阻尼器只有約 1,246 kN，斜撐與接頭的設計力相差約 34%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際產品或專案。
workedExample.textEn: Acceptance exercise: the specification is C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4 and α = 0.4. A production test uses sinusoidal displacement with amplitude u₀ = 50 mm at f = 1.0 Hz, so peak velocity is v = 2π×1.0×0.05 ≈ 0.314 m/s and the expected peak force is F = 1,500×0.314^0.4 ≈ 944 kN. A nonlinear damper dissipates E = λ·C·u₀^(1+α)·ω^α per cycle, with λ ≈ 3.58 for α = 0.4, so E ≈ 3.58×1,500×0.0151×2.09 ≈ 169 kJ. A measured loop area of 152 kJ is −10% and acceptable within ±15%; 140 kJ (about −17%) fails. A linear damper giving the same force at 0.314 m/s (C ≈ 3,005 kN·s/m) dissipates π·F·u₀ ≈ 148 kJ per cycle; if velocity doubles to 0.628 m/s the linear damper produces about 1,888 kN while the α = 0.4 damper produces about 1,246 kN, a difference of about 34% in brace and connection design force. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real product or project.

title: 高強度混凝土高程泵送
summary: 超高層核心筒與巨柱的混凝土多以泵送輸送，600 m 的垂直高度本身就產生約 14 MPa 的靜壓，再加上高強度混凝土黏度高造成的管壁摩擦，泵機出口壓力可達 20 至 30 MPa 級。本課以哈里發塔 2008 年 606 m 的垂直泵送紀錄、上海中心大廈約 580 m 的泵送、平安金融中心以 C100 泵送至 555.5 m 等案例，說明壓力組成、潤滑層流變、高壓管與接頭、泵機功率、管線固定、開泵與清管、可泵性試驗、溫度與坍流度監測、磨耗檢測與強度追溯。
summaryEn: Concrete for supertall cores and megacolumns is mostly pumped; a vertical lift of 600 m alone creates about 14 MPa of static head, and wall friction from viscous high-strength mixes pushes pump outlet pressures into the 20 to 30 MPa range. Using Burj Khalifa's 2008 vertical pumping record of 606 m, pumping to about 580 m at Shanghai Tower and C100 concrete pumped to 555.5 m at Ping An Finance Center, the course covers pressure components, lubrication-layer rheology, high-pressure pipes and couplings, pump power, line fixing, start-up and flushing, pumpability testing, temperature and slump-flow monitoring, wear inspection and strength traceability.

workedExample.text: 計算練習：以 125 mm 管徑把高強度混凝土泵送到 600 m 高，總管長 700 m、10 個彎管、排量 40 m³/h。靜壓 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa；摩擦梯度由試驗迴路量得 0.0106 MPa/m，700 m 約 7.4 MPa；彎管 1.0 MPa；總泵壓約 22.8 MPa。管內流速 0.0111/0.0123 ≈ 0.91 m/s；水力功率 22.8×10⁶×0.0111 ≈ 253 kW，效率 0.75 時引擎約 338 kW。以 D = 150 mm、容許應力 300 MPa 計，所需壁厚 22.8×150/600 ≈ 5.7 mm，取 10 mm 新管保留磨耗裕度。若為提高強度使界面黏度加倍，摩擦梯度升到 0.0202 MPa/m，總泵壓約 29.5 MPa，功率約 328 kW、引擎約 437 kW，所需壁厚增為約 7.4 mm，磨耗裕度與管件壽命都大幅縮短，可能需要改用接力泵或調整配比。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。
workedExample.textEn: Calculation exercise: high-strength concrete is pumped through a 125 mm line to 600 m, with 700 m of line, ten bends and 40 m³/h output. Static head is 2,450×9.81×600 ≈ 14.4 MPa; the loop-measured friction gradient of 0.0106 MPa/m gives about 7.4 MPa over 700 m; bends add 1.0 MPa; total pressure is about 22.8 MPa. Line velocity is 0.0111/0.0123 ≈ 0.91 m/s; hydraulic power is 22.8×10⁶×0.0111 ≈ 253 kW, about 338 kW of engine at 0.75 efficiency. With D = 150 mm and 300 MPa allowable stress, the required wall is 22.8×150/600 ≈ 5.7 mm, so 10 mm new pipe keeps a wear allowance. If interface viscosity doubles to gain strength, friction rises to 0.0202 MPa/m and total pressure to about 29.5 MPa, power to about 328 kW and engine to about 437 kW, and the required wall to about 7.4 mm, sharply shortening wear allowance and pipe life, so a relay pump or a mix adjustment may be needed. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.

title: 巨厚筏基水化熱控制
titleEn: Hydration-heat control in massive raft foundations
summary: 超高層的筏基厚達數公尺、一次連續澆置數萬立方公尺，水泥水化放出的熱量幾乎全部困在核心，表面卻持續散熱，造成高溫與內外溫差。本課以上海中心大廈約 6 萬 m³ 的連續澆置、天津高銀金融 117 的 65,000 m³ 筏基與洛杉磯 Wilshire Grand Center 的約 5.5 m 厚筏基為例，說明溫升估算、約束應力、低熱配比、冷卻管、連續供料與分層、保溫養護、熱電偶監測、模型校正、延遲鈣礬石風險與溫控紀錄交接。
summaryEn: Supertall rafts are several metres thick and placed continuously in tens of thousands of cubic metres; hydration heat is trapped almost entirely in the core while the surfaces keep losing heat, creating high temperatures and core-to-surface differentials. Using Shanghai Tower's continuous pour of about 60,000 m³, the 65,000 m³ raft of Goldin Finance 117 in Tianjin and the raft about 5.5 m thick at Wilshire Grand Center in Los Angeles, the course covers temperature-rise estimates, restraint stresses, low-heat mixes, cooling pipes, continuous supply and layering, insulated curing, thermocouple monitoring, model calibration, delayed ettringite risk and handover of thermal-control records.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：筏基面積 8,000 m²、厚 6 m，總量 48,000 m³，以 1,000 m³/h 連續澆置約 48 h。配比 B（水泥 230、飛灰 100、爐石 120 kg/m³）絕熱溫升 ΔT_ad = 144,600/2,400 ≈ 60.3°C，6 m 厚核心散熱時間約 104 天，取核心達到絕熱溫升的 90%。澆置溫度 15°C 時預測峰值 15 + 0.9×60.3 ≈ 69.2°C，低於 70°C；表面加 50 mm 保溫毯使散熱由 350 W/m² 降到約 26 W/m²，預測溫差控制在 15°C，約束應力 0.5×25,000×10⁻⁵×15 ≈ 1.88 MPa，裂縫指數 2.2/1.88 ≈ 1.17。若改用配比 A（水泥 450 kg/m³），ΔT_ad ≈ 78.8°C，同樣 15°C 澆置時峰值約 85.9°C，超過限值 15.9°C，即使把澆置溫度預冷到 5°C 仍有約 75.9°C，必須改配比或加冷卻管。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a raft of 8,000 m² and 6 m thickness holds 48,000 m³, placed continuously at 1,000 m³/h in about 48 h. Mix B (cement 230, fly ash 100, slag 120 kg/m³) has ΔT_ad = 144,600/2,400 ≈ 60.3°C; the 6 m core needs about 104 days to cool, so take the core reaching 90% of adiabatic rise. At a placing temperature of 15°C the predicted peak is 15 + 0.9×60.3 ≈ 69.2°C, below 70°C; a 50 mm blanket cuts surface loss from 350 W/m² to about 26 W/m² and keeps the predicted differential at 15°C, giving a restraint stress of 0.5×25,000×10⁻⁵×15 ≈ 1.88 MPa and a cracking index of 2.2/1.88 ≈ 1.17. With mix A (cement 450 kg/m³), ΔT_ad ≈ 78.8°C and the peak at 15°C placing is about 85.9°C, 15.9°C over the limit; even pre-cooling to 5°C leaves about 75.9°C, so the mix must change or cooling pipes be added. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：超高層巨型箱型柱 800×800 mm、板厚 60 mm，以全滲透焊做現場續接。(1) 受力：柱在風載下承受拉力 15 MN，斷面積 4×(800 − 60)×60 = 177,600 mm²，平均拉應力 15×10⁶/177,600 ≈ 84.5 MPa。(2) 材料：CE ≈ 0.44、板厚 60 mm，教學假設採最低預熱 110°C、層間溫度上限 230°C；以 30 V、300 A、300 mm/min 施焊，熱輸入 1.8 kJ/mm，須落在 WPS 範圍內。(3) 收縮：A_w = 1,300 mm²，每個續接約 4.5 mm，20 個續接約 90 mm，於柱段長度中預留。(4) 檢驗：70° 斜角探頭在 60 mm 板第一跨聲程約 175 mm；400 道焊縫抽驗 40 道、拒收 3 道，拒收率 7.5% 超過 5%，全面補驗其餘 360 道。(5) 若改變一個輸入：抽驗只拒收 1 道（2.5%），可維持 10% 抽驗，但拒收焊縫仍要追溯銲工並修補後複檢。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a supertall mega box column 800×800 mm with 60 mm plates is spliced on site with CJP welds. (1) Demand: the column carries 15 MN of wind tension over an area of 4×(800 − 60)×60 = 177,600 mm², a mean tensile stress of 15×10⁶/177,600 ≈ 84.5 MPa. (2) Material: with CE ≈ 0.44 and 60 mm plate, the teaching assumption is a minimum preheat of 110°C and a maximum interpass temperature of 230°C; welding at 30 V, 300 A and 300 mm/min gives a heat input of 1.8 kJ/mm, which must lie within the WPS range. (3) Shrinkage: with A_w = 1,300 mm², each splice shrinks about 4.5 mm and 20 splices about 90 mm, allowed for in segment lengths. (4) Inspection: a 70° angle probe needs a first-leg sound path of about 175 mm in 60 mm plate; sampling 40 of 400 welds finds 3 rejects, a 7.5% rate above 5%, so the remaining 360 are all tested. (5) Changing one input: with only 1 reject (2.5%) the 10% sampling can continue, but the rejected weld is still traced to its welder, repaired and re-tested. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某鋼構支撐續接需傳遞使用剪力 900 kN，採 7/8 in A325 螺栓、雙剪面、標準孔。(1) 最低預拉 T_b = 0.70×120 ksi×0.462 in² ≈ 39 kips ≈ 173 kN。(2) 接觸面採噴砂 Class B（μ = 0.50）：每支 2×0.50×1.13×173 ≈ 195 kN，需 900/195 ≈ 4.6 支，為對稱配置取 6 支。(3) 螺栓長 4.5 in（約 114 mm），L/d ≈ 5.1，依轉角表介於 4d 與 8d 之間，密貼後轉 1/2 圈。(4) 安裝前驗證要求每組 ≥ 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN，三組 186、190、185 kN 均合格後才能開工。(5) 若改變一個輸入：接觸面誤塗面漆而只能以 Class A（μ = 0.30）計，每支只剩約 117 kN，需 900/117 ≈ 7.7 支，原本 6 支的接頭抗滑力約只有需求的 78%，須清除塗層或增加螺栓。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際結構。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a steel brace splice must carry 900 kN of service shear using 7/8 in A325 bolts in double shear with standard holes. (1) Minimum pretension T_b = 0.70×120 ksi×0.462 in² ≈ 39 kips ≈ 173 kN. (2) With blast-cleaned Class B faying surfaces (μ = 0.50), each bolt gives 2×0.50×1.13×173 ≈ 195 kN, needing 900/195 ≈ 4.6 bolts, so 6 are used for a symmetric layout. (3) The bolt length is 4.5 in (about 114 mm), L/d ≈ 5.1, between 4d and 8d in the turn-of-nut table, so the nut is turned 1/2 turn after snugging. (4) Pre-installation verification requires each assembly to reach at least 1.05×173 ≈ 181.7 kN; three assemblies at 186, 190 and 185 kN pass before work starts. (5) Changing one input: if the faying surfaces were painted by mistake and only Class A (μ = 0.30) can be counted, each bolt gives about 117 kN, needing 900/117 ≈ 7.7 bolts, so the six-bolt joint has only about 78% of the required slip resistance and the coating must be removed or bolts added. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real structure.

title: 組合樓板剪力釘焊接
titleEn: Stud welding for composite floor systems
summary: 從組合梁介面的水平剪力流與部分組合出發，說明頭釘強度與壓型鋼板肋的折減、穿板焊接的電流與環境條件、首件 30° 彎曲試驗與外觀檢查、推出試驗求取剪力釘強度，以及火災溫度效應與改修時的紀錄需求，並以 NIST 對世界貿易中心七號樓組合樓板的調查、雙子塔以桁架「指節」取得組合作用的樓板，以及英國鋼結構協會對穿板焊接的說明為依據。
summaryEn: Starting from horizontal shear flow and partial composite action at the beam–slab interface, explain headed-stud strength and its reduction in deck ribs, current and site conditions for through-deck welding, first-stud 30° bend tests and visual checks, push-out tests for stud resistance, and fire and thermal effects and record-keeping for alterations, drawing on NIST's investigation of the composite floors of 7 World Trade Center, the Twin Towers' floors made composite by truss knuckles, and steel-industry guidance on through-deck welding.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：12 m 簡支組合梁 W460×60（A_s = 7,590 mm²、F_y = 345 MPa），梁距 3 m，76 mm 高的壓型鋼板橫向鋪設、肋距 300 mm，樓板總厚 140 mm、f′c = 28 MPa，使用 19 mm 頭釘（F_u = 450 MPa）。(1) 完全組合所需剪力 C = min(7,590×345, 0.85×28×3,000×64) ≈ min(2,619, 4,570) = 2,619 kN。(2) 每肋 1 支、弱位置：Q_n = 0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN，半跨 20 個肋 ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN，組合比 58%；I_eff ≈ 255 + √0.58×(700 − 255) ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴，約為完全組合的 85%。(3) 焊後長度 125 mm，高出肋頂 49 mm，保護層 15 mm，皆滿足要求。(4) 若改變一個輸入：剪力釘全部焊在強位置（R_p = 0.75），每支約 95.7 kN，ΣQ_n ≈ 1,914 kN，組合比提高到約 73%，不必增加剪力釘數量就提高勁度與強度。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 12 m simply supported composite beam W460×60 (A_s = 7,590 mm², F_y = 345 MPa) at 3 m spacing carries a slab 140 mm thick on transverse 76 mm deck with ribs at 300 mm and f′c = 28 MPa, using 19 mm headed studs (F_u = 450 MPa). (1) Full composite shear C = min(7,590×345, 0.85×28×3,000×64) ≈ min(2,619, 4,570) = 2,619 kN. (2) One weak-position stud per rib: Q_n = 0.6×283.5×450 ≈ 76.5 kN, and 20 ribs per half span give ΣQ_n ≈ 1,531 kN, a 58% ratio; I_eff ≈ 255 + √0.58×(700 − 255) ≈ 595×10⁶ mm⁴, about 85% of full composite. (3) The welded stud of 125 mm projects 49 mm above the rib with 15 mm of cover, both acceptable. (4) Changing one input: welding every stud in the strong position (R_p = 0.75) gives about 95.7 kN each, ΣQ_n ≈ 1,914 kN and a ratio of about 73%, raising stiffness and strength without adding studs. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.

title: 高層建築差異縮短補償
summary: 超高層的柱與核心筒在重力、潛變與收縮下持續縮短，若兩者縮短量不同，樓板會傾斜，連接構件與外伸臂會鎖入附加力，帷幕牆與電梯也會被拉扯。本課從縮短的三個來源與「安裝後縮短」的觀念出發，談構件尺寸、鋼—混凝土混合系統、標高補償、延遲接合時機、振弦式應變計與測量回饋，到非結構構件的容許變形與竣工後的長期追蹤，並以樂天世界塔、哈里發塔與世界貿易中心一號大樓的公開做法為例。
summaryEn: In a supertall building, columns and cores keep shortening under gravity, creep and shrinkage; when they shorten by different amounts, floors tilt, connecting members and outriggers lock in extra forces, and façades and elevators are strained. Starting from the three sources of shortening and the idea of post-installation shortening, the course covers member size, steel–concrete hybrid systems, level compensation, timing of delayed connections, vibrating-wire gauges and survey feedback, then tolerances of non-structural elements and long-term tracking after completion, illustrated by public practice at Lotte World Tower, Burj Khalifa and One World Trade Center.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：判斷一棟混凝土塔樓下部 30 層（120 m）是否需要差異縮短補償。周邊柱平均 σ = 18 MPa、E = 40 GPa、φ = 1.6、因斷面大取 ε_sh = 150 με：ε = 450 + 720 + 150 = 1,320 με，縮短 1,320×10⁻⁶×120,000 ≈ 158 mm。核心牆平均 σ = 9 MPa、φ = 1.6、因牆薄取 ε_sh = 280 με：ε = 225 + 360 + 280 = 865 με，縮短約 104 mm。差異約 54.6 mm，若柱與核心相距 12 m，樓板坡度 54.6/12,000 ≈ 1/220，超過教學採用的 1/360 準則，需要補償。若把柱放大使 σ 降到 14 MPa，柱應變 350 + 560 + 150 = 1,060 με，縮短約 127 mm，差異約 23.4 mm，坡度約 1/513，即可符合。注意這是總縮短，實際補償應以安裝後縮短計算。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: decide whether the lower 30 storeys (120 m) of a concrete tower need differential-shortening compensation. Perimeter columns average σ = 18 MPa with E = 40 GPa, φ = 1.6 and, because of their size, ε_sh = 150 με: ε = 450 + 720 + 150 = 1,320 με, a shortening of 1,320×10⁻⁶×120,000 ≈ 158 mm. Core walls average σ = 9 MPa with φ = 1.6 and, being thin, ε_sh = 280 με: ε = 225 + 360 + 280 = 865 με, about 104 mm. The difference is about 54.6 mm; with columns 12 m from the core, the floor slope is 54.6/12,000 ≈ 1/220, beyond the 1/360 teaching criterion, so compensation is needed. Enlarging the columns to bring σ down to 14 MPa gives 350 + 560 + 150 = 1,060 με, about 127 mm, a difference of about 23.4 mm and a slope of about 1/513, which complies. Note these are total shortenings; actual compensation should be based on post-installation shortening. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.

title: 建築施工階段結構分析
summary: 完工結構的分析假設所有構件同時存在、荷重一次加上，但真實建築是一層層長出來的：混凝土在年輕時就被加載、接頭在不同時間鎖定、支撐被逐步拆除，許多內力在施工中被「鎖入」並留到營運期。本課從一次加載的誤差、施工期風荷載與早齡期材料、接頭狀態與溫差，到由上而下開挖、核心領先、監測回饋、接合前位移監測、鎖入應力與營運中改造，以中央電視台總部、碎片大廈、樂天世界塔與威利斯大樓的公開做法為例。
summaryEn: Analysis of a completed structure assumes all members exist at once and loads arrive in one step, but real buildings grow floor by floor: concrete is loaded young, joints are locked at different times, shores are removed in stages, and many forces are locked in during construction and remain in service. The course moves from the error of one-step loading, construction-period wind and early-age materials, joint states and temperature differences, to top-down excavation, core lead, monitoring feedback, pre-closure movement monitoring, locked-in stresses and alterations in occupied buildings, drawing on public practice at CCTV Headquarters, The Shard, Lotte World Tower and Willis Tower.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：檢核 7 天齡期樓板在上方新澆樓板與兩層連續支撐下是否安全。板厚 0.25 m，自重 0.25×25 = 6.25 kPa，模板 0.5 kPa，施工活載 1.5 kPa。依 Grundy–Kabaila 類型的分析，多層支撐系統中受載最大的樓板約承受 2.0 倍的（自重 + 模板），需求 = 2.0×6.75 + 1.5 = 15.0 kPa；完工服務荷重為 6.25 + 1.0（附加靜載）+ 2.5（活載）= 9.75 kPa，需求比 15.0/9.75 ≈ 1.54。ACI 209 強度發展 f′c(t)/f′c28 = t/(4 + 0.85t)，7 天約 0.70，衝剪強度隨 √f′c 約為 0.84。若設計服務利用率為 0.45，7 天時等效利用率 = 0.45×1.54/0.84 ≈ 0.83，可以接受；若改在 3 天就承載，強度比 0.46、√ 約 0.68，利用率 ≈ 0.45×1.54/0.68 ≈ 1.02，超過 1.0，必須延後拆撐或增加支撐層數。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: check whether a 7-day-old slab is safe under a newly cast slab above with two levels of continuous shoring. The slab is 0.25 m thick, self-weight 0.25×25 = 6.25 kPa, formwork 0.5 kPa and construction live load 1.5 kPa. Grundy–Kabaila-type analysis shows the most heavily loaded slab in a multi-level shoring system carries about 2.0 times (self-weight + formwork), so demand = 2.0×6.75 + 1.5 = 15.0 kPa; the completed service load is 6.25 + 1.0 superimposed dead + 2.5 live = 9.75 kPa, a demand ratio of 15.0/9.75 ≈ 1.54. ACI 209 strength gain is f′c(t)/f′c28 = t/(4 + 0.85t), about 0.70 at 7 days, so punching strength, varying with √f′c, is about 0.84. If the design service utilisation is 0.45, the equivalent utilisation at 7 days is 0.45×1.54/0.84 ≈ 0.83, acceptable; loading at 3 days instead gives a strength ratio of 0.46, √ about 0.68, and utilisation ≈ 0.45×1.54/0.68 ≈ 1.02, above 1.0, so striking must be delayed or more shore levels added. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.

title: 結構抗連鎖倒塌設計
summary: 從 Ronan Point、世界貿易中心 7 號大樓與 Champlain Towers South 的教訓出發，建立異常荷載的風險觀念與拆柱後的荷載重分配，學習拉結力法、板柱穿孔剪力與完整性鋼筋、懸鏈作用與接頭轉角，再談施工符合性、子結構試驗與能量法、既有建築腐蝕評估、火災熱膨脹觸發的倒塌，以及使用期間的荷載變更管理與交接。
summaryEn: Starting from the lessons of Ronan Point, World Trade Center 7 and Champlain Towers South, build the risk view of abnormal loads and the load redistribution after column loss, learn the tie-force method, slab–column punching shear and integrity reinforcement, catenary action and connection rotation, then cover construction conformance, subassembly tests and the energy method, corrosion assessment of existing buildings, fire-triggered collapse through thermal expansion, and load-change management and handover in service.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某鋼筋混凝土構架柱距 8 m，D = 6.0 kPa、L = 3.0 kPa。樓面荷載 w_F = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa。拉結力法：F_i = 3·w_F·L₁ = 3×8.7×8 ≈ 209 kN/m，取 f_y = 420 MPa、φ = 0.75，需 A_s ≈ 663 mm²/m。替代路徑：拆除一根內柱後，8 m 受載寬度的梁線荷載 w = 69.6 kN/m，跨度由 8 m 變 16 m，固端彎矩由約 371 kN·m 增為約 1,485 kN·m，乘動力放大 2.0 後約 2,970 kN·m，為原值 8 倍，一般梁斷面無法以抗彎承受。改用懸鏈作用：轉角 0.20 rad 時下垂 δ ≈ 1.62 m，拉力 T ≈ 69.6×16²/(8×1.62) ≈ 1,373 kN，小於 8 m 寬拉結筋總強度約 1,670 kN，但接頭必須在 0.20 rad 下仍能傳遞拉力，外柱也要承受同量級的內拉力。若跨度 L₁ 改為 10 m（受載寬度仍為 8 m），F_i 增為約 261 kN/m，拆柱後跨度 20 m，懸鏈拉力在相同轉角下約增為 1.25 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a reinforced-concrete frame on an 8 m grid carries D = 6.0 kPa and L = 3.0 kPa, so w_F = 1.2×6.0 + 0.5×3.0 = 8.7 kPa. Tie-force method: F_i = 3·w_F·L₁ = 3×8.7×8 ≈ 209 kN/m, needing A_s ≈ 663 mm²/m with f_y = 420 MPa and φ = 0.75. Alternate path: after removing an interior column, the beam line load over an 8 m tributary width is w = 69.6 kN/m and the span grows from 8 to 16 m, so the fixed-end moment rises from about 371 to about 1,485 kN·m and, with a dynamic amplification of 2.0, to about 2,970 kN·m, eight times the original and beyond what an ordinary beam section can resist in bending. Relying on catenary action instead: at 0.20 rad the sag is δ ≈ 1.62 m and the tension T ≈ 69.6×16²/(8×1.62) ≈ 1,373 kN, below the roughly 1,670 kN strength of ties across 8 m, provided the connections still carry tension at 0.20 rad and the perimeter columns resist an inward pull of the same order. If L₁ becomes 10 m with the tributary width kept at 8 m, F_i rises to about 261 kN/m, the post-loss span becomes 20 m and catenary tension at the same rotation grows by about 1.25 times. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

title: 既有建築基礎隔震改造
summary: 從鹽湖城市郡大樓、舊金山市政府與猶他州議會大廈的隔震改造出發，計算隔震後的週期、位移與扭轉放大，設計鉛心橡膠支承與後拉預力托換梁，再處理切柱頂升的荷載轉移、施工期間的地震風險、原型與出廠試驗、強震監測，最後談性質變化的上下限分析、隔震縫維護與交接。
summaryEn: Starting from the isolation retrofits of the Salt Lake City and County Building, San Francisco City Hall and the Utah State Capitol, compute isolated period, displacement and torsional amplification, design lead-rubber bearings and post-tensioned transfer girders, then handle load transfer by cutting and jacking, earthquake risk during construction, prototype and production tests and strong-motion monitoring, and finally upper- and lower-bound property analysis, moat maintenance and handover.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某歷史建築重 W = 216,000 kN，以 54 個鉛心橡膠支承隔震。單一支承：鉛心 150 mm、降伏應力 10 MPa，Q_d ≈ 177 kN；直徑 900 mm、橡膠總厚 200 mm、G = 0.4 MPa，K_d ≈ 1,237 kN/m。設計位移 D = 0.40 m 時 F ≈ 672 kN，K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m，β_eff ≈ 16%。系統 K ≈ 90,650 kN/m，T = 2π√(W/(g·K)) ≈ 3.1 s；以 S_D1 = 0.7、B = 1.35，D = g·S_D1·T/(4π²·B) ≈ 9.81×0.7×3.1/(39.48×1.35) ≈ 0.40 m，與假設一致；基底剪力係數約 0.17，約為固定基底的六分之一。平面 60 m × 30 m、偏心 3 m 時角落總位移約 0.50 m，隔震縫取 0.55 m 以上。若採用上限性質（Q_d×1.3、K_d×1.1），單一支承力增為約 774 kN，上部結構設計力增加約 15%；若隔震縫被縮減到 0.30 m，撞擊動能約 3.2 MJ。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a historic building weighing W = 216,000 kN is isolated on 54 lead-rubber bearings. For one bearing, a 150 mm lead core with 10 MPa yield stress gives Q_d ≈ 177 kN, and a 900 mm diameter with 200 mm total rubber and G = 0.4 MPa gives K_d ≈ 1,237 kN/m. At the design displacement D = 0.40 m, F ≈ 672 kN, K_eff ≈ 1,679 kN/m and β_eff ≈ 16%. The system K ≈ 90,650 kN/m gives T = 2π√(W/(g·K)) ≈ 3.1 s; with S_D1 = 0.7 and B = 1.35, D = g·S_D1·T/(4π²·B) ≈ 9.81×0.7×3.1/(39.48×1.35) ≈ 0.40 m, consistent with the assumption, and the base-shear coefficient is about 0.17, roughly one sixth of the fixed-base value. For a 60 m × 30 m plan with 3 m eccentricity the corner displacement is about 0.50 m, so the moat should be at least 0.55 m. Upper-bound properties (Q_d×1.3, K_d×1.1) raise the bearing force to about 774 kN, about 15% more superstructure force; a moat reduced to 0.30 m means an impact energy of about 3.2 MJ. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

title: 鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工
summary: 剪力牆是高層與中高層建築最主要的側力抵抗構件，其耐震表現取決於牆端邊界構材的圍束、縱筋續接位置、施工縫處理與混凝土在密集鋼筋中的密實度。本課以哈里發塔的扶壁式核心牆、亞特蘭大電梯試驗塔的滑模核心牆，以及 2011 年基督城 CTV 大樓倒塌後皇家調查委員會的檢討為背景，說明側力分配、邊界構材需求、圍束配筋、續接、鋼筋間距與骨材、澆置振搗、強度驗收、澆置前查驗、震後損傷判讀與開孔變更管控。
summaryEn: Shear walls are the main lateral-force-resisting members of mid- and high-rise buildings, and their seismic performance depends on confinement of boundary elements, the location of longitudinal splices, treatment of construction joints and the compaction of concrete within dense reinforcement. Against the background of Burj Khalifa's buttressed core walls, the slipformed core walls of the Atlanta elevator test tower and the Royal Commission's review after the 2011 collapse of the CTV Building in Christchurch, the course covers lateral force sharing, boundary-element demand, confinement detailing, splices, bar spacing and aggregate size, placing and vibration, strength acceptance, pre-pour inspection, post-earthquake damage interpretation and control of later openings.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計檢核練習：一道長 l_w = 8 m、厚 400 mm 的剪力牆，f′_c = 42 MPa、f_y = 420 MPa，設計位移比 δ_u/h_w = 0.01，分析得中性軸深度 c = 1,100 mm。邊界構材門檻 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm，c 超過門檻，需特殊邊界構材，延伸長度 max(1,100 − 800, 550) = 550 mm，取 600 mm。圍束：邊界 400×600 mm、核心 320×520 mm，A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442，0.3×0.442×42/420 ≈ 0.0133 控制，s = 100 mm 時 A_sh ≥ 425 mm²，用 4 肢 D13（507 mm²）。剪力強度 V_n = 3.2×10⁶×(0.17×6.48 + 0.0025×420) ≈ 6,886 kN，φV_n = 0.75×6,886 ≈ 5,164 kN。縱筋 D25 的 B 類搭接約 1,240 mm，若全部在同一斷面搭接，邊界淨間距由約 92 mm 降到約 27 mm，故改為錯開或使用續接器。若設計位移比提高到 0.015，門檻降為 8,000/(600×0.0225) ≈ 593 mm，邊界構材需求更明確，延伸長度仍為 550 mm 但塑性鉸區的應變更高。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design check exercise: a shear wall with l_w = 8 m and 400 mm thickness has f′_c = 42 MPa, f_y = 420 MPa, a design drift ratio δ_u/h_w = 0.01 and an analysed neutral-axis depth c = 1,100 mm. The boundary threshold is 8,000/(600×0.015) ≈ 889 mm, which c exceeds, so a special boundary element is needed, extending max(1,100 − 800, 550) = 550 mm, taken as 600 mm. Confinement: with a 400×600 mm boundary and 320×520 mm core, A_g/A_ch ≈ 1.442 and 0.3×0.442×42/420 ≈ 0.0133 governs, so at s = 100 mm A_sh ≥ 425 mm², provided by four legs of D13 (507 mm²). Shear strength is V_n = 3.2×10⁶×(0.17×6.48 + 0.0025×420) ≈ 6,886 kN and φV_n = 0.75×6,886 ≈ 5,164 kN. A Class B lap for D25 is about 1,240 mm; lapping all bars at one section would cut boundary clear spacing from about 92 mm to about 27 mm, so laps are staggered or couplers used. If the design drift ratio rises to 0.015, the threshold falls to 8,000/(600×0.0225) ≈ 593 mm, the boundary-element demand becomes clearer, and although the extent remains 550 mm the hinge-zone strains are higher. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

title: 挫屈束制支撐安裝
summary: 從挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑與層間變位換算核心應變出發，檢查核心、套管與脫層材及節點板的設計，再把重點放在安裝：重力荷載與安裝時機造成的預壓、現場配合誤差與螺栓鎖固，接著談 AISC 341 資格試驗與震後評估、防火與熱膨脹，最後是更換與交接，並以 One Rincon Hill、鹽湖城國際機場與日本製鐵工程的無黏結支撐公開資料對照。

workedExample.text: 設計與安裝練習：核心 A_sc = 4,000 mm²、F_y = 345 MPa，P_ysc ≈ 1,380 kN；以 ω = 1.4、β = 1.1，T_max ≈ 1,932 kN、C_max ≈ 2,125 kN。柱距 6 m、樓高 4 m，θ ≈ 33.7°、工作點長度約 7.21 m，降伏段 L_ysc ≈ 4,327 mm。設計層間變位 2%（80 mm）時支撐伸縮 ≈ 66.6 mm，核心應變 ≈ 1.54%，資格試驗須涵蓋約 3.1%。套管 250×250×6 mm、長 6.0 m，P_e ≈ 3,188 kN，為 C_max 的 1.5 倍。支撐勁度約 259 kN/mm：若鎖固後上方荷載使每層柱縮短 3.0 mm，支撐預壓約 431 kN（P_ysc 的 31%）；若安裝時強迫消除 2 mm 錯位，再增加約 518 kN。兩者相加約 949 kN，已達 P_ysc 的約 69%，地震時受壓側會提早降伏。若改為主要靜載完成後才鎖固並以墊片處理錯位，預壓可降到 P_ysc 的 10% 以下。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際產品或建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design and installation exercise: a core with A_sc = 4,000 mm² and F_y = 345 MPa gives P_ysc ≈ 1,380 kN; with ω = 1.4 and β = 1.1, T_max ≈ 1,932 kN and C_max ≈ 2,125 kN. For a 6 m bay and 4 m storey, θ ≈ 33.7°, the work-point length is about 7.21 m and the yielding zone L_ysc ≈ 4,327 mm. At a design drift of 2% (80 mm) the brace deforms about 66.6 mm, a core strain of about 1.54%, so qualification must cover about 3.1%. A 250×250×6 mm casing 6.0 m long has P_e ≈ 3,188 kN, 1.5 times C_max. With brace stiffness about 259 kN/mm, loads added after connection that shorten each storey's columns by 3.0 mm preload the brace by about 431 kN (31% of P_ysc), and forcing out a 2 mm misfit adds about 518 kN. Together about 949 kN, roughly 69% of P_ysc, so the brace yields early on the compression side in an earthquake. Connecting after the main dead loads and shimming the misfit can keep preload below 10% of P_ysc. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real product or building.

title: 預鑄混凝土耐震接頭
summary: 從預鑄構架的地震傳力路徑與自復位原理出發，計算混合預力梁柱接頭的開口、鋼腱應力與軟鋼脫黏長度，設計灌漿套筒續接，再處理吊裝期間的臨時穩定、樓梯與樓板的支承長度與滑動縫、ACI 374.1 試驗允收與 PRESSS 縮尺試驗，最後談套筒灌漿缺陷檢測與震後預力復驗，並以 The Paramount、PRESSS 試驗建築與基督城地震的公開教訓對照。

workedExample.text: 設計練習：某預鑄混合抗彎構架梁深 700 mm，梁端以無黏結鋼腱施加 P = 1,200 kN（初始 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa），力臂 0.35 m，M_pt = 420 kN·m；上下緣軟鋼 A_s = 1,000 mm²，以 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa、力臂 0.55 m 計，M_s ≈ 289 kN·m，復位比 λ ≈ 1.45。設計層間變位 2% 時梁端開口 14 mm，16 m 長鋼腱應力增約 171 MPa 至約 1,194 MPa；軟鋼伸長 12 mm，以 3% 應變上限需脫黏 400 mm。柱底 D32 灌漿套筒以 τ = 12 MPa 計需埋入約 413 mm，提供 512 mm。若最大考量地震變位達 3.5%，開口增為約 24.5 mm，鋼腱應力約 1,322 MPa 仍低於降伏，但軟鋼伸長 21 mm，脫黏長度須增至約 700 mm；若震後浮升試驗發現預力損失 15%，λ 降為約 1.23。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a precast hybrid moment frame has 700 mm beams post-tensioned with unbonded tendons at P = 1,200 kN (initially 0.55 f_pu ≈ 1,023 MPa) at a 0.35 m lever arm, so M_pt = 420 kN·m; top and bottom mild steel A_s = 1,000 mm² at 1.25 f_y = 525 MPa and a 0.55 m lever arm gives M_s ≈ 289 kN·m and a recentring ratio λ ≈ 1.45. At 2% design drift the beam-end gap is 14 mm and a 16 m tendon gains about 171 MPa to about 1,194 MPa; the mild steel elongates 12 mm, needing 400 mm of debonding for a 3% strain limit. D32 grouted sleeves at the column base need about 413 mm of embedment at τ = 12 MPa, and 512 mm is provided. If the maximum considered drift reaches 3.5%, the gap grows to about 24.5 mm and tendon stress to about 1,322 MPa, still below yield, but the mild steel elongates 21 mm and needs about 700 mm of debonding; if a post-earthquake lift-off test finds 15% prestress loss, λ drops to about 1.23. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：教學雙 T 梁寬 3.0 m、高 800 mm、跨度 24 m，A = 450,000 mm²、I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴、y_b ≈ 508 mm。自重 10.8 kN/m（3.6 kPa），加附加靜載 0.5 kPa 與屋頂活載 1.0 kPa，w_u ≈ 19.56 kN/m，M_u ≈ 1,408 kN·m。配置 12 股 15.2 mm 鋼絞線、偏心 e ≈ 408 mm，以 f_ps ≈ 1,700 MPa、f'c = 35 MPa 估計 φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m，需求比約 0.80。放鬆時 P_i ≈ 2,016 kN：反拱約 65.7 mm、自重撓度約 51.7 mm，淨反拱約 14 mm；梁端頂部拉應力約 3.5 MPa，超過 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa，需脫黏或折線配置。長期淨反拱只剩約 2 mm，排水坡度須由支承高程提供，並以雨水荷載約 0.74 kPa 檢核。每根腹肋端部反力約 117 kN，缺口吊筋約需 373 mm²。若日後切斷 2 股鋼絞線，φM_n 降為約 1,471 kN·m，需求比升為約 0.96，使用狀態底緣拉應力約 5.2 MPa 會開裂。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際產品或建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a teaching double tee 3.0 m wide and 800 mm deep spans 24 m, with A = 450,000 mm², I ≈ 3.01×10¹⁰ mm⁴ and y_b ≈ 508 mm. Self-weight is 10.8 kN/m (3.6 kPa); with 0.5 kPa superimposed dead load and 1.0 kPa roof live load, w_u ≈ 19.56 kN/m and M_u ≈ 1,408 kN·m. Twelve 15.2 mm strands at e ≈ 408 mm, with f_ps ≈ 1,700 MPa and f'c = 35 MPa, give φM_n ≈ 1,758 kN·m and a demand ratio of about 0.80. At release P_i ≈ 2,016 kN: camber about 65.7 mm against self-weight deflection about 51.7 mm, a net of about 14 mm; top tension at the ends is about 3.5 MPa, above 0.5√f'ci ≈ 2.74 MPa, so strands must be debonded or harped. Long-term net camber is only about 2 mm, so drainage slope must come from bearing elevations, checked for a rain load of about 0.74 kPa. Each stem end reacts about 117 kN, needing about 373 mm² of dap hanger steel. If 2 strands are later cut, φM_n falls to about 1,471 kN·m, the demand ratio rises to about 0.96 and service bottom tension of about 5.2 MPa cracks the member. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real product or building.

title: 大跨度空間桁架提升
summary: 大跨度屋蓋若在高空逐件安裝，需要大量臨時支撐、高空作業與大型吊車；改在地面組裝後整體提升，能提高品質與安全，但提升狀態下桁架的支承點、受力方向與穩定條件都和使用狀態不同。課程以倫敦希斯洛第五航廈 156 m 單跨屋蓋、新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的 1,270 t 提升，以及川口衞發展、1984 年首用於神戶世界紀念館的 Pantadome 頂升構法為錨點，說明吊點與吊耳、鋼絞線與千斤頂、同步控制、塔架穩定、試提升、風速停止準則與就位轉換的檢核邏輯。
summaryEn: Erecting a long-span roof piece by piece at height needs extensive falsework, work at height and large cranes; assembling it at ground level and lifting it whole improves quality and safety, but in the lifting state the truss has different supports, force directions and stability conditions from service. Anchored on the 156 m single-span roof of Heathrow Terminal 5, the 1,270 t lift of the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark and Mamoru Kawaguchi's Pantadome push-up method first used at Kobe's World Memorial Hall in 1984, the course explains the checking logic for lift points and lugs, strands and jacks, synchronised control, tower stability, trial lifts, wind stop criteria and final load transfer.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：為一個屋蓋提升單元做初步提升設計。假設單元重 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台千斤頂共 16 點提升，W = 2,200×9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN，平均每點 1,350 kN。（1）鋼絞線：15.7 mm、破斷 279 kN、工作荷載取 40% 破斷，需 1,350/111.6 ≈ 12.1 → 13 根，每根約 104 kN；長 40 m 時伸長約 142 mm。（2）同步：吊點勁度 20 kN/mm、允許反力偏差 10%（135 kN），允許高差約 6.8 mm，警戒設 5 mm。（3）時間：提升 30 m、速度 10 m/h，純提升約 3 h，加試提升停留與就位約半天。（4）若改為 12 點提升，每點 1,800 kN，鋼絞線需 1,800/111.6 ≈ 16.1 → 17 根，伸長約 145 mm，但每座塔架荷載增為 3 台時約 5,400 kN，塔架挫屈需求隨之上升。所有數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案的提升設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: preliminary lifting design for a roof unit. Assume the unit weighs 2,200 t and is lifted at 16 points by 8 towers with 2 jacks each, W = 2,200×9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN, an average of 1,350 kN per point. (1) Strands: 15.7 mm with 279 kN breaking load at a working load of 40% of breaking needs 1,350/111.6 ≈ 12.1, so 13 strands of about 104 kN; 40 m long they stretch about 142 mm. (2) Synchronisation: with 20 kN/mm stiffness at a lift point and a 10% (135 kN) allowable reaction deviation, the allowable level difference is about 6.8 mm, with an alarm at 5 mm. (3) Time: lifting 30 m at 10 m/h takes about 3 h of pure lifting, about half a day with the trial-lift hold and final positioning. (4) With 12 points instead, each carries 1,800 kN and needs 1,800/111.6 ≈ 16.1, so 17 strands stretching about 145 mm, while a tower with 3 jacks carries about 5,400 kN and its buckling demand rises accordingly. All values are teaching assumptions, not the lifting design of any real project.

title: 張拉膜屋蓋成形
titleEn: Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs
summary: 張拉膜沒有抗彎勁度，形狀必須是預應力與邊界共同決定的平衡曲面，因此設計流程從形狀尋找開始，再以膜材雙軸試驗決定勁度與裁片補償，最後在現場展開、吊升並分階段導入預應力。課程以丹佛國際機場 Jeppesen 航廈的雙層 PTFE 屋頂（約 34,800 m² 主屋頂）、吉達哈吉航廈的 210 個錐形膜單元與 Frei Otto 的 1967 年蒙特婁德國館為錨點，說明邊索與膜預應力的關係、積水與雪載、膜材強度折減、補償率誤差、吊升風速、錐形單元頂升、張力量測、顫振、潛變鬆弛與維護交接。
summaryEn: A tensile membrane has no bending stiffness, so its shape must be an equilibrium surface set by prestress and boundaries; design therefore starts with form finding, then uses biaxial fabric tests to set stiffness and pattern compensation, and finally unfolds, hoists and prestresses the membrane on site in stages. Anchored on the double-layer PTFE roof of Denver International Airport's Jeppesen Terminal (about 34,800 m² of main roof), the 210 conical membrane units of the Hajj Terminal in Jeddah and Frei Otto's 1967 German Pavilion in Montreal, the course covers edge-cable and prestress relations, ponding and snow, fabric strength reduction, compensation errors, hoisting wind limits, jacking of conical units, tension measurement, flutter, creep relaxation and maintenance handover.
