workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一片四點雙曲膜的邊索、補償與敏感度。膜預應力 t = 3 kN/m，自由邊弦長 c = 20 m，邊索張力 T = 150 kN：曲率半徑 R = T/t = 50 m，邊索垂度 f ≈ c²/(8R) = 1.0 m。雙軸試驗得經向勁度 E = 1,000 kN/m，彈性應變 3/1,000 = 0.3%，加潛變預留 0.2%，補償率 0.5%，20 m 長的裁片裁成 20×0.995 = 19.90 m。若實際膜材較軟（E = 750 kN/m）卻沿用 0.3% 的彈性補償，張拉到同一幾何後預應力只有 750×0.003 = 2.25 kN/m，低 25%；在 T 不變下邊索曲率半徑變為 150/2.25 ≈ 66.7 m、垂度約 0.75 m，邊界幾何也跟著改變，最後需重新調整邊索或桅桿。所有數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: edge cable, compensation and sensitivity of a four-point anticlastic membrane. With membrane prestress t = 3 kN/m, a free-edge chord c = 20 m and edge-cable tension T = 150 kN, the radius is R = T/t = 50 m and the edge sag f ≈ c²/(8R) = 1.0 m. Biaxial tests give a warp stiffness E = 1,000 kN/m, so the elastic strain is 3/1,000 = 0.3%; adding 0.2% for creep gives 0.5% compensation, and a 20 m pattern is cut to 20×0.995 = 19.90 m. If the actual fabric is softer, E = 750 kN/m, while the 0.3% elastic compensation is kept, the prestress after tensioning to the same geometry is only 750×0.003 = 2.25 kN/m, 25% low; with T unchanged the edge radius becomes 150/2.25 ≈ 66.7 m and the sag about 0.75 m, so the boundary geometry changes too and edge cables or masts must be readjusted. All values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.

title: 索網屋蓋張拉
summary: 索網屋蓋在完成張拉之前只是一堆會晃動的鋼索，預拉力與曲率才讓它具有勁度，因此張拉是設計的一部分而不是單純的施工步驟。課程以 1952 年羅利 Dorton 體育館（世界第一座永久性索支承屋頂，約 300 ft 無柱跨度）、1972 年慕尼黑奧運鞍形索網、卡加利 Saddledome 的索承混凝土雙曲面，以及巴西利亞國家體育場的平衡懸吊輪輻式雙層屋頂為錨點，說明預拉勁度、受壓環、索頭錨具、地面組裝與提升張拉、力與幾何控制、頻率法量索、載重試驗、溫度與鬆弛，以及單索更換的檢核邏輯。
summaryEn: A cable-net roof is only a set of swaying cables until it is tensioned; prestress and curvature give it stiffness, so tensioning is part of the design rather than a mere construction step. Anchored on Raleigh's Dorton Arena of 1952 (the world's first permanent cable-supported roof, about 300 ft clear span), Munich's 1972 Olympic saddle nets, the cable-held concrete saddle of Calgary's Saddledome and the balanced-suspension-wheel double-layer roof of Brasília's National Stadium, the course explains the checking logic for prestress stiffness, compression rings, cable terminations, ground assembly with lift-and-tension, force and geometry control, frequency-based force measurement, load tests, temperature and relaxation, and single-cable replacement.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：輪輻式屋蓋的受壓環與最後張拉行程。屋蓋有 n = 60 根徑向索，每根設計水平力 H = 3,000 kN，受壓環半徑 R = 120 m。（1）環力 N = nH/(2π) = 60×3,000/(2π) ≈ 28,650 kN；均布徑向力 q = N/R ≈ 239 kN/m。（2）環的平面內挫屈 q_cr = 3EI/R³，要求 q_cr ≥ 2.5q，需 EI ≥ 2.5×239×120³/3 ≈ 3.44×10⁸ kN·m²。（3）徑向索 EA = 600,000 kN、長 100 m，勁度 6,000 kN/m，最後 0.5 m 行程內力量由近 0 升到 3,000 kN；若一台千斤頂落後 30 mm，該索少 180 kN、相鄰索相應增加，約為 6%。（4）若把徑向索數增為 72 根並維持相同總力，每根 H = 2,500 kN，最後行程縮為約 0.42 m，單根同步誤差 30 mm 的力差仍為 180 kN，但比例升為約 7.2%，同步要求更嚴。所有數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: compression ring and final tensioning stroke of a spoked-wheel roof. The roof has n = 60 radial cables, each with design horizontal force H = 3,000 kN, and a compression ring of radius R = 120 m. (1) Ring force N = nH/(2π) = 60×3,000/(2π) ≈ 28,650 kN; uniform radial load q = N/R ≈ 239 kN/m. (2) In-plane ring buckling q_cr = 3EI/R³ with q_cr ≥ 2.5q requires EI ≥ 2.5×239×120³/3 ≈ 3.44×10⁸ kN·m². (3) A radial cable with EA = 600,000 kN and length 100 m has stiffness 6,000 kN/m, so in the last 0.5 m of stroke its force rises from near zero to 3,000 kN; a jack lagging 30 mm leaves that cable 180 kN short, with neighbours correspondingly higher, about 6%. (4) Increasing to 72 radial cables with the same total force gives H = 2,500 kN each and a final stroke of about 0.42 m; a 30 mm synchronisation error still means 180 kN, but now about 7.2%, so synchronisation requirements tighten. All values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.

title: 可開合體育場屋頂
summary: 可開合屋頂同時是大跨度鋼結構與一部大型行走機械：固定主結構承受軌道與移動屋面板，轉向架把輪壓傳入軌道梁，驅動與制動在限定風速下讓屋面板同步移動。本課以多倫多 SkyDome（今 Rogers Centre）、亞特蘭大賓士體育場、溫布頓中央球場與福岡巨蛋為例，建立狀態荷載、輪壓、驅動功率、偏斜控制、試運轉與長期維護的工程判斷。
summaryEn: A retractable roof is both a long-span steel structure and a large travelling machine: the fixed primary structure carries rails and moving panels, bogies deliver wheel loads into rail girders, and drives and brakes move the panels in step below a set wind speed. Using Toronto's SkyDome (now Rogers Centre), Atlanta's Mercedes-Benz Stadium, Wimbledon's Centre Court and Fukuoka Dome, the course builds engineering judgement on state-dependent loads, wheel loads, drive power, skew control, commissioning and long-term maintenance.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一片屋面板質量 1,200 t，坐在 16 個車輪上，行程 70 m，運轉風速上限 25 m/s。重量 W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN；平均輪壓 735.8 kN，不均勻係數 1.3 時設計輪壓 ≈ 956 kN。行走阻力：滾動 W×0.005 = 58.9 kN，主桁架撓曲造成的 1% 坡度 W×0.01 = 117.7 kN，風壓 q = 0.5×1.225×25² ≈ 383 Pa 乘迎風面積 600 m² 得 229.7 kN，合計 F ≈ 406 kN。速度 v = 0.12 m/s 時輸出功率 P = F·v ≈ 48.8 kW，效率 0.85 時輸入約 57.4 kW；附著係數 0.15 需驅動輪正壓力 ≈ 2,708 kN，至少 4 個驅動輪。全程時間 t = 70/0.12 + 10 ≈ 593 s ≈ 9.9 min。若把運轉風速上限提高到 30 m/s，風力變為 229.7×(30/25)² ≈ 331 kN，總阻力 ≈ 507 kN，輸入功率增為約 71.6 kW，驅動輪正壓力需求也增加約 25%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際體育場的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 1,200 t panel sits on 16 wheels, travels 70 m and has an operating wind limit of 25 m/s. Its weight is W = 1,200×9.81 = 11,772 kN; the mean wheel load is 735.8 kN, and with an unevenness factor of 1.3 the design wheel load is about 956 kN. Travel resistance: rolling W×0.005 = 58.9 kN, a 1% gradient from truss deflection W×0.01 = 117.7 kN, and wind q = 0.5×1.225×25² ≈ 383 Pa on 600 m² giving 229.7 kN, for a total F ≈ 406 kN. At v = 0.12 m/s the output power is P = F·v ≈ 48.8 kW, about 57.4 kW input at 0.85 efficiency; an adhesion coefficient of 0.15 needs about 2,708 kN on driven wheels, so at least four driven wheels. Travel time is t = 70/0.12 + 10 ≈ 593 s ≈ 9.9 min. Raising the operating limit to 30 m/s makes the wind force 229.7×(30/25)² ≈ 331 kN and the total about 507 kN, so input power rises to about 71.6 kW and the required normal load on driven wheels rises by about 25%. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real stadium.

title: 薄殼混凝土屋頂施工
summary: 薄殼混凝土屋頂以數公分厚的雙曲面跨越數十公尺，靠的是形狀讓荷載以薄膜壓力傳遞；它的弱點是挫屈、邊緣彎矩、溫差裂縫與施工幾何誤差。本課從 Candela 的雙曲拋物面、Isler 的倒懸模型殼到蘇黎世聯邦理工學院在 NEST HiLo 的索網織物模板，說明殼形、配筋、模板、澆置脫模、幾何量測與長期維護的工程判斷。
summaryEn: Thin concrete shells span tens of metres with curved surfaces only a few centimetres thick, because their form lets loads travel as membrane compression; their weak points are buckling, edge bending, thermal cracking and construction geometry errors. From Candela's hyperbolic paraboloids and Isler's inverted hanging-model shells to ETH Zurich's cable-net fabric formwork at NEST HiLo, the course explains engineering judgement on shell form, reinforcement, formwork, casting and decentering, geometry survey and long-term maintenance.

workedExample.text: 設計練習：一座球形薄殼屋頂半徑 R = 40 m、厚度 t = 80 mm、E = 30,000 MPa，自重 q_g = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa，雪荷載 1.0 kPa，合計 2.92 kPa。頂部經向力 N = qR/2 = 2.92×40/2 = 58.4 kN/m，壓應力 σ = 58.4/0.08 = 0.73 MPa。古典挫屈 p_cr = 1.18×30,000×(0.08/40)² MPa ≈ 141 kPa，缺陷折減 0.3 與潛變係數 2（有效 E 降為 1/3）後約 14.1 kPa，安全係數 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8。環向力在 φ ≈ 51.8° 由壓轉拉。若為省材料把厚度改為 60 mm：自重 1.44 kPa、合計 2.44 kPa，σ = 2.44×40/2/0.06 ≈ 0.81 MPa，應力反而上升；p_cr 按 t² 降為約 79.5 kPa，折減後約 7.95 kPa，安全係數只剩約 3.3。由此可見減薄殼體省下的是自重，失去的是挫屈裕度。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際殼體的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a spherical shell roof has radius R = 40 m, thickness t = 80 mm and E = 30,000 MPa; self-weight is q_g = 24×0.08 = 1.92 kPa and snow 1.0 kPa, total 2.92 kPa. The crown meridional force is N = qR/2 = 2.92×40/2 = 58.4 kN/m, a compressive stress σ = 58.4/0.08 = 0.73 MPa. Classical buckling gives p_cr = 1.18×30,000×(0.08/40)² MPa ≈ 141 kPa; after an imperfection factor of 0.3 and a creep coefficient of 2 (effective E reduced to one third) it is about 14.1 kPa, a safety factor of 14.1/2.92 ≈ 4.8. The hoop force turns tensile at φ ≈ 51.8°. Thinning to 60 mm to save material gives self-weight 1.44 kPa and total 2.44 kPa, so σ = 2.44×40/2/0.06 ≈ 0.81 MPa, actually higher; p_cr falls with t² to about 79.5 kPa, about 7.95 kPa after reduction, and the safety factor drops to about 3.3. Thinning saves self-weight but spends buckling margin. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real shell.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某展示廳全玻璃立面高 10 m，玻璃肋間距 2.0 m，設計風壓 1.5 kPa，肋為 3×15 mm 膠合強化玻璃、深 550 mm，上下簡支。線荷重 w = 1.5×2.0 = 3.0 kN/m，M = wL²/8 = 3.0×10²/8 = 37.5 kN·m；S = 45×550²/6 ≈ 2.27×10⁶ mm³，σ ≈ 16.5 MPa；一片破裂後 σ ≈ 24.8 MPa。撓度 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 8.9 mm（約 L/1,120）。挫屈：完全耦合 M_cr ≈ 129 kN·m，安全比 129/37.5 ≈ 3.4；完全不耦合 M_cr ≈ 14.6 kN·m，比值只有 0.39，不足，因此必須以面玻璃與矽利康拘束受壓邊、改用高剪力勁度中間膜，或加深斷面。若把肋深加到 650 mm，I_z 與 I_t 約按深度比增加，不耦合 M_cr 約為 14.6×650/550 ≈ 17.3 kN·m，仍不足，說明挫屈主要靠厚度與耦合而非深度解決。矽利康咬合寬 = 1.5 kN/m ÷ 138 kPa ≈ 10.9 mm，取 12 mm。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a showroom has a 10 m high all-glass façade with fins at 2.0 m centres, design wind 1.5 kPa, and fins of 3×15 mm laminated toughened glass, 550 mm deep and simply supported top and bottom. Line load w = 1.5×2.0 = 3.0 kN/m and M = wL²/8 = 3.0×10²/8 = 37.5 kN·m; S = 45×550²/6 ≈ 2.27×10⁶ mm³, so σ ≈ 16.5 MPa, rising to about 24.8 MPa with one ply broken. Deflection δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 8.9 mm (about L/1,120). Buckling: fully coupled M_cr ≈ 129 kN·m, a ratio of 129/37.5 ≈ 3.4; uncoupled M_cr ≈ 14.6 kN·m, a ratio of only 0.39, which fails, so the compressed edge must be restrained by face glass and silicone, a stiffer interlayer used, or the section changed. Deepening the fin to 650 mm raises I_z and I_t roughly in proportion to depth, so uncoupled M_cr becomes about 14.6×650/550 ≈ 17.3 kN·m, still inadequate, showing that buckling is solved mainly by thickness and coupling rather than depth. Silicone bite = 1.5 kN/m ÷ 138 kPa ≈ 10.9 mm, specified as 12 mm. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 60 層辦公塔標準層周長 120 m、層高 4.2 m，採 1.5 m 寬單元，標準區設計風壓 3.0 kPa、角隅區 4.5 kPa。每層 120/1.5 = 80 片，共 4,800 片。標準區每單元風力 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN，每錨件 9.45 kN；角隅區為 4.5×1.5×4.2 = 28.35 kN，每錨件約 14.2 kN，乘 1.5 為 21.3 kN。豎框：標準區 w = 4.5 kN/m，L/175 = 24 mm 需 I ≥ 1.09×10⁷ mm⁴；角隅區 w = 6.75 kN/m，需 I 按比例增為約 1.63×10⁷ mm⁴，即增加 50%。接縫變位預算 18.8 mm，設計 ±20 mm；層間位移試驗 1.5×21 = 31.5 mm。公差組合 √(25² + 10² + 5²) ≈ 27.4 mm，在 ±30 mm 調整量內。若安裝速率每日 40 片，約 120 個工作天。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 60-storey office tower has a 120 m typical-floor perimeter and 4.2 m storeys, using 1.5 m units with design pressures of 3.0 kPa in typical zones and 4.5 kPa at corners. Each floor needs 120/1.5 = 80 units, 4,800 in total. A typical unit takes 3.0×1.5×4.2 = 18.9 kN of wind, 9.45 kN per anchor; a corner unit takes 4.5×1.5×4.2 = 28.35 kN, about 14.2 kN per anchor or 21.3 kN with a 1.5 factor. Mullions: in typical zones w = 4.5 kN/m and L/175 = 24 mm requires I ≥ 1.09×10⁷ mm⁴; at corners w = 6.75 kN/m, so I rises proportionally to about 1.63×10⁷ mm⁴, 50% more. The stack-joint movement budget is 18.8 mm, designed as ±20 mm, and the racking test uses 1.5×21 = 31.5 mm. Combined tolerance √(25² + 10² + 5²) ≈ 27.4 mm lies within the ±30 mm adjustment. At 40 units per day installation takes about 120 working days. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

title: 雙層通風幕牆整合
summary: 從雙層通風幕牆的腔體類型與氣候條件出發，建立日射吸熱與通風量決定腔體溫升、煙囪效應決定浮力風量的模型，說明外層玻璃與懸挑托架、檢修走道的結構設計、開口與遮陽的細部，再處理施工整合、控制系統試運轉、樣品牆熱流量測與腔體煙控，最後以清潔、結露與實測能耗完成交接，並以柏林 GSW 總部、溫尼伯曼尼托巴水電大樓與倫敦聖瑪莉斧街 30 號說明不同的腔體策略。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 20 m 高的多樓層式雙層幕牆開間寬 3.0 m、層高 3.6 m、腔深 0.9 m。夏季晴天百葉吸收 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W/開間，70% 即 2,268 W 進入腔體空氣。若以腔體出風溫升 ΔT ≤ 8 K 為目標，需風量 V = 2,268/(1,206×8) ≈ 0.235 m³/s。浮力壓差 ΔP = 1.2×9.81×20×8/300 ≈ 6.3 Pa；有效開口 Cd·A = V/√(2ΔP/ρ) = 0.235/3.24 ≈ 0.073 m²，以 50% 自由面積、Cd = 0.6 的百葉需毛面積約 0.073/0.3 ≈ 0.24 m²，加防蟲網（再乘 0.6）約 0.40 m²。外層托架根部彎矩約 2.65 kN·m。若腔體高度降為 10 m，ΔP 減半為約 3.1 Pa，同樣風量需開口增為約 √2 ≈ 1.41 倍，即約 0.57 m²。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 20 m high multi-storey double-skin façade has 3.0 m bays, 3.6 m storeys and a 0.9 m cavity. On a clear summer day the blinds absorb 0.5×600×10.8 = 3,240 W per bay, 70% of which, 2,268 W, enters the cavity air. To keep the outlet temperature rise to ΔT ≤ 8 K requires V = 2,268/(1,206×8) ≈ 0.235 m³/s. The stack pressure is ΔP = 1.2×9.81×20×8/300 ≈ 6.3 Pa, so the effective opening is Cd·A = V/√(2ΔP/ρ) = 0.235/3.24 ≈ 0.073 m²; a louvre with 50% free area and Cd = 0.6 needs a gross area of about 0.073/0.3 ≈ 0.24 m², or about 0.40 m² with an insect screen (a further factor of 0.6). The outer-skin bracket root moment is about 2.65 kN·m. If the cavity height drops to 10 m, ΔP halves to about 3.1 Pa and the same airflow needs openings about √2 ≈ 1.41 times larger, about 0.57 m². Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

title: 建築外牆氣密水密試驗
summary: 從雨水穿透外牆的驅動力與風壓換算出發，說明壓力等化雨幕、空氣屏障與接縫毛細作用的原理，再把設計風壓轉成 ASTM E283、E331 與 AAMA 501 系列試驗的壓力與允收值，處理樣品牆試驗、施工中現場抽驗與 AAMA 501.2 噴水試驗的時程，最後以漏水診斷、事件後複驗與交接紀錄收尾，並以台北 101、麻省理工學院 Stata 中心與英屬哥倫比亞漏水公寓危機說明試驗與設計失誤的代價。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 40 層辦公塔外牆面積 30,000 m²，風洞試驗得標準區設計風壓 DP = 2.4 kPa、角隅區 3.6 kPa。標準區水密試驗壓力取 15% DP = 360 Pa（高於 300 Pa 下限），角隅區 540 Pa；結構試驗 150% DP 分別為 3.6 kPa 與 5.4 kPa；氣密試驗 300 Pa、限值 0.30 L/s·m²。樣品牆 37.8 m²：總洩漏 15.0 L/s、基準洩漏 4.5 L/s，試體洩漏 10.5 L/s，q = 10.5/37.8 ≈ 0.28 L/s·m²，合格。現場抽驗：水密壓力 2/3×360 = 240 Pa（標準區），氣密允許 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m²。540 Pa 相當於水柱 540/9,810 ≈ 55 mm，角隅區橫框擋水高度至少要大於此值並留餘裕。若角隅區改以 20% DP 試驗，壓力升為 720 Pa，水柱約 73 mm，擋水需相應加高。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 40-storey office tower has 30,000 m² of façade, and wind-tunnel testing gives design pressures DP = 2.4 kPa in typical zones and 3.6 kPa at corners. Water-test pressure is 15% DP = 360 Pa for typical zones (above the 300 Pa minimum) and 540 Pa at corners; structural tests at 150% DP are 3.6 kPa and 5.4 kPa; the air test is at 300 Pa with a 0.30 L/s·m² limit. Mock-up of 37.8 m²: total leakage 15.0 L/s, tare 4.5 L/s, specimen 10.5 L/s, q = 10.5/37.8 ≈ 0.28 L/s·m², a pass. Field sampling: water at 2/3×360 = 240 Pa in typical zones, air allowance 1.5×0.30 = 0.45 L/s·m². 540 Pa equals a water column of 540/9,810 ≈ 55 mm, so corner transom dams must exceed this with margin. If corners are instead tested at 20% DP, the pressure rises to 720 Pa, a column of about 73 mm, and the dams must rise accordingly. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

title: 高層建築消防分區設計
summary: 從防火區劃的目的與火載量出發，比較灑水系統與區劃的分工，計算標準火災溫度與時間等效、防火門縫隙的漏煙、樓板邊緣縫隙的等效開口，再處理施工與裝修期間的區劃完整性、耐火試驗、樓梯加壓驗收、區劃失效時的結構臨界溫度，最後談使用管理與交接，並以高雄城中城大樓、倫敦 Grenfell Tower 與費城 One Meridian Plaza 的教訓對照。
summaryEn: Starting from the purpose of compartmentation and fire load, compare the roles of sprinklers and compartments, compute standard-fire temperatures and time equivalence, smoke leakage through fire-door gaps and the equivalent opening of slab-edge gaps, then cover compartment integrity during construction and fit-out, fire-resistance testing, stair-pressurisation acceptance and structural critical temperatures when compartments fail, and finally management in use and handover, compared with lessons from Kaohsiung's Cheng Chung Cheng Building, London's Grenfell Tower and Philadelphia's One Meridian Plaza.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 40 層辦公大樓標準層 1,500 m²、火載量 600 MJ/m²，每層一個區劃，火載量 Q = 1,500×600 = 900 GJ。以 Eurocode 簡化時間等效 t_e = 600×0.07×1.0 ≈ 42 min，樓板與區劃牆採 60 min 防火時效；ISO 834 在 60 min 時約 945°C。主要鋼梁使用率 μ₀ = 0.5，臨界溫度約 585°C，被覆厚度依此選定。防火門 3 mm 周邊縫在 25 Pa 壓差下漏煙約 272 m³/h，多 20 mm 門下縫則加倍。帷幕牆與樓板 100 mm 縫、周長 160 m，若未封填等於每層 16 m² 開口。樓梯加壓 50 Pa 時開門力約 91.5 N，80 Pa 時約 122.5 N。若灑水系統失效使火勢跨越兩層，同時燃燒的火載量變為 1,800 GJ，鋼梁若因後續加載使用率升到 0.7，臨界溫度降為約 526°C，原被覆厚度不再足夠。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 40-storey office tower has 1,500 m² typical floors and a fire load of 600 MJ/m², one compartment per floor, so Q = 1,500×600 = 900 GJ. Simplified Eurocode time equivalence gives t_e = 600×0.07×1.0 ≈ 42 min, so floors and compartment walls are rated 60 min; ISO 834 reaches about 945°C at 60 min. Principal steel beams at utilisation μ₀ = 0.5 have a critical temperature of about 585°C, which sets the coating thickness. A fire door with a 3 mm perimeter gap leaks about 272 m³/h at 25 Pa, doubled by an extra 20 mm undercut. A 100 mm curtain-wall gap around a 160 m perimeter, unsealed, equals a 16 m² opening per floor. Stair pressurisation at 50 Pa gives a door-opening force of about 91.5 N, and at 80 Pa about 122.5 N. If sprinkler failure lets the fire span two floors, the fire load burning at once becomes 1,800 GJ, and if later loads raise beam utilisation to 0.7, the critical temperature falls to about 526°C and the original coating is no longer sufficient. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

title: 超高層電梯分區與調度
titleEn: Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings
summary: 從上行尖峰人口與五分鐘運輸能力出發，說明超高層為何以穿梭電梯、空中大廳與疊用井道分段服務，再處理數百公尺行程的鋼索自重與曳引、超高速車廂的耳壓與振動、核心筒縮短下的導軌安裝、目的樓層派梯與往返時間計算，最後談鋼索擺動、維護更新與緊急運轉，並以哈里發塔、上海中心大廈與台北 101 的公開資料對照。
summaryEn: Starting from up-peak population and five-minute handling capacity, explain why supertall towers serve their floors in tiers with shuttles, sky lobbies and stacked shafts, then handle rope self-weight and traction over hundreds of metres, ear pressure and vibration in ultra-high-speed cars, rail installation on a shortening core, destination dispatch and round-trip-time calculation, and finally rope sway, maintenance, modernisation and emergency operation, compared with public data from Burj Khalifa, Shanghai Tower and Taipei 101.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：上段 30 層、每層淨面積 1,600 m²、每人 10 m²、出勤率 85%，人口 30×1,600/10×0.85 = 4,080 人；穿梭電梯須在五分鐘運送 13%，即 0.13×4,080 ≈ 530 人。採雙層車廂，每層車廂載 21 人，每趟 42 人；直達行程 250 m、速度 8 m/s、加速度 1.0 m/s²、加加速度 1.0 m/s³，單程時間 t = D/v + v/a + a/j = 31.25+8+1 = 40.25 s。往返時間 = 2×40.25 + 12 s 開關門 + 42 s 上下客 ≈ 134.5 s；每部五分鐘運量 300×42/134.5 ≈ 93.7 人，需 530/93.7 ≈ 5.7，取 6 部，間隔 134.5/6 ≈ 22.4 s。若速度提高到 10 m/s，單程 25+10+1 = 36 s、往返 126 s、每部 100 人，仍需 5.3 部，即 6 部：提速每趟只省約 8.5 s，台數不變，雙層化與縮短上下客時間反而更有效。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: an upper tier of 30 floors with 1,600 m² net per floor, 10 m² per person and 85% attendance holds 30×1,600/10×0.85 = 4,080 people; the shuttles must move 13% in five minutes, 0.13×4,080 ≈ 530 people. Using double-deck cars with 21 passengers per deck, each trip carries 42. Express travel of 250 m at 8 m/s with acceleration 1.0 m/s² and jerk 1.0 m/s³ gives a one-way time t = D/v + v/a + a/j = 31.25+8+1 = 40.25 s. Round trip = 2×40.25 + 12 s of door operation + 42 s of passenger transfer ≈ 134.5 s; each car moves 300×42/134.5 ≈ 93.7 people per five minutes, so 530/93.7 ≈ 5.7 and six shuttles are needed, with an interval of 134.5/6 ≈ 22.4 s. Raising speed to 10 m/s gives 25+10+1 = 36 s one way, a 126 s round trip and 100 people per car, still 5.3 and therefore six cars: the extra speed saves only about 8.5 s per trip and does not change the car count, while double-decking and faster passenger transfer do more. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

title: 鋼構耐火被覆施工
summary: 從鋼材在火害中的強度折減與臨界溫度出發，建立斷面係數與被覆厚度的熱傳關係，比較噴覆型防火材料（SFRM）與膨脹型防火塗料的材料機制、施工環境與交叉作業損傷，再以 ASTM E605／E736 現場抽驗、耐火試驗登錄與約束條件判讀完成驗收，並以世界貿易中心、紐約時報大樓與馬德里溫莎大樓說明厚度、黏結與改修過渡期的風險。
summaryEn: Starting from steel strength loss and critical temperature in fire, build the heat-transfer link between section factor and protection thickness, compare the mechanisms, site conditions and trade damage of sprayed fire-resistive materials (SFRM) and intumescent coatings, then close acceptance with ASTM E605/E736 field sampling, fire-test listings and restraint classification, using the World Trade Center, the New York Times Building and the Windsor Building in Madrid to show the risks of thin spots, weak bond and half-finished retrofits.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某 150 m（約 492 ft）辦公塔的樓板梁要求 2 小時非約束等級，選用的登錄設計以 W/D = 0.82 的試驗梁、SFRM 厚度 1.00 in 取得該等級。專案梁 W16×26：D = 3bf + 2d − 2tw = 3×5.50 + 2×15.7 − 2×0.25 = 47.4 in，W/D = 26/47.4 ≈ 0.55，換算斷面係數 Ap/V ≈ 134/(W/D) ≈ 244 m⁻¹；厚度 T₁ = 1.00×(0.82 + 0.6)/(0.55 + 0.6) = 1.42/1.15 ≈ 1.24 in，取 1.25 in（約 32 mm）。現場允收：設計 ≥ 1 in，單點不得低於 1.25 − 0.25 = 1.00 in。樓高超過 420 ft，黏結門檻 1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa，以 0.0045 m² 拉拔蓋需承受約 215 N 不破壞。若改用 W16×40（D = 3×7.00 + 2×16.0 − 2×0.305 ≈ 52.4 in，W/D ≈ 0.76），T₁ = 1.42/1.36 ≈ 1.04 in，較重斷面可減薄約 0.2 in，但仍不得低於登錄最小厚度。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: floor beams in a 150 m (about 492 ft) office tower need a 2-hour unrestrained rating, and the chosen listed design achieved it with a test beam of W/D = 0.82 and 1.00 in of SFRM. Project beam W16×26: D = 3bf + 2d − 2tw = 3×5.50 + 2×15.7 − 2×0.25 = 47.4 in, W/D = 26/47.4 ≈ 0.55, equivalent to a section factor Ap/V ≈ 134/(W/D) ≈ 244 m⁻¹; thickness T₁ = 1.00×(0.82 + 0.6)/(0.55 + 0.6) = 1.42/1.15 ≈ 1.24 in, specified as 1.25 in (about 32 mm). Field acceptance: with a design of 1 in or more, no reading may be below 1.25 − 0.25 = 1.00 in. The tower exceeds 420 ft, so the bond threshold is 1,000 psf ≈ 47.9 kPa, meaning a 0.0045 m² pull-off cap must hold about 215 N. If a W16×40 is used instead (D = 3×7.00 + 2×16.0 − 2×0.305 ≈ 52.4 in, W/D ≈ 0.76), T₁ = 1.42/1.36 ≈ 1.04 in, so the heavier section saves about 0.2 in but must still respect the listed minimum. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.

title: 跨層轉換桁架施工
summary: 當上部樓層的柱位與下部不同，例如住宅柱網落在開闊的辦公或大廳之上，或周邊柱要集中到少數巨柱，就需要跨越一到數層樓高的轉換桁架。轉換桁架承受多層樓的集中荷重，構件厚重、接頭複雜，而且在施工中必須先完成並具足夠勁度，上方樓層才能開始施作。本課以碎片大廈的費氏轉換、樂天世界塔的帶狀桁架與吊掛樓層、赫斯特大樓的超級斜撐和威利斯大樓底座改造的轉換梁為例，談荷重路徑、吊掛、厚板焊接、接頭、整體提升、預拱與卸撐、超音波檢驗、卸載監測、防火與交接。
summaryEn: When upper columns do not line up with those below, for example a residential grid over open offices or a lobby, or perimeter columns gathered onto a few mega-columns, transfer trusses one to several storeys deep are needed. They carry concentrated loads from many floors, so members are heavy and joints complex, and during construction they must be complete and stiff before the floors above can proceed. Using the Vierendeel transfers of The Shard, the belt trusses and hung floors of Lotte World Tower, the super-diagonals of the Hearst Tower and the transfer girders of the Willis Tower base repositioning, the course covers load paths, hanging, thick-plate welding, joints, lifting, camber and de-propping, ultrasonic testing, unloading monitoring, fire protection and handover.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：檢核一榀跨度 L = 18 m、深 d = 7.5 m（兩層樓）的轉換桁架，中點承受上方 20 層的一根柱。每層受載面積 9 m×9 m、服務荷重 8.0 kPa，柱力 P = 20×81×8.0 = 12,960 kN。中點彎矩 M = PL/4 = 12,960×18/4 = 58,320 kN·m，弦桿力 C = T = M/d ≈ 7,776 kN，以 0.9×345 MPa 計所需弦桿斷面約 25,040 mm²。分四格、每格 4.5 m，斜桿角度 θ = atan(7.5/4.5) ≈ 59.0°，端格剪力 V = P/2 = 6,480 kN，斜桿力 = V/sinθ ≈ 7,560 kN。弦桿取 A_c = 0.025 m²，等效 I = A_c·d²/2 ≈ 0.703 m⁴，撓度 δ = PL³/(48EI) = 12,960×18³/(48×200×10⁶×0.703) ≈ 11.2 mm，加上斜桿伸縮約 30% 得約 14.6 mm，預拱取 15 mm。若因建築要求把深度壓縮為一層 3.75 m，弦桿力加倍為約 15,550 kN，I 降為四分之一，撓度約 44.8 mm、含斜桿約 58 mm，預拱與上方樓層高差都難以控制。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: check a transfer truss spanning L = 18 m with depth d = 7.5 m (two storeys), carrying at mid-span one column from 20 floors above. Each floor has a 9 m×9 m tributary area and an 8.0 kPa service load, so the column load P = 20×81×8.0 = 12,960 kN. The mid-span moment M = PL/4 = 12,960×18/4 = 58,320 kN·m and the chord force C = T = M/d ≈ 7,776 kN, needing a chord area of about 25,040 mm² at 0.9×345 MPa. With four 4.5 m panels the diagonal angle θ = atan(7.5/4.5) ≈ 59.0°, the end-panel shear V = P/2 = 6,480 kN and the diagonal force = V/sinθ ≈ 7,560 kN. Taking A_c = 0.025 m² for the chords, the equivalent I = A_c·d²/2 ≈ 0.703 m⁴ and the deflection δ = PL³/(48EI) = 12,960×18³/(48×200×10⁶×0.703) ≈ 11.2 mm; adding about 30% for diagonal strain gives about 14.6 mm, so a 15 mm camber is set. If architectural demands squeeze the depth to one 3.75 m storey, the chord force doubles to about 15,550 kN, I falls to a quarter and deflection becomes about 44.8 mm, about 58 mm with diagonals, making camber and level differences above hard to control. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.

title: 清水混凝土模板與澆置
summary: 清水混凝土的表面就是建築完成面，不能事後粉刷遮蓋，因此模板分割、繫桿孔排列、面板材料、脫模劑、配比與骨材一致性、澆置速度與振搗、樣板牆與驗收距離都必須在施工前定案。本課以安藤忠雄的光之教會與路易斯．康的沙克研究所為例，並以 ACI 347.3R 的成形面等級 CSC1 至 CSC4 與 ACI 301 第 6 節建築混凝土為框架，說明清水混凝土從設計意圖到長期維護的工程判斷。
summaryEn: In exposed architectural concrete the surface is the finished building face and cannot be covered later, so panel layout, tie-hole pattern, facing material, release agent, mix and aggregate consistency, placing rate and vibration, mock-ups and viewing distance must all be settled before casting. Using Tadao Ando's Church of the Light and Louis Kahn's Salk Institute, framed by the ACI 347.3R formed-surface categories CSC1 to CSC4 and ACI 301 Section 6 Architectural Concrete, the course explains engineering judgement from design intent to long-term maintenance.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 施工規劃練習：一道清水牆長 12 m、高 5.46 m、厚 0.3 m，要求 CSC4 級。模板以 0.91×1.82 m 面板分割，12/0.91 ≈ 13.2 片不是整數，改用 13 片、每片 12/13 ≈ 0.923 m 的訂製寬度，高度 3 片，共 39 片，每片 6 個繫桿孔共 234 個。面板 21 mm 合板，設計側壓 50 kPa，背楞間距 250 mm 時撓度 ≈ 0.47 mm（約 L/531），滿足 L/400。牆體體積 12×5.46×0.3 ≈ 19.7 m³，上升速度限制 1.5 m/h 時供料 5.4 m³/h，約 3.6 h 完成。驗收距離訂為 6 m，可分辨約 1.75 mm 的缺陷。若現場改以 15 m³/h 供料，上升速度變為約 4.17 m/h，整面牆約 1.3 h 澆完，側壓接近液壓 24×5.46 ≈ 131 kPa，為設計值的約 2.6 倍，面板撓度增為約 1.23 mm，超過 L/400 的 0.625 mm，牆面會出現可見波浪與漏漿痕。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。
workedExample.textEn: Planning exercise: an exposed wall 12 m long, 5.46 m high and 0.3 m thick is specified to CSC4. With 0.91×1.82 m panels, 12/0.91 ≈ 13.2 is not a whole number, so 13 custom panels of 12/13 ≈ 0.923 m are used, three high, 39 panels in all with 6 tie holes each, 234 tie holes. With 21 mm plywood, a design pressure of 50 kPa and studs at 250 mm, deflection is about 0.47 mm (about L/531), meeting L/400. The wall holds 12×5.46×0.3 ≈ 19.7 m³; limiting the rate of rise to 1.5 m/h means 5.4 m³/h of supply and about 3.6 h to complete. Viewing distance is set at 6 m, where about 1.75 mm defects can be resolved. If the site switches to 15 m³/h, the rate of rise becomes about 4.17 m/h and the wall fills in about 1.3 h, pressure approaches hydrostatic 24×5.46 ≈ 131 kPa, about 2.6 times the design value, and facing deflection grows to about 1.23 mm, beyond the 0.625 mm L/400 limit, so visible waves and leak marks appear. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.

title: 工程數位模型碰撞檢查

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一棟 20 層建築第一次聯合碰撞檢查得到 18,000 筆原始結果，分組後成為 900 組，其中 30% 即 270 組為真實議題。若這些議題留到現場，每件需 3 人工班 2 天（3×8×2 = 48 工時），以每工時 60 美元計為 2,880 美元，再加材料 1,200 美元，每件 4,080 美元，總計 270×4,080 = 1,101,600 美元。施工前協調由 2 名協調員做 26 週、每週 40 小時、每小時 75 美元，即 2×26×40×75 = 156,000 美元，加軟硬體 30,000 美元共 186,000 美元，效益比約 1,101,600/186,000 ≈ 5.9。若其中一半議題本來就會在製造圖階段被發現，效益減半為 550,800 美元，比值約 3.0，仍值得投入。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: the first federated clash run on a 20-storey building returns 18,000 raw results, grouped into 900 groups, of which 30%, or 270, are real issues. Left to site, each would need a three-person crew for two days (3×8×2 = 48 labour-hours) at US$60 per hour, US$2,880, plus US$1,200 of material, US$4,080 each and 270×4,080 = US$1,101,600 in total. Pre-construction coordination by two coordinators for 26 weeks at 40 hours a week and US$75 per hour costs 2×26×40×75 = US$156,000, plus US$30,000 for software and hardware, US$186,000 in all, a benefit ratio of about 1,101,600/186,000 ≈ 5.9. If half the issues would have been caught at shop-drawing stage anyway, the benefit halves to US$550,800 and the ratio is about 3.0, still worth the effort. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.

title: 施工測量控制網
summary: 從控制網層級與精度預算出發，說明投影比例因子、觀測墩與強制對心、全測站與 GNSS 的精度規格與 ISO 17123 現場檢定，再處理導線與最小二乘平差、高層建築軸線垂直傳遞、GNSS 靜態測量與高程換算、長隧道貫通誤差，以及控制網複測、參考框架與交接紀錄，並以戈達基線隧道、英法海底隧道與 Crossrail 的公開資料對照。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：以極座標法從控制觀測墩放樣錨栓，控制點本身標準差 2.0 mm，全測站測距 ±(1 mm + 1 ppm)、測角 1″（4.85×10⁻⁶ rad），放樣公差 ±10 mm（95%）。距離 D = 150 m 時，測距 σ_D = 1 + 0.15 = 1.15 mm，橫向 D·σ_θ = 150×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.73 mm，合成 σ = √(1.15² + 0.73² + 2.0²) = √5.85 ≈ 2.42 mm，95% 約 1.96×2.42 ≈ 4.7 mm，合格。D = 400 m 時 σ_D = 1.4 mm、橫向 1.94 mm，σ = √9.72 ≈ 3.12 mm，95% 約 6.1 mm，仍合格但餘裕變小，宜改由較近的控制點放樣。若忘記套用 148 ppm 的合併比例因子，400 m 的距離就多出 400×148×10⁻⁶ ≈ 59 mm 的系統誤差，遠大於所有隨機誤差的總和。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: anchor bolts are set out by polar method from a control pillar whose own standard deviation is 2.0 mm, using a total station with ±(1 mm + 1 ppm) distance and 1″ (4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) angle accuracy, against a set-out tolerance of ±10 mm at 95%. At D = 150 m the distance term is σ_D = 1 + 0.15 = 1.15 mm and the lateral term D·σ_θ = 150×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.73 mm, giving σ = √(1.15² + 0.73² + 2.0²) = √5.85 ≈ 2.42 mm and a 95% value of about 1.96×2.42 ≈ 4.7 mm, which passes. At D = 400 m, σ_D = 1.4 mm and the lateral term is 1.94 mm, so σ = √9.72 ≈ 3.12 mm and the 95% value is about 6.1 mm, still passing but with less margin, so a closer control point is preferable. Forgetting the 148 ppm combined scale factor adds a systematic error of 400×148×10⁻⁶ ≈ 59 mm at 400 m, far more than all the random errors together. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.

title: 建築雷射掃描竣工比對

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：一棟 30 層建築以掃描檢查帷幕牆托架位置，每層 40 個托架點、共 1,200 點，相對設計位置的偏差平均 +6 mm、標準差 8 mm（假設常態分布且已含量測誤差），托架可調範圍 ±20 mm。超出範圍的機率 = P(z > (20−6)/8 = 1.75) + P(z < (−20−6)/8 = −3.25) ≈ 0.0401 + 0.0006 ≈ 0.041，約 1,200×0.041 ≈ 49 個托架需另做處理。若依掃描結果把帷幕牆安裝基準整體平移 6 mm，使平均偏差歸零，超出機率變為 P(|z| > 20/8 = 2.5) ≈ 0.012，只剩約 15 個。竣工掃描的價值不只在判定合格，更在讓下一工序依實際幾何調整基準；但基準調整須由帷幕牆設計者確認不影響室內淨距與接縫寬度。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: curtain-wall bracket positions on a 30-storey building are checked by scanning, 40 bracket points per floor and 1,200 in all, with deviations from design averaging +6 mm and a standard deviation of 8 mm (assumed normal and including measurement error), against a bracket adjustment range of ±20 mm. The probability of falling outside is P(z > (20−6)/8 = 1.75) + P(z < (−20−6)/8 = −3.25) ≈ 0.0401 + 0.0006 ≈ 0.041, so about 1,200×0.041 ≈ 49 brackets need special treatment. Shifting the whole façade setting-out datum by 6 mm according to the scan, so that the mean deviation becomes zero, changes the probability to P(|z| > 20/8 = 2.5) ≈ 0.012, leaving only about 15. The value of as-built scanning lies not only in judging conformance but in letting the next trade adjust its datum to actual geometry; the datum shift must still be confirmed by the façade designer as not affecting internal clearances or joint widths. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.

titleEn: Protective coating of large steel structures
summary: 從大氣腐蝕環境與 ISO 12944 腐蝕性分級出發，說明鋅底漆、中塗與面漆的防蝕機制、噴砂清潔度與錨紋、露點與施工環境、構件細部與邊緣膜厚、濕膜與乾膜厚度驗收、附著力檢測、劣化分級與維護策略，並以舊金山金門大橋的持續修補、蘇格蘭福斯鐵橋首次全面重塗與艾菲爾鐵塔每約七年一次的重塗為實例。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：某海邊鋼桁架橋塗裝面積 50,000 m²，評估為 C5 環境（教學假設第一年碳鋼損失 100 μm）。(1) 不塗裝時 25 年每面損失約 100×25^0.523 ≈ 538 μm。(2) 系統：無機鋅底漆 75 μm（固含量 60%）、環氧中塗 150 μm（80%）、聚氨酯面漆 60 μm（65%），總乾膜 285 μm。(3) 理論用量：50,000×75/(0.6×1,000) = 6,250 L、50,000×150/(0.8×1,000) = 9,375 L、50,000×60/(0.65×1,000) ≈ 4,615 L，合計約 20,240 L；損耗取 30%，採購約 20,240/0.7 ≈ 28,900 L，約 0.58 L/m²。(4) 施工時氣溫 20°C、濕度 85%，露點約 17.4°C，鋼面須 ≥ 20.4°C。(5) 驗收：最低個別讀數 0.8×285 = 228 μm。(6) 若改變一個輸入：飛濺區改列 CX 而加一道 150 μm 環氧中塗，該層理論用量再增加 9,375 L（含損耗約 13,400 L），總乾膜 435 μm。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際工程。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a coastal steel truss bridge has 50,000 m² to coat in a C5 environment (teaching assumption: first-year steel loss 100 μm). (1) Uncoated, each face would lose about 100×25^0.523 ≈ 538 μm in 25 years. (2) System: inorganic zinc primer 75 μm (60% volume solids), epoxy intermediate 150 μm (80%) and polyurethane topcoat 60 μm (65%), 285 μm dry in total. (3) Theoretical volumes: 50,000×75/(0.6×1,000) = 6,250 L, 50,000×150/(0.8×1,000) = 9,375 L and 50,000×60/(0.65×1,000) ≈ 4,615 L, about 20,240 L in total; with 30% loss, about 20,240/0.7 ≈ 28,900 L is bought, about 0.58 L/m². (4) At 20°C and 85% humidity the dew point is about 17.4°C, so the steel must be at least 20.4°C. (5) Acceptance: the minimum single reading is 0.8×285 = 228 μm. (6) Changing one input: classifying splash zones as CX and adding a 150 μm epoxy coat there adds 9,375 L theoretical for that coat (about 13,400 L with losses) and raises total dry film to 435 μm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project.

title: 建築模組化吊裝與接合
summary: 從體積模組的角柱荷載路徑與雙層樓板出發，說明模組間繫結與防連續倒塌、角部接頭與螺栓接合、吊點與吊裝框，再處理起重機選型與風速限制、堆疊公差與墊片、工廠出廠檢驗、現場接頭與防火防水檢查，最後談模組間空腔的耐久與模組履歷交接，並以新加坡 The Clement Canopy、紐約 461 Dean Street 與蒙特婁 Habitat 67 對照。

workedExample.text: 設計練習：一棟 20 層鋼構模組建築，每層 8 個模組，共 8×20 = 160 個。每個模組吊裝循環（掛鉤、吊升、定位、鎖固、回程）40 分鐘，總吊裝時間 160×40/60 ≈ 106.7 小時；每天可吊裝 6 小時，需 106.7/6 ≈ 17.8 天，若預留 25% 風雨停工，約 17.8/0.75 ≈ 23.7 天，取 24 個工作天。起重機在 40 m 半徑的額定荷重 28 t，模組 22 t 加吊裝框 2.5 t 與索具 0.5 t，吊重 25 t，使用率 25/28 ≈ 89%。若裝修與設備使模組增重 8% 成 22×1.08 = 23.76 t，吊重 26.76 t，使用率 26.76/28 ≈ 96%，超過 90% 的規劃上限，須縮短半徑、移位起重機或改用較大機型。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案；實際吊裝計畫須由合格的吊掛負責人核准。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: a 20-storey steel modular building has 8 modules per floor, 8×20 = 160 in all. Each lifting cycle (hook on, hoist, place, bolt, return) takes 40 minutes, so total hook time is 160×40/60 ≈ 106.7 hours; at 6 lifting hours a day this needs 106.7/6 ≈ 17.8 days, and allowing 25% for wind and rain about 17.8/0.75 ≈ 23.7 days, so 24 working days. The crane is rated 28 t at 40 m radius; a 22 t module plus a 2.5 t lifting frame and 0.5 t of rigging gives a 25 t hook load and 25/28 ≈ 89% utilisation. If finishes and equipment add 8% to the module, 22×1.08 = 23.76 t, the hook load is 26.76 t and utilisation 26.76/28 ≈ 96%, above a 90% planning limit, so the radius must be shortened, the crane moved or a larger crane used. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project; an actual lifting plan must be approved by a competent lifting supervisor.

summary: 中國政府公開記錄新關角隧道32.645公里及2014年4月雙線正洞貫通，這個事件不是通車日期。本課從高原長距離施工出發，研究弱帶支護、地下水、通風密度修正、多工作面物流與控制網。所有空氣密度及機具數字明列為假想條件，不代替高海拔現地測量。

The two results are not a complete design because permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. title: 豎井沉井施工
summary: 本課以沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮為主線，從下沉驅動與力系平衡與側摩阻與埋深累積建立系統邊界，再把井底滲流與有效應力、位移速率與突沉辨識連到永久抗浮與階段交接。下沉驅動、土阻與水壓隨施工階段改變；靜力差值不預測下沉速度，抗浮重量比也不是規範安全係數。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift. Driving weight, soil resistance and water pressure change by stage; static imbalance does not predict sinking speed, and a weight-to-uplift ratio is not a code safety factor. workedExample.text: 原創教學例：同一方向總應力假設為900 kPa，孔隙水壓為300 kPa，骨架有效應力為σ′=900−300=600 kPa。若只把孔壓提高10%至330 kPa，而總應力保持不變，σ′變為570 kPa，降低30 kPa亦即5%。這個比較只適用於相同位置、方向及總應力邊界；它不表示襯砌所受外水壓減少，相反水壓需求可能增加。工程師應分別把骨架強度與襯砌水壓作用帶回各自模型，並用分層水壓資料確認假設。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume total stress of 900 kPa and pore pressure of 300 kPa in the same direction, giving skeleton effective stress σ′=900−300=600 kPa. Increase only pore pressure by 10% to 330 kPa while holding total stress fixed: σ′ becomes 570 kPa, a reduction of 30 kPa or 5%. This comparison requires the same location, direction and total-stress boundary. It does not reduce external water pressure on the lining; hydraulic demand may instead rise. Check skeleton strength and lining pressure in their respective models and verify the assumptions using aquifer-specific piezometer data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：圓井直徑D=10 m，每次進尺h=1 m，原位體積為V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³。若直徑增加10%至11 m而進尺相同，V=π×11²×1/4=95.03 m³，增加21%。提升量若以鬆方記錄，必須先以實測鬆方係數換算，才可與此原位量比較。這項幾何敏感度不表示切削時間必然增加21%，因為岩性、刀具、出碴及支護還可能改變循環。施工團隊應把新增體積放入整個循環分析，而非只擴大切削功率。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: for a circular shaft with D=10 m and advance h=1 m, in-situ volume is V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³. Increasing diameter by 10% to 11 m at the same advance gives V=π×11²×1/4=95.03 m³, an increase of 21%. Hoisted loose volume must first be converted using a measured bulking factor before comparison. This geometric sensitivity does not imply exactly 21% more cutting time because geology, tools, muck handling and support also shape the cycle. The construction team should insert the extra volume into the complete cycle model instead of simply increasing the installed cutting power alone.

title: 交叉隧道人工地盤凍結
summary: 人工地盤凍結透過冷卻與相變暫時增加地層強度並減少滲流，卻同時引入熱量、凍脹及解凍變形問題。本課將凍結管幾何、對流熱輸送、長期潛變與備援冷量分開檢查，再建立從臨時凍土支護轉交永久襯砌的證據與停留點。

workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume m=1000 kg of pore water undergoes phase change with latent heat Lf=334 kJ/kg. The latent energy is Q=mLf=334000 kJ. It excludes soil sensible heat, unfrozen water, salinity, pipe losses and groundwater advection. Actual freezing duration requires an enthalpy and advective-heat model supported by temperatures; dividing this energy by rated plant power does not authorize excavation.

title: 連續壁槽溝穩定
summary: 連續壁成槽時，穩定液必須與地下水、土層滲透性及地面載重共同維持槽壁穩定。本課從壓差與濾餅機理出發，連結槽段幾何、垂直度、沉渣與鋼筋籠浮力，再用混凝土量平衡與接頭水力坡降建立施工品質及鄰房變形的驗證鏈。

workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume equal slurry and groundwater levels with unit weights of 11 and 9.81 kN/m³. This increases hydraulic margin only, not overall trench stability by 10%, because earth pressures, changing strata and panel geometry also influence the mechanism. title: 咬合樁止水壁施工
summary: 咬合樁牆以相鄰樁體互相切入形成連續擋土與止水系統，其性能受樁位、垂直度、切削時齡及結構樁剛度共同控制。本課將幾何咬合與材料強度分開驗證，再檢查冠梁傳力、嵌入深度、缺口滲流與長期裂縫，建立全深度的竣工證據。
summaryEn: Secant walls use overlapping piles to form a retaining and cutoff system governed by position, verticality, cutting age and structural-pile stiffness. The course verifies geometric overlap separately from material strength, then examines capping-beam transfer, embedment, defect seepage and long-term cracking through full-depth as-built evidence.

workedExample.text: 原創教學例：相同圓樁直徑D=1.0 m，中心距s=0.8 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.20 m。若只把中心距增加10%至0.88 m，樁徑不變，咬合減為0.12 m，降低40%。這顯示接近幾何閉合條件時，小幅位置變更可消耗很大的餘量。實際還須扣除孔斜、樁徑變異及測量誤差，並用全深相鄰樁位置重建止水路徑；正的名目咬合不是接面水密或結構抗剪已獲證明。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: equal circular piles have D=1.0 m and centre spacing s=0.8 m, giving nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m. Increase spacing alone by 10% to 0.88 m while holding diameter fixed: overlap becomes 0.12 m, a 40% reduction. This shows how a small positional change can consume substantial reserve near a geometric closure condition. Actual evaluation must also account for inclination, diameter variation and survey uncertainty and reconstruct the full-depth cutoff using adjacent-pile positions. Positive nominal overlap does not demonstrate either watertight contact or structural shear transfer. Verify the geometric prediction against independent survey and observed hydraulic behaviour.

title: 鋼板樁圍堰支撐
summary: 鋼板樁圍堰的安全取決於水土壓、支撐系統、鎖口止水與開挖底部的滲流穩定。本課以逐階段自由體圖連結抽水、支撐預力、樁趾被動反力及拆撐，並檢查角隅扭矩、水流拖曳與材料劣化，避免只用單根板樁彎矩代表整個圍堰。
summaryEn: Sheet-pile cofferdams depend on water and earth pressures, bracing, interlock sealing and base seepage stability. Stage-specific free bodies connect dewatering, support force, toe resistance and removal, with checks of corner torsion, current drag and deterioration beyond the bending demand of one sheet pile.

summary: 深開挖內支撐預壓用來消除間隙並限制壁體位移，卻也會引入額外構件力與地層反力。本課將預壓目標、軸向剛度、溫度作用、座板接觸及鎖定損失分開討論，再用多支撐互制、第二階效應與卸載變位建立設計及現場量測的共同基準。
summaryEn: Preloading excavation struts closes gaps and limits wall movement while introducing additional member forces and ground reactions. workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume post-contact support stiffness k=200 kN/mm and force increment ΔP=600 kN, giving elastic shortening δ=ΔP/k=3 mm. Actual jack stroke also includes seating gaps, waler deformation, wall movement and equipment compliance, so this shortening cannot establish complete contact. Verification records force and both end movements simultaneously, identifies the stiffness change at seating, then checks retained preload, thermal force and interaction with neighbouring struts. workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: take free length Lf=12 m, steel area A=0.001 m² and modulus E=195 GPa. At P=600 kN, theoretical free extension is δ=PLf/(EA)=36.92 mm. Total test movement also includes head seating, reaction-frame motion and bond-zone deformation. Separate these using independent references and unloading recovery; total movement cannot uniquely identify free length, and these assumed numbers do not prescribe a field test load.

title: 微型樁托底補強
summary: 微型樁托底的關鍵不只是把樁打到深處，而是建立既有柱、承台、連接件與地層之間可驗證的新力流。本課逐步檢查鋼材與黏結承載、預載移交、樁群剛度、無側限段挫屈與低淨高接頭，最後用長期沉陷判讀新舊基礎是否確實共同工作。
summaryEn: Micropile underpinning requires a verified new load path from existing columns through caps and connectors into ground. The course examines steel and bond resistance, preloaded transfer, group stiffness, buckling in unsupported zones and low-headroom joints, then interprets long-term settlement to establish interaction between old and new foundations.

workedExample.text: 原創教學例：現有柱力800 kN、增建250 kN、設備150 kN，在本例同時使用情境下合計1200 kN。若只增加現有柱力10%至880 kN，其他兩項維持不變，合計變成1280 kN，總需求增加80 kN或6.67%，而不是10%。還須按上部結構規範建立荷載組合，並確定新舊基礎如何分力。此加總不代表每根新樁平均分擔，也不證明承台連接或荷載移交完成；應以樁力、承台位移及現況調查共同驗證。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: an existing column carries 800 kN, an extension adds 250 kN and equipment adds 150 kN, giving 1200 kN in this simultaneous-use scenario. Increase only the existing-column component by 10% to 880 kN while holding the others fixed: total demand becomes 1280 kN, up 80 kN or 6.67%, not 10%. Appropriate structural load combinations and new-old foundation sharing remain necessary. This sum implies neither equal sharing by new piles nor completed cap connection and load transfer. Verify those using pile forces, cap movement and existing-condition investigation.

title: 噴射灌漿地盤改良
summary: 噴射灌漿以高能流體侵蝕並混合原土，形成幾何與材料性質受地層控制的改良體。本課區分止水與承載需求，從滲流、咬合、材料留存及返漿量平衡出發，逐步檢查強度發展、複合地盤分力、鑽孔偏斜和統計變異，最後以水力試驗驗證整體功能。
summaryEn: Jet grouting erodes and mixes soil to form treated bodies whose geometry and properties depend on ground conditions. The course separates cutoff and bearing functions, linking seepage, overlap, binder retention and return balance to strength, composite-ground sharing, bore deviation and variability, then verifies overall performance hydraulically.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設均質改良體滲透係數k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、水力坡降i=2，流量Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。只把k增加10%至1.1×10⁻⁸ m/s，其他量不變，Q=2.2×10⁻⁶ m³/s，也增加10%。此線性敏感度只對固定幾何與達西流成立；若有貫通缺口，總流量可能由另一機制控制。驗證時要記錄上下游水頭、面積與有效流路，並結合取芯及全深幾何，不能用低流量或高強度單獨宣稱整體止水合格。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume homogeneous permeability k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and hydraulic gradient i=2. Darcy discharge is Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. Increase only k by 10% to 1.1×10⁻⁸ m/s while holding other inputs fixed: Q becomes 2.2×10⁻⁶ m³/s, also up 10%. This linear sensitivity requires fixed geometry and Darcy flow; a connected defect may instead control total discharge through another mechanism. Verification records upstream and downstream heads, area and effective paths, combining cores and full-depth geometry rather than inferring system sealing from low flow or high strength alone. The designer must verify that the test boundaries represent the intended permanent hydraulic condition.

title: 深層攪拌樁地盤改良
summary: 深層攪拌以機械拌合將膠結材料送入原土，效果由土樣反應性、材料量與攪拌分布共同決定。本課不把轉速或水泥用量當品質保證，而是連結含水比、柱體幾何、重疊、剛度及脆性，配合取樣統計和地盤變形建立材料到整體性能的驗證。
summaryEn: Deep mixing mechanically combines binder with native soil, with results governed by reactivity, dosage and mixing distribution. The course treats neither rotation rate nor cement quantity as a quality guarantee, linking water content, geometry, overlap, stiffness and brittleness to sampling statistics and ground movement from material to system performance.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：原土水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=60%。若水量增加10%至66 kg而乾土不變，含水比變成66%，增加六個百分點，也就是相對增加10%。此結果不是飽和度，也不能直接推論固化後強度減少多少。配比還需計入新增漿液水、乾膠結材及土體反應性，並以相同養護及試驗方法比較。工程師應把含水比變化帶回材料試驗矩陣，避免用固定水泥量掩蓋不同土層的差異。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: native soil contains Mw=60 kg of water and Ms=100 kg of dry soil, giving w=Mw/Ms=60%. Increasing water mass by 10% to 66 kg while dry mass remains fixed raises water content to 66%, six percentage points or a 10% relative increase. This is not saturation and does not directly predict the resulting strength reduction. Mixture assessment also includes added slurry water, dry binder and soil reactivity under comparable curing and testing. Feed the changed water content into the laboratory matrix rather than assuming a fixed cement dosage neutralizes differences between strata.

title: 補償灌漿沉陷控制
summary: 補償灌漿透過受控的地層變形降低隧道施工對資產的沉陷影響，其目標是控制差異變形而非追求最大抬升。本課把沉陷槽、注入效率、孔位誤差、有效應力及回饋延遲連成模型，再檢查結構角變形、曲率與停止注入後的殘餘反應。
summaryEn: Compensation grouting controls ground deformation to reduce settlement effects from tunnelling, targeting differential movement rather than maximum heave. The course connects settlement troughs, injection efficiency, bore position, effective stress and feedback delay, then evaluates structural distortion, curvature and residual movement after injection stops.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設高斯沉陷槽smax=20 mm、寬度參數i=10 m，在x=10 m位置，s=20 exp(−10²/(2×10²))=12.13 mm。若只增加峰值10%至22 mm，槽寬不變，同位置沉陷為13.34 mm，也增加10%。這個結果描述固定形狀的沉陷場，不是所需灌漿量；實際建物剛度、注入效率、孔位與反應延遲會影響補償。工程師應檢查全資產角變形與曲率，並以獨立測點驗證槽形，不能只把單點抬回原位當成完成。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume a Gaussian trough with smax=20 mm and width parameter i=10 m. At x=10 m, s=20 exp(−10²/(2×10²))=12.13 mm. Increase only the peak by 10% to 22 mm while keeping width fixed: movement at the same position becomes 13.34 mm, also up 10%. This describes a fixed-shape settlement field, not required grout quantity. Building stiffness, injection efficiency, port position and response delay affect actual compensation. Check distortion and curvature across the whole asset and validate trough shape at independent points rather than defining completion by restoring one point alone.

title: 地盤壓密灌漿
summary: 壓密灌漿主要藉低流動性漿團擠移周圍土體，適用性與排水、密實狀態及可容許位移密切相關。本課區分擠密、填空與劈裂，從孔壓、孔隙比、漿泡幾何及處理覆蓋出發，連結等待時間、地表隆起、資產推力與改善後的剩餘沉陷。
summaryEn: Compaction grouting displaces surrounding soil with low-mobility grout masses, with suitability governed by drainage, density and tolerable movement. The course distinguishes densification, void filling and fracture, connecting pore pressure, void ratio, bulb geometry and coverage to waiting time, heave, asset force and residual settlement.

workedExample.text: 原創教學例：假設飽和土受等向不排水總應力增量Δσ=100 kPa，Skempton係數B=0.9，超額孔壓Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa。只把總應力增量提高10%至110 kPa，B維持不變，Δu=99 kPa。這表示短時間內增加的荷載大部分由水壓反應承擔，不代表土骨架已永久增強。真實壓密灌漿並非等向試驗，還含剪應力、排水與漿泡形狀；應以孔壓消散及處理前後原位阻力共同確認改善，而非把高注入壓力當成密實度證據。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: assume saturated soil receives an isotropic undrained total-stress increment Δσ=100 kPa with Skempton coefficient B=0.9. Excess pressure is Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa. Increase only the stress increment by 10% to 110 kPa with B fixed and Δu becomes 99 kPa. Most of the short-term increment is therefore expressed in water pressure rather than demonstrated permanent skeleton strengthening. Actual compaction grouting is not an isotropic test and also involves shear, drainage and bulb geometry. Verify improvement using pressure dissipation and paired in-situ resistance tests rather than interpreting high injection pressure as density evidence.

title: 砂井與垂直排水板
titleEn: Sand drains and prefabricated vertical drains
summary: 砂井與預製排水板縮短軟土排水路徑，使超額孔壓較快消散，但不會直接消除土的可壓縮性。本課以網格幾何、等效直徑、水平壓密時間與安裝塗抹為主線，連結井阻、載重、沉陷及排水老化，建立以孔壓與變形共同判斷的卸載交接條件。
summaryEn: Sand drains and prefabricated drains shorten drainage paths and accelerate excess-pressure dissipation without eliminating compressibility. The course connects grid geometry, equivalent diameter, radial time and installation smear to well resistance, loading, settlement and drain deterioration, establishing unloading and handover criteria from both pressure and movement.

workedExample.text: 原創教學例：僅作固定無因次幾何與材料參數的擴散尺度比較，長路徑Llong=5 m、短路徑Lshort=1 m，時間比tshort/tlong=(1/5)²=0.0400。若短路徑增加10%至1.1 m，時間比變為(1.1/5)²=0.0484，比原比值增加21%。這不是排水板網格改變後的實際工期比例，因為井徑比、塗抹範圍及井阻可能同步改變。工程設計仍須用完整徑向壓密關係並配合孔壓、沉陷與排水能力觀測，確認各層剩餘壓密而非直接套用平方比。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: compare diffusion scales only while holding dimensionless geometry and material parameters fixed. With Llong=5 m and Lshort=1 m, tshort/tlong=(1/5)²=0.0400. Increasing the short length by 10% to 1.1 m changes the ratio to (1.1/5)²=0.0484, a 21% increase in that ratio. This is not the actual schedule ratio after changing a drain grid, because drain-size ratio, smear extent and well resistance may change simultaneously. Engineering design still requires the complete radial-consolidation relationship and observations of pore pressure, settlement and discharge capacity to establish residual consolidation in each layer.

title: 真空預壓軟土改良
summary: 本課聚焦連結負孔壓傳遞、排水能力與卸載回彈判斷真空壓密。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on relate suction transfer, drainage capacity and unloading rebound to vacuum consolidation. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：教學假設總應力固定、孔壓變化Δu=−60kPa，Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa；此式不代表任何深度都收到相同負壓。假設總應力固定，孔壓降幅由60增為66kPa，增加10%，有效應力增量也由60增為66kPa；這不能推論沉陷或強度同增10%，因壓縮性及應力路徑可能非線性。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。
workedExample.textEn: The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: At fixed total stress and pore-pressure change Δu=−60kPa, Δσ′=−Δu=60kPa. The relation does not imply equal suction at every depth. At fixed total stress, increasing assumed pore-pressure reduction from60 to66kPa by10% raises effective-stress gain from60 to66kPa. Settlement or strength does not necessarily rise10%, because compressibility and stress paths may be nonlinear. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. title: Landsat 地球觀測計畫

summaryEn: Use Landsat 8 as the main instrument example to study orbit, bands, DN conversion, quality masks and time series, separating observations, processing and environmental inference.
scope: 12道原創遙測入門任務；課程沒有預載實景或實測表格。小算例係數為教學假設；實際分析需自行取得資料及其版本相符的中繼資料，不把单一衛星規格套用所有世代。
scopeEn: Twelve original introductory remote-sensing tasks, without preloaded scenes or measured tables. Small-example coefficients are hypothetical. Actual analysis requires acquired data and matching metadata; one satellite’s specifications do not apply to every generation.

summary: 以 LHC 的公開系統介紹拆解束流導引、RF、低溫、真空與探測資料介面。
summaryEn: Use public LHC system descriptions to examine beam guidance, RF, cryogenics, vacuum and detector-data interfaces.
scope: 十二步是紙上模型與原創示意圖的概念課程，不提供真實機器設定、束流操作、聯鎖解除或繞過方式。教學事件卡不是真實 LHC 量測，也不作新物理結論；不是加速器設計或運轉 SOP。
scopeEn: Twelve tasks use paper models and original concept diagrams. They provide no real machine settings, beam operations, interlock releases or bypass methods. Teaching event cards are not LHC measurements and support no new-physics conclusions; this is not an accelerator design or operating SOP.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想單次脈衝：到target的雷射能量2 MJ、融合輸出3 MJ，Qtarget=1.5。若wall-plug雷射效率2%，電網驅動需100 MJ；僅回收融合熱且熱電效率35%，輸出1.05 MJ；另有5 MJ輔助輸入，淨能量=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ。未回收雷射熱，皆為假想而非NIF實測；target gain不等於電廠淨電。
workedExample.textEn: Assume one pulse with laser energy 2 MJ at the target and fusion output 3 MJ: Qtarget=1.5. At assumed wall-plug laser efficiency 2%, driver input is 100 MJ. Recovering only fusion heat at 35% gives 1.05 MJ; auxiliaries consume 5 MJ, so net=1.05−100−5=−103.95 MJ. Laser-heat recovery is omitted; values are hypothetical, not NIF measurements. Target gain is not plant net electricity.
